+**Amendment (2026-10-20): bounded current-source reference observation.**
+The default daemon plan gate may use sealed ingest reference facts for examined
+files only after a request-owned window hashes the entire discovered corpus
+before and after its plan calls. A continuation is bounded to 64 MiB and five
+seconds; the window holds no file bodies, expires, and publishes no final
+current verdict before close. Excluded bytes preserve Unknown for absent
+references. A legacy daemon without the advertised protocol keeps the live
+scan and its partial disclosure; a started window that fails refuses. This is
+derived evidence for one observed interval, not persisted plan state or a
+machine-evaluated process trigger. **Decision models.** None: source identity,
+caps and exclusions are deterministic byte and metadata comparisons.
+
+The CLI's completed window and the console's cached plan section have
+different freshness evidence. CLI JSON marks `observed_window` only after a
+validated close; the console marks `current_worktree_freshness: unknown` until
+it implements that lifecycle. OC-8 parity still covers each plan's counts,
+criteria and provenance; only these explicit freshness fields differ.
+If a current window refuses during begin, collection, close or result
+retrieval, CLI JSON emits one operational refusal with scope
+`current_worktree`, freshness `unknown`, the reason and exit 2. It emits no
+plan verdicts or cached positive rows. Re-ingest may establish a new sealed
+generation, after which a new window can qualify another observation.
+
 ## ADR-019 — In-tree mirror of agentic-kit for kit-free distribution
 
 **Status.** Accepted, amended 2026-09-01; amended 2026-10-16 by ADR-070 (the mirrors are packages of fathom's module by import-path rewrite: no kit require or replace in `go.mod`, `.vendor-commit` is the pin, vendor-check compares after reversing the rewrite).

 primary target (then the per-file resolver graduates to a typed pass); the
 per-file refresh is measured slower than 150 ms p50 at the hook.
 
+### Amendment: source-bound external indexes (2026-10-20)
+
+The external SCIP producer remains the compiler-facing instrument. A versioned
+local sidecar binds mutable generated projects, configuration, source inventories,
+reference assemblies and producer identity to its exact index. `scip-dotnet`
+requires the receipt; other producers opt in by providing it. Import and every
+shared refresh path validate the same contract and invalidate only the refused
+index's own namespace plus served graph memos. Missing sidecars/indexes and failed
+attempts cannot preserve older typed rows as current. State-directory precedence
+also clears remembered rows for a shadowed legacy index without deleting either
+artifact or falling back when the preferred index fails. No new store table,
+model, MCP tool, compiler resolver or polling loop is introduced. This is freshness
+at import/refresh boundaries, not continuous query-time hashing.
+See [the contract and migration](docs/guides/scip-source-receipts.md).
+
+**Decision models.** None: hashes, identity and invalidation are deterministic.
+
 ## ADR-042: The decision port — typed fast decisions behind a flag, off by default (2026-09-22)
 
 **Status.** Accepted. Accepts `docs/vision/32-decision-port.md` (owner-directed,
@@ -2653,6 +2693,12 @@ amendment's "the user's own `[decide] sites`" becomes the user-only `[decide] se
 
 **Amended 2026-09-24 (ADR-044, O114): liveness binds to a commit, and the kill rule counts warn.** Two defects in this record's first round. (1) A certificate read `live` whenever the newest ingested run passed; runs carried no commit and the sweep staled a certificate only when its test FILE moved, so after any refactor every certificate stayed live on a run that predated the change (O114). Decision 1's "stale when the test or a reached symbol moves" and decision 5's "no attested run, no live certificate" now mean: a certificate is `live` only when a passing attested run is bound to a commit (test-kit's envelope `env.commit`, clean tree) and no file the certificate reaches (its test file plus the files of the symbols it reaches) changed between that commit and HEAD. A run without a commit leaves the certificate `unproven` with the reason named; a bound run whose reach changed since makes the claim `stale`. (2) The TC-M3 kill clause ("never fires deny in a month") combined with requirements shipped `enforcement: off` is dead on arrival: an off requirement cannot fire. The clause now reads "never fires at warn in a month on a repository where it is armed at warn", and the testing-certifications requirement is armed at warn on this repository.
 
+### Native Unity source-bound adapter amendment (2026-10-20)
+
+The non-Go runner extension uses the existing test-kit record plus a bound native NUnit document and active source receipt. Only exact current typed method identities join; variants aggregate as a whole cohort and filtered or stale evidence stays unjoined/UNKNOWN. Generic non-Go file/name joining remains a separate path and cannot admit a declared Unity envelope. Native dirty/source-bound observations remain informational and excluded from live clean-commit certificates. The producer contract is [documented here](docs/guides/unity-nunit-evidence.md); the compatibility change is [explicit](docs/upgrades/unreleased-native-unity-evidence.md). This does not promote broader native coverage or language grades.
+
+**Decision models.** None applies: identity, hashes, source freshness and native outcomes are deterministic; provider none, no model egress.

+// Bench-only native declaration evidence from the native project loader.
+// No extractor output/SCIP/store is read to construct these answers. Rich raw
+// spans remain available when the product's declared signature rule is lossy.
+using System.Security.Cryptography;
+using System.Text;
+using Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;
+using Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;
+using Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.Syntax;
+using Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Text;
+
+static class DeclarationEvidence
+{
+    // Grounded in docs/design/language-breadth.md section3.3 and
+    // internal/extractor/tsextract.go:1231-1250, exact f844af51. This exports
+    // evidence, not a new score. No-body FIRST-LINE behavior is preserved.
+    public const string SignatureContract = "definition Span.Start to body Span.Start; without a body only its first line; Unicode whitespace collapsed/trimmed; cap200Unicode scalar values (199 + ellipsis), per existing product contract";
+
+    internal sealed record Result(object File, List<object> Declarations);
+    sealed record Declaration(string Kind, SyntaxNode Definition, SyntaxNode Statement, SyntaxNodeOrToken Name);
+
+    public static Result Collect(string root, string relative, Project project, SyntaxNode syntax, SemanticModel model)
+    {
+        var path=Path.GetFullPath(syntax.SyntaxTree.FilePath);
+        var raw=System.IO.File.ReadAllBytes(path);
+        var before=Convert.ToHexString(SHA256.HashData(raw)).ToLowerInvariant();
+        var text=syntax.SyntaxTree.GetText();
+        using(var reader=new StreamReader(new MemoryStream(raw),text.Encoding??Encoding.UTF8,true))
+            if(!String.Equals(reader.ReadToEnd(),text.ToString(),StringComparison.Ordinal))
+                throw new IOException("Loaded semantic source differs from disk: "+relative);
+        var rows=new List<object>();
+        foreach(var declaration in Declarations(syntax))
+        {
+            var node=declaration.Definition;
+            var symbol=model.GetDeclaredSymbol(node);
+            // Events/fields are emitted at their individual variable declarator;
+            // no first-variable line is borrowed for later names.
+            var nameText=declaration.Name.ToString();
+            var nameToken=declaration.Name.IsToken?declaration.Name.AsToken():default;
+            var bodyStart=BodyStart(node);
+            var headerEnd=bodyStart??node.Span.End;
+            var contractEnd=headerEnd;
+            if(bodyStart==null)
+            {
+                var firstLine=text.Lines.GetLineFromPosition(node.SpanStart);
+                contractEnd=Math.Min(contractEnd,firstLine.End);
+            }
+            var header=text.ToString(TextSpan.FromBounds(node.SpanStart,headerEnd));
+            var contractSource=text.ToString(TextSpan.FromBounds(node.SpanStart,contractEnd));
+            var semanticContainer=symbol?.ContainingSymbol;
+            var declarations=symbol?.DeclaringSyntaxReferences.OrderBy(reference=>reference.SyntaxTree.FilePath,StringComparer.Ordinal).ThenBy(reference=>reference.Span.Start).Select(reference=>{
+                var target=reference.GetSyntax();
+                return new {path=Path.GetRelativePath(root,target.SyntaxTree.FilePath).Replace('\\','/'),
+                    span=Span(target.SyntaxTree,target.Span)};
+            }).ToArray();
+            rows.Add(new {path=relative,project=project.Name,project_file=project.FilePath,
+                assembly=model.Compilation.Assembly.Identity.ToString(),
+                raw_kind=declaration.Kind,syntax_kind=node.Kind().ToString(),
+                name_text=nameText,name_value=nameToken.RawKind==0?nameText:nameToken.ValueText,
+                name_span=Span(node.SyntaxTree,declaration.Name.Span),
+                definition_span=Span(node.SyntaxTree,node.Span),full_span=Span(node.SyntaxTree,node.FullSpan),
+                statement_span=Span(node.SyntaxTree,declaration.Statement.Span),
+                containing_namespace=symbol?.ContainingNamespace?.ToDisplayString(),
+                containing_symbol=semanticContainer?.ToDisplayString(SymbolDisplayFormat.FullyQualifiedFormat),
+                semantic_kind=symbol?.Kind.ToString(),semantic_type_kind=(symbol as INamedTypeSymbol)?.TypeKind.ToString(),
+                method_kind=(symbol as IMethodSymbol)?.MethodKind.ToString(),metadata_name=symbol?.MetadataName,
+                display_name=symbol?.ToDisplayString(SymbolDisplayFormat.CSharpErrorMessageFormat),
+                documentation_id=symbol?.GetDocumentationCommentId(),
+                binding_status=symbol==null?"unresolved-declared-symbol":"resolved",declaring_syntax_references=declarations,
+                raw_header=header,header_span=Span(node.SyntaxTree,TextSpan.FromBounds(node.SpanStart,headerEnd)),
+                signature_contract_applies=SignatureApplies(declaration.Kind),
+                signature_normalized_candidate=NormalizeSignature(contractSource),
+                signature_source_span=Span(node.SyntaxTree,TextSpan.FromBounds(node.SpanStart,contractEnd)),
+                signature_has_conditional_directives=contractSource.Split('\n').Any(line=>line.TrimStart().StartsWith("#",StringComparison.Ordinal)),
+                signature_limit="Raw active-tree source slice; conditional directive/preprocessor policy differences remain unjudged until compared explicitly; this output computes no accuracy"});
+        }
+        var after=Convert.ToHexString(SHA256.HashData(System.IO.File.ReadAllBytes(path))).ToLowerInvariant();
+        if(before!=after)throw new IOException("Source changed while exporting declarations: "+relative);
+        var options=syntax.SyntaxTree.Options as CSharpParseOptions;
+        var diagnostics=syntax.SyntaxTree.GetDiagnostics().Select(d=>new {id=d.Id,severity=d.Severity.ToString(),message=d.ToString()}).ToArray();
+        return new Result(new {path=relative,project=project.Name,source_sha256=before,
+            source_text_checksum=Convert.ToHexString(text.GetChecksum().ToArray()).ToLowerInvariant(),
+            source_text_checksum_algorithm=text.ChecksumAlgorithm.ToString(),
+            language_version=options?.LanguageVersion.ToString(),
+            preprocessor_symbols=options?.PreprocessorSymbolNames.OrderBy(value=>value,StringComparer.Ordinal).ToArray(),
+            diagnostics,declarations=rows.Count},rows);
+    }
+
+    static object Span(SyntaxTree tree,TextSpan span)
+    {
+        var lines=tree.GetLineSpan(span).Span;
+        return new {start_line=lines.Start.Line+1,start_column_utf16=lines.Start.Character,
+            end_line=lines.End.Line+1,end_column_utf16=lines.End.Character,
+            start_offset_utf16=span.Start,length_utf16=span.Length};
+    }
+
+    static IEnumerable<Declaration> Declarations(SyntaxNode root)
+    {
+        foreach(var node in root.DescendantNodes())
+        {
+            Declaration declaration=node switch {
+                BaseNamespaceDeclarationSyntax n=>new("namespace",n,n,n.Name.GetLastToken()),
+                RecordDeclarationSyntax n=>new(n.ClassOrStructKeyword.IsKind(SyntaxKind.StructKeyword)?"recordStruct":"record",n,n,n.Identifier),
+                ClassDeclarationSyntax n=>new("class",n,n,n.Identifier),
+                StructDeclarationSyntax n=>new("struct",n,n,n.Identifier),
+                InterfaceDeclarationSyntax n=>new("interface",n,n,n.Identifier),
+                EnumDeclarationSyntax n=>new("enum",n,n,n.Identifier),
+                EnumMemberDeclarationSyntax n=>new("enumMember",n,n,n.Identifier),
+                DelegateDeclarationSyntax n=>new("delegate",n,n,n.Identifier),
+                MethodDeclarationSyntax n=>new("method",n,n,n.Identifier),
+                ConstructorDeclarationSyntax n=>new("constructor",n,n,n.Identifier),
+                DestructorDeclarationSyntax n=>new("destructor",n,n,n.Identifier),
+                OperatorDeclarationSyntax n=>new("operator",n,n,n.OperatorToken),
+                ConversionOperatorDeclarationSyntax n=>new("conversionOperator",n,n,n.Type),
+                PropertyDeclarationSyntax n=>new("property",n,n,n.Identifier),
+                IndexerDeclarationSyntax n=>new("indexer",n,n,n.ThisKeyword),
+                EventDeclarationSyntax n=>new("event",n,n,n.Identifier),
+                _=>null};
+            if(declaration!=null)yield return declaration;
+            if(node is BaseFieldDeclarationSyntax field)
+                foreach(var variable in field.Declaration.Variables)
+                    yield return new Declaration(field is EventFieldDeclarationSyntax?"event":"field",variable,field,variable.Identifier);
+        }
+    }
+
+    static int? BodyStart(SyntaxNode node)=>node switch {
+        BaseMethodDeclarationSyntax method=>method.Body?.SpanStart??method.ExpressionBody?.SpanStart,
+        TypeDeclarationSyntax type when !type.OpenBraceToken.IsMissing&&type.OpenBraceToken.RawKind!=0=>type.OpenBraceToken.SpanStart,
+        _=>null};
+
+    static bool SignatureApplies(string kind)=>kind is "method" or "constructor" or "conversionOperator" or "class" or "record" or "recordStruct" or "struct" or "interface";
+
+    internal static string NormalizeSignature(string source)
+    {
+        var builder=new StringBuilder();var pendingSpace=false;
+        foreach(var rune in source.EnumerateRunes())
+        {
+            if(Rune.IsWhiteSpace(rune)){pendingSpace=builder.Length>0;continue;}
+            if(pendingSpace)builder.Append(' ');
+            builder.Append(rune.ToString());pendingSpace=false;
+        }
+        var normalized=builder.ToString();var runes=normalized.EnumerateRunes().ToArray();
+        if(runes.Length<=200)return normalized;
+        return string.Concat(runes.Take(199).Select(rune=>rune.ToString())).TrimEnd(' ')+"…";
+    }
+}

+// Bench-only declaration export from the subject's actual MSBuild selection.
+// No extractor output, SCIP or store is read to construct native answers.
+using System.Security.Cryptography;
+using System.Text.Json;
+using System.Xml.Linq;
+using Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;
+using Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.MSBuild;
+
+static class ProjectDeclarations
+{
+    public static int Run(string[] args) => RunAsync(args,false).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
+    public static int RunImports(string[] args) => RunAsync(args,true).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
+
+    static async Task<int> RunAsync(string[] args,bool importsMode)
+    {
+        if(args.Length is not (3 or 4))
+            throw new ArgumentException((importsMode?"project-imports":"project-declarations")+" <repository-root> <actual.sln|slnx|csproj> <repository-relative-source-directory> [owned-intermediate-root]");
+        var root=Path.GetFullPath(args[0]);
+        var input=Path.GetFullPath(args[1]);
+        var selector=args[2];
+        if(Path.IsPathRooted(selector)||selector.Contains('\\')||selector.Any(char.IsControl)||
+            selector.Split('/').Any(segment=>segment is "" or "." or ".."))
+            throw new ArgumentException("Source directory must be an explicit canonical repository-relative path");
+        if(!Directory.Exists(Path.Combine(root,selector)))throw new DirectoryNotFoundException(selector);
+        var prefix=selector+"/";
+        var failures=new List<string>();var errors=new List<object>();var projects=new List<object>();
+        var declarations=new List<object>();var files=new List<object>();var outside=new List<object>();
+        var inputHash=Hash(input);
+        var properties=new Dictionary<string,string>();
+        string isolatedProperties=null;
+        if(args.Length==4)
+        {
+            var owned=Path.GetFullPath(args[3]);Directory.CreateDirectory(owned);
+            isolatedProperties=Path.Combine(owned,"oracle-output-paths.props");
+            // Imported after Unity-style pre-SDK property groups. Keep each
+            // project's design-time artifacts distinct without editing it.
+            var obj=Path.Combine(owned,"obj").Replace('\\','/')+"/$(MSBuildProjectName)/";
+            var bin=Path.Combine(owned,"bin").Replace('\\','/')+"/$(MSBuildProjectName)/";
+            new XDocument(new XElement("Project",new XElement("PropertyGroup",
+                new XElement("BaseIntermediateOutputPath",obj),new XElement("IntermediateOutputPath",obj),
+                new XElement("MSBuildProjectExtensionsPath",obj),new XElement("OutputPath",bin),
+                new XElement("UseSharedCompilation","false"),new XElement("NuGetAudit","false"))))
+                .Save(isolatedProperties);
+            properties["CustomBeforeMicrosoftCommonProps"]=isolatedProperties;
+        }
+        using var workspace=MSBuildWorkspace.Create(properties);
+        workspace.RegisterWorkspaceFailedHandler(e=>{
+            if(e.Diagnostic.Kind==WorkspaceDiagnosticKind.Failure)failures.Add(e.Diagnostic.Message);
+            Console.Error.WriteLine("workspace: "+e.Diagnostic);
+        });
+        Solution solution;
+        if(Path.GetExtension(input).Equals(".csproj",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
+            solution=(await workspace.OpenProjectAsync(input)).Solution;
+        else solution=await workspace.OpenSolutionAsync(input);
+        // Both modes use this exact workspace, project selection and isolation.
+        // The raw using exporter has no dependency on Fathom, SCIP or its scorer.
+        var imports=importsMode?new ProjectImports(root,selector,solution,failures):null;
+        if(importsMode){imports.Track(input);imports.Track(isolatedProperties);}
+        foreach(var project in solution.Projects.OrderBy(project=>project.Name,StringComparer.Ordinal).ThenBy(project=>project.FilePath,StringComparer.Ordinal))
+        {
+            if(project.Language!=LanguageNames.CSharp)continue;
+            var compilation=await project.GetCompilationAsync();
+            if(compilation==null){failures.Add("null compilation: "+project.Name);continue;}
+            // Emitted error order is ordinal rendered-message order per project.
+            // OrderBy retains every diagnostic, including identical messages.
+            var projectErrors=compilation.GetDiagnostics().Where(d=>d.Severity==DiagnosticSeverity.Error)
+                .OrderBy(d=>d.ToString(),StringComparer.Ordinal).ToArray();
+            foreach(var error in projectErrors)errors.Add(new {project=project.Name,message=error.ToString()});
+            projects.Add(new {name=project.Name,path=project.FilePath,
+                source_sha256=project.FilePath==null?null:Hash(project.FilePath),
+                assembly=compilation.Assembly.Identity.ToString(),trees=compilation.SyntaxTrees.Count(),errors=projectErrors.Length});
+            if(importsMode)imports.AddProject(project,compilation);
+            Console.Error.WriteLine($"project {project.Name}: {compilation.SyntaxTrees.Count()} trees, {projectErrors.Length} errors");
+            foreach(var document in project.Documents.OrderBy(document=>document.FilePath,StringComparer.Ordinal))
+            {
+                if(document.FilePath==null){failures.Add("document has no source path: "+project.Name+"/"+document.Name);continue;}
+                var relative=Path.GetRelativePath(root,document.FilePath).Replace('\\','/');
+                if(!relative.StartsWith(prefix,StringComparison.Ordinal))
+                {
+                    outside.Add(new {project=project.Name,path=relative,reason="outside explicit source directory; not declaration-emission selected"});
+                    continue;
+                }
+                var model=await document.GetSemanticModelAsync();var syntax=await document.GetSyntaxRootAsync();
+                if(model==null||syntax==null){failures.Add("null native model/root: "+relative);continue;}
+                if(importsMode)await imports.AddFileAsync(relative,project,syntax,model);
+                else
+                {
+                    var evidence=DeclarationEvidence.Collect(root,relative,project,syntax,model);
+                    declarations.AddRange(evidence.Declarations);files.Add(evidence.File);
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        if(inputHash!=Hash(input))failures.Add("Project/solution input changed while exporting declarations");
+        if(importsMode)
+        {
+            imports.CheckClosure(failures);
+            Console.WriteLine(JsonSerializer.Serialize(new {
+                schema="fathom.roslyn.project-imports/v1",tool="roslyn-project-imports",
+                version=typeof(Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.CSharpCompilation).Assembly.GetName().Version.ToString(),
+                repository_root=root,input,input_sha256=inputHash,source_directory=selector,
+                isolated_output_properties=isolatedProperties,
+                isolated_output_properties_sha256=isolatedProperties==null?null:Hash(isolatedProperties),
+                positions="1-based lines, 0-based UTF16 columns, half-open spans",
+                semantics="Raw native using-statement binding and namespace declaration contributions only; never actual-use dependencies or a neutral grading document",
+                emission_scope="Active using directives in selected regular project.Documents. Every compilation tree is inventoried; a selected generated/non-document tree refuses completeness rather than silently disappearing.",
+                read_boundary="Source directory selects emitted using rows only. MSBuild loads projects, source generators and references outside it; no allowed-read, no-network or full MSBuild-import closure guarantee. Use an independently controlled offline environment and source receipt.",
+                closure_scope="Input, loaded project files, physical compilation trees, PE references and owned output props; transitive MSBuild imports are not exhaustively enumerated",
+                projects=imports.Projects,files=imports.Files,usings=imports.Usings,
+                native_input_hashes=imports.Inputs,workspace_failures=failures,compile_errors=errors,
+                outside_emission_selection=outside
+            },new JsonSerializerOptions{WriteIndented=true}));
+            return failures.Count==0&&errors.Count==0?0:1;
+        }
+        var payload=new {schema="fathom.roslyn.project-declarations/v1",tool="roslyn-project-declarations",
+            version=typeof(Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.CSharpCompilation).Assembly.GetName().Version.ToString(),
+            repository_root=root,input,input_sha256=inputHash,source_directory=selector,
+            isolated_output_properties=isolatedProperties,
+            isolated_output_properties_sha256=isolatedProperties==null?null:Hash(isolatedProperties),
+            scope="Actual MSBuild project/solution and active configuration only; source-directory-selected native declaration occurrences, not a syntax-union or runtime proof",
+            read_boundary="Source directory controls emitted declarations only. MSBuildWorkspace loads other project/dependency inputs; this is not an allowed-read sandbox or offline guarantee.",
+            positions="1-based lines, 0-based UTF16 columns, half-open ranges; definition/full/statement/name spans are separate",
+            signature_contract=DeclarationEvidence.SignatureContract,projects,workspace_failures=failures,compile_errors=errors,
+            outside_emission_selection=outside,files,declarations};
+        Console.WriteLine(JsonSerializer.Serialize(payload,new JsonSerializerOptions{WriteIndented=true}));
+        return failures.Count==0&&errors.Count==0?0:1;
+    }
+
+    static string Hash(string path)=>Convert.ToHexString(SHA256.HashData(File.ReadAllBytes(path))).ToLowerInvariant();
+}

+// Bench-only raw native using facts. This is NOT the neutral import oracle:
+// declaration membership must never become actual-use dependency truth.
+using System.Security.Cryptography;
+using System.Text;
+using Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;
+using Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;
+using Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.Syntax;
+using Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.FindSymbols;
+using Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Text;
+
+sealed class ProjectImports
+{
+    readonly string root,prefix;
+    readonly Solution solution;
+    readonly List<string> failures;
+    readonly SortedDictionary<string,string> inputs=new(StringComparer.Ordinal);
+    Task<List<(Project Project,Compilation Compilation)>> sourceProjects;
+    sealed record Origin(Compilation Compilation,Project Project,string Method,object[] Candidates,bool Unknown);
+    public readonly List<object> Projects=new(),Files=new(),Usings=new();
+    public object[] Inputs=>inputs.Select(pair=>(object)new {path=pair.Key,sha256=pair.Value}).ToArray();
+
+    public ProjectImports(string root,string selector,Solution solution,List<string> failures)
+    {this.root=root;prefix=selector+"/";this.solution=solution;this.failures=failures;}
+
+    public void Track(string path)
+    {
+        if(path==null||!File.Exists(path))return;
+        path=Path.GetFullPath(path);
+        string hash=Hash(File.ReadAllBytes(path));
+        if(inputs.TryGetValue(path,out var old)&&old!=hash)
+            throw new IOException("Native input changed during export: "+path);
+        inputs[path]=hash;
+    }
+    public void CheckClosure(List<string> failures)
+    {
+        foreach(var item in inputs)
+            if(!File.Exists(item.Key)||Hash(File.ReadAllBytes(item.Key))!=item.Value)
+                failures.Add("Native input changed during import export: "+item.Key);
+    }
+    public void AddProject(Project project,Compilation compilation)
+    {
+        Track(project.FilePath);
+        if(project.FilePath==null||!File.Exists(project.FilePath))failures.Add("Missing loaded project file: "+project.Name);
+        var parse=project.ParseOptions as CSharpParseOptions;
+        var references=new List<object>();
+        foreach(var reference in compilation.References)
+        {
+            var assembly=compilation.GetAssemblyOrModuleSymbol(reference);
+            string path=(reference as PortableExecutableReference)?.FilePath;Track(path);
+            if(path!=null&&!File.Exists(path))failures.Add("Missing loaded PE reference: "+path);
+            references.Add(new {display=reference.Display,path,
+                native_assembly=assembly?.ContainingAssembly?.Identity.ToString()??(assembly as IAssemblySymbol)?.Identity.ToString(),
+                reference_kind=reference is CompilationReference?"compilation":"portable-executable",
+                aliases=reference.Properties.Aliases.IsDefaultOrEmpty?Array.Empty<string>():reference.Properties.Aliases.ToArray(),embed_interop_types=reference.Properties.EmbedInteropTypes});
+        }
+        var trees=new List<object>();
+        foreach(var tree in compilation.SyntaxTrees.OrderBy(tree=>tree.FilePath,StringComparer.Ordinal))
+        {
+            Track(tree.FilePath);
+            bool regularDocument=project.Documents.Any(document=>document.FilePath==tree.FilePath);
+            if(Selected(tree.FilePath)&&!regularDocument)
+                failures.Add("Selected native tree has no regular project.Document; using coverage incomplete: "+tree.FilePath);
+            if(File.Exists(tree.FilePath)&&File.ReadAllText(tree.FilePath)!=tree.GetText().ToString())
+                failures.Add("Physical source differs from the native compilation snapshot: "+tree.FilePath);
+            trees.Add(new {path=Relative(tree.FilePath),native_text_sha256=Hash(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(tree.GetText().ToString())),
+                physical_file=File.Exists(tree.FilePath),selected=Selected(tree.FilePath),regular_project_document=regularDocument,
+                using_emission=Selected(tree.FilePath)?regularDocument?"selected regular document":"incomplete: selected non-document tree":"outside using emission selection"});
+        }
+        Projects.Add(new {name=project.Name,path=project.FilePath,assembly=compilation.Assembly.Identity.ToString(),
+            language_version=parse?.LanguageVersion.ToString(),preprocessor_symbols=parse?.PreprocessorSymbolNames.OrderBy(x=>x,StringComparer.Ordinal).ToArray(),
+            output_kind=compilation.Options.OutputKind.ToString(),platform=compilation.Options.Platform.ToString(),
+            project_references=project.ProjectReferences.Select(reference=>new {
+                path=solution.GetProject(reference.ProjectId)?.FilePath,aliases=reference.Aliases.IsDefaultOrEmpty?Array.Empty<string>():reference.Aliases.ToArray(),embed_interop_types=reference.EmbedInteropTypes}).ToArray(),
+            native_references=references,native_trees=trees});
+    }
+
+    public async Task AddFileAsync(string path,Project project,SyntaxNode syntax,SemanticModel model)
+    {
+        Track(syntax.SyntaxTree.FilePath);
+        var options=syntax.SyntaxTree.Options as CSharpParseOptions;
+        // Disabled regions are native trivia with exact positions/hashes. Do not
+        // reparse them into fake active bindings or silently union configurations.
+        var inactive=syntax.DescendantTrivia(descendIntoTrivia:true)
+            .Where(trivia=>trivia.IsKind(SyntaxKind.DisabledTextTrivia))
+            .Select(trivia=>new {span=Span(syntax.SyntaxTree,trivia.Span),
+                text_sha256=Hash(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(trivia.ToFullString())),
+                status="inactive in native parse configuration; no binding attempted"}).ToArray();
+        Files.Add(new {project=project.FilePath,path,
+            source_sha256=File.Exists(syntax.SyntaxTree.FilePath)?inputs[Path.GetFullPath(syntax.SyntaxTree.FilePath)]:null,
+            native_text_sha256=Hash(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(syntax.SyntaxTree.GetText().ToString())),
+            language_version=options?.LanguageVersion.ToString(),preprocessor_symbols=options?.PreprocessorSymbolNames.OrderBy(x=>x,StringComparer.Ordinal).ToArray(),
+            inactive_regions=inactive});
+        foreach(var directive in syntax.DescendantNodes().OfType<UsingDirectiveSyntax>().OrderBy(node=>node.SpanStart))
+        {
+            var name=directive.NamespaceOrType;
+            var info=name==null?default: model.GetSymbolInfo(name);
+            var symbol=info.Symbol;
+            if(symbol is IAliasSymbol alias)symbol=alias.Target;
+            var candidates=info.CandidateSymbols.IsDefaultOrEmpty?Array.Empty<ISymbol>():info.CandidateSymbols.ToArray();
+            var candidateReason=info.CandidateReason;
+            if(symbol is IErrorTypeSymbol error)
+            {
+                if(candidates.Length==0&&!error.CandidateSymbols.IsDefaultOrEmpty)candidates=error.CandidateSymbols.ToArray();
+                if(candidateReason==CandidateReason.None)candidateReason=error.CandidateReason;
+            }
+            var diagnostics=model.GetDiagnostics(directive.Span).Where(d=>d.Severity==DiagnosticSeverity.Error).ToArray();
+            var contributions=new List<object>();var targets=new SortedSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
+            bool metadata=false,source=false,unknown=false;
+            string status;
+            if(candidateReason==CandidateReason.Ambiguous||diagnostics.Any(d=>d.Id is "CS0104" or "CS0433"))status="ambiguous";
+            else if(candidateReason==CandidateReason.Inaccessible||diagnostics.Any(d=>d.Id=="CS0122"))status="inaccessible";
+            else if(symbol==null||symbol is IErrorTypeSymbol)status="unresolved";
+            else if(diagnostics.Length>0)status="invalid_statement";
+            else if(symbol is INamespaceSymbol ns)
+            {
+                foreach(var part in Leaves(ns).OrderBy(PartKey,StringComparer.Ordinal))
+                {
+                    var declaration=part;string mapping="native constituent syntax references";
+                    var refs=part.DeclaringSyntaxReferences;
+                    var origin=await OriginAsync(model.Compilation,part.ContainingAssembly);
+                    var sourceCompilation=origin.Compilation;
+                    if(refs.IsDefaultOrEmpty&&sourceCompilation!=null)
+                    {
+                        // OriginAsync requires a native reference/source identity
+                        // mapping. It never selects a project by simple name.
+                        declaration=WithinAssembly(sourceCompilation.Assembly,part);
+                        refs=declaration?.DeclaringSyntaxReferences??System.Collections.Immutable.ImmutableArray<SyntaxReference>.Empty;
+                        mapping=origin.Method+"; exact namespace within that source assembly";
+                    }
+                    // A source-project candidate without a native compilation
+                    // reference is UNKNOWN, never reverse-mapped by spelling.
+                    bool isSource=!refs.IsDefaultOrEmpty||sourceCompilation!=null||origin.Unknown||part.Locations.Any(location=>location.IsInSource);
+                    bool isUnknown=isSource&&refs.IsDefaultOrEmpty;
+                    source|=isSource;metadata|=!isSource;unknown|=isUnknown;
+                    var locations=Locations(refs,targets);
+                    contributions.Add(new {native_namespace=Describe(part),source_project=sourceCompilation==null?null:origin.Project?.FilePath,mapping,
+                        native_preferred_source_project=origin.Project?.FilePath,
+                        source_identity_method=origin.Method,source_identity_candidates=origin.Candidates,
+                        origin_assembly=declaration?.ContainingAssembly?.Identity.ToString(),
+                        status=isUnknown?"source_mapping_unknown":isSource?"source":"metadata-only",
+                        declarations=locations});
+                }
+                status=unknown?"native_mapping_unknown":source&&metadata?"mixed_source_metadata":source?"source":"external_metadata";
+            }
+            else if(symbol is INamedTypeSymbol named)
+            {
+                var original=named.OriginalDefinition;var refs=original.DeclaringSyntaxReferences;
+                string mapping="native original type syntax references";
+                var origin=await OriginAsync(model.Compilation,named.ContainingAssembly);
+                var sourceCompilation=origin.Compilation;
+                ISymbol sourceLookup=null;
+                if(refs.IsDefaultOrEmpty&&sourceCompilation!=null)
+                {
+                    var found=await SymbolFinder.FindSourceDefinitionAsync(original,solution);
+                    sourceLookup=found;
+                    if(found is INamedTypeSymbol foundType&&
+                        foundType.ContainingAssembly.Identity.Equals(named.ContainingAssembly.Identity)&&
+                        foundType.OriginalDefinition.GetDocumentationCommentId()==named.OriginalDefinition.GetDocumentationCommentId()&&
+                        foundType.DeclaringSyntaxReferences.All(reference=>sourceCompilation.SyntaxTrees.Contains(reference.SyntaxTree)))
+                    {original=foundType.OriginalDefinition;refs=original.DeclaringSyntaxReferences;mapping=origin.Method+"; SymbolFinder.FindSourceDefinitionAsync with native identity/tree checks";}
+                }
+                source=!refs.IsDefaultOrEmpty;
+                unknown=!source&&(sourceCompilation!=null||origin.Unknown);
+                metadata=!source&&!unknown;
+                contributions.Add(new {native_type=Describe(named),native_source_type=Describe(original),mapping,
+                    source_lookup=Describe(sourceLookup),source_project=sourceCompilation==null?null:origin.Project?.FilePath,
+                    native_preferred_source_project=origin.Project?.FilePath,
+                    source_identity_method=origin.Method,source_identity_candidates=origin.Candidates,
+                    status=unknown?"source_mapping_unknown":source?"source":"metadata-only",declarations=Locations(refs,targets)});
+                status=unknown?"native_mapping_unknown":source?"source":"external_metadata";
+            }
+            else status="unsupported_bound_symbol";
+            var selected=targets.Where(target=>target.StartsWith(prefix,StringComparison.Ordinal)).ToArray();
+            var measured=selected.Where(target=>target!=path).ToArray();
+            Usings.Add(new {project=project.FilePath,assembly=model.Compilation.Assembly.Identity.ToString(),path,
+                span=Span(syntax.SyntaxTree,directive.Span),name_span=name==null?null:Span(syntax.SyntaxTree,name.Span),
+                written_name=name?.ToString(),alias=directive.Alias?.Name.Identifier.ValueText,
+                is_static=directive.StaticKeyword.IsKind(SyntaxKind.StaticKeyword),is_global=directive.GlobalKeyword.IsKind(SyntaxKind.GlobalKeyword),
+                scope=directive.GlobalKeyword.IsKind(SyntaxKind.GlobalKeyword)?"compilation":directive.Parent is CompilationUnitSyntax?"file":"namespace",
+                scope_span=Span(syntax.SyntaxTree,directive.Parent.Span),
+                scope_symbol=directive.Parent is BaseNamespaceDeclarationSyntax scopeNamespace?Describe(model.GetDeclaredSymbol(scopeNamespace)):null,
+                status,bound_symbol=Describe(symbol),candidate_reason=candidateReason.ToString(),candidates=candidates.Select(Describe).ToArray(),
+                errors=diagnostics.Select(d=>new {id=d.Id,message=d.GetMessage(),span=d.Location.IsInSource?Span(d.Location.SourceTree,d.Location.SourceSpan):null}).ToArray(),
+                contributions,all_source_target_paths=targets.ToArray(),selected_target_paths=selected,measured_cross_file_target_paths=measured,
+                target_scope=measured.Length>0?"has_measured_cross_file_targets":selected.Length>0?"selected_self_only":targets.Count>0?"outside_emission_selection":"no_source_target",
+                source_contribution_mapping_complete=!unknown&&(status is "source" or "mixed_source_metadata" or "external_metadata"),
+                dependency_semantics="None: unused using succeeds without establishing an actual-use file edge"});
+        }
+    }
+
+    object[] Locations(System.Collections.Immutable.ImmutableArray<SyntaxReference> refs,SortedSet<string> targets)
+    {
+        if(refs.IsDefaultOrEmpty)return Array.Empty<object>();
+        return refs.OrderBy(reference=>reference.SyntaxTree.FilePath,StringComparer.Ordinal).ThenBy(reference=>reference.Span.Start).Select(reference=>{
+            string file=reference.SyntaxTree.FilePath;Track(file);string path=Relative(file);
+            // Missing/generated paths remain raw evidence, never measured targets.
+            if(File.Exists(file)&&path!=null)targets.Add(path);
+            return (object)new {path,span=Span(reference.SyntaxTree,reference.Span),
+                physical_file=File.Exists(file),selected=Selected(file),
+                native_text_sha256=Hash(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(reference.SyntaxTree.GetText().ToString())),
+                physical_sha256=File.Exists(file)?inputs[Path.GetFullPath(file)]:null};
+        }).ToArray();
+    }
+
+    static IEnumerable<INamespaceSymbol> Leaves(INamespaceSymbol ns)
+    {
+        var parts=ns.ConstituentNamespaces;
+        if(parts.Length==1&&SymbolEqualityComparer.Default.Equals(parts[0],ns)){yield return ns;yield break;}
+        foreach(var part in parts)foreach(var leaf in Leaves(part))yield return leaf;
+    }
+    static string PartKey(INamespaceSymbol ns)=>ns.ContainingAssembly?.Identity+"|"+ns.ContainingModule?.Name+"|"+ns.ToDisplayString();
+    async Task<Origin> OriginAsync(Compilation context,IAssemblySymbol assembly)
+    {
+        if(assembly==null)return new(null,null,"no containing assembly",Array.Empty<object>(),false);
+        if(SymbolEqualityComparer.Default.Equals(assembly,context.Assembly))
+            return new(context,solution.GetProject(context.Assembly),"native current compilation assembly",Array.Empty<object>(),false);
+        if(context.GetMetadataReference(assembly) is CompilationReference reference)
+            return new(reference.Compilation,solution.GetProject(reference.Compilation.Assembly),
+                "Compilation.GetMetadataReference -> CompilationReference.Compilation",Array.Empty<object>(),false);
+        // PE-to-selected-source association is unsupported in this producer.
+        // Native preference and exact AssemblyIdentity candidates are diagnostic
+        // facts only: they never admit source targets or namespace membership.
+        var preferred=solution.GetProject(assembly);
+        sourceProjects??=LoadSourceProjectsAsync();
+        var matches=(await sourceProjects).Where(entry=>entry.Compilation.Assembly.Identity.Equals(assembly.Identity)).ToArray();
+        var candidates=matches.Select(entry=>(object)new {path=entry.Project.FilePath,
+            assembly=entry.Compilation.Assembly.Identity.ToString(),native_preferred=entry.Project.Id==preferred?.Id}).ToArray();
+        if(matches.Length==0)
+            return new(null,preferred,"metadata; no exact source AssemblyIdentity match",candidates,false);
+        return new(null,preferred,
+            "UNSUPPORTED: PE-to-selected-source association; native preference and exact AssemblyIdentity candidates are diagnostics only",
+            candidates,true);
+    }
+    async Task<List<(Project Project,Compilation Compilation)>> LoadSourceProjectsAsync()
+    {
+        var result=new List<(Project,Compilation)>();
+        foreach(var project in solution.Projects.Where(project=>project.Language==LanguageNames.CSharp).OrderBy(project=>project.FilePath,StringComparer.Ordinal))
+        {
+            var compilation=await project.GetCompilationAsync();
+            if(compilation!=null)result.Add((project,compilation));
+        }
+        return result;
+    }
+    static INamespaceSymbol WithinAssembly(IAssemblySymbol assembly,INamespaceSymbol target)
+    {
+        var names=new Stack<string>();for(var ns=target;!ns.IsGlobalNamespace;ns=ns.ContainingNamespace)names.Push(ns.Name);
+        var found=assembly.GlobalNamespace;
+        foreach(string name in names)
+        {
+            var next=found.GetNamespaceMembers().Where(member=>member.Name==name).ToArray();
+            if(next.Length!=1)return null;found=next[0];
+        }
+        return found;
+    }
+    static object Describe(ISymbol symbol)=>symbol==null?null:new {
+        kind=symbol.Kind.ToString(),display=symbol.ToDisplayString(SymbolDisplayFormat.FullyQualifiedFormat),
+        assembly=symbol.ContainingAssembly?.Identity.ToString()??(symbol as IAssemblySymbol)?.Identity.ToString(),
+        module=symbol.ContainingModule?.Name,documentation_id=symbol.GetDocumentationCommentId(),
+        namespace_kind=(symbol as INamespaceSymbol)?.NamespaceKind.ToString(),implicit_declaration=symbol.IsImplicitlyDeclared};
+    static object Span(SyntaxTree tree,TextSpan span)
+    {
+        var lines=tree.GetLineSpan(span);return new {start_line=lines.StartLinePosition.Line+1,start_character=lines.StartLinePosition.Character,
+            end_line=lines.EndLinePosition.Line+1,end_character=lines.EndLinePosition.Character,start_offset=span.Start,length=span.Length};
+    }
+    string Relative(string path)=>string.IsNullOrEmpty(path)?null:Path.GetRelativePath(root,Path.GetFullPath(path)).Replace('\\','/');
+    bool Selected(string path)=>!string.IsNullOrEmpty(path)&&Relative(path).StartsWith(prefix,StringComparison.Ordinal);
+    static string Hash(byte[] bytes)=>Convert.ToHexString(SHA256.HashData(bytes)).ToLowerInvariant();
+}

+## Opt-in native project declaration evidence
+
+`project-declarations <repository-root> <actual.sln|slnx|csproj>
+<repository-relative-source-directory> [owned-intermediate-root]` loads the subject's actual MSBuild
+selection and writes `fathom.roslyn.project-declarations/v1`. Existing syntax and
+`calls` modes and their output schemas are unchanged. This evidence shape is
+deliberately separate from the legacy neutral tool-oracle input; no scorer
+consumes it and it reports no grade.
+
+The new evidence distinguishes the identifier's span from each declarator's
+definition, the full declaration statement, and trivia-inclusive full span.
+Every variable in a multi-field/event statement has its own location. Native
+semantic kind, namespace, containing symbol, assembly, documentation ID, and
+all partial declaration locations remain separate fields. Unresolved symbols,
+workspace failures and compilation errors are retained; errors exit nonzero.
+Positions use one-based lines and zero-based UTF-16 columns, half-open spans.
+
+Signatures retain both the raw native header and a candidate normalized under
+the existing `tsSignature` contract: start to captured body, or only the first
+line when no body exists; whitespace collapsed; at most 200 Unicode scalars
+(199 plus ellipsis when truncated). The surprising first-line rule is not
+silently improved. Conditional source differences stay unjudged. Native kinds
+outside the product's current signature contract are emitted and flagged,
+not silently removed.
+
+The source directory selects emitted declarations. It does not prevent
+MSBuildWorkspace from loading project/dependency files, run a sandbox, or
+guarantee offline operation. Use only explicitly selected trusted projects and
+locally provisioned dependencies. The command performs no explicit restore or
+download. Active project defines are recorded; this is not exhaustive mixed
+preprocessor coverage, whole-repository completeness, player execution or
+serialized-scene proof. The optional owned intermediate root redirects per-project design-time artifacts
+through a hash-recorded output-only MSBuild props import, preserving original
+project files. Each selected source hash and decoded text is checked
+against the loaded native tree; the project/solution input hash is checked
+before and after, but the filesystem is not an atomic snapshot.
+
+Native regressions in `testdata/declarations` cover distinct field and
+event locations; attributes; expression/bodiless signatures; escaped, Unicode
+and UTF-16 positions; long signatures; partial/generic containers; active
+defines; raw operators/destructors/indexers/delegates/records; and explicit
+syntax/semantic errors. `*.cs.input` fixtures are not compiled into RoslynDump.
+After the native output exists, `verify.py valid|error <output.json>` asserts
+the real evidence. Fixture labels are source regression expectations, never
+an independent language-grade oracle. Actual execution receipts must name their exact source/binary and fixture
+outputs; fixture expectations alone do not establish a pass.
+
+## Project imports and diagnostic-order migration
+
+`project-imports <repository-root> <actual.sln|slnx|csproj>
+<repository-relative-source-directory> [owned-intermediate-root]` reuses the
+native project-declarations workspace and emits raw
+`fathom.roslyn.project-imports/v1` facts. It records active using syntax, native
+symbol/reference identity and complete namespace contribution declarations.
+Current-compilation and actual CompilationReference sources can supply
+declarations. Source, metadata, mixed, unresolved and unsupported cases remain
+explicit; there is no namespace union or source association by textual name.
+
+A PE reference with a possible selected-source match remains
+UNSUPPORTED/UNKNOWN with zero source targets. Native preference and assembly
+identity candidates are diagnostic only. The raw export is neither a closed
+neutral scorer payload nor actual-use file dependency truth. An independently
+reviewed adapter/closed cohort is required before an import-statement reading;
+namespace contribution membership cannot replace file-use edges or a missing
+metric denominator. `-imports-from tool` in lang-oracle only selects its neutral
+import family beside SCIP and does not directly consume this raw export or
+qualify a language grade.
+
+Both native project modes preserve every rendered error diagnostic in ordinal
+string order per project. This changes the old error-array byte ordering while
+leaving its schema, messages and counts intact. Strict-byte consumers must pin
+new error output under this explicit contract. Preserve historical raw outputs;
+do not normalize their order to make old/new bytes appear equal. Valid-output
+identity and new/new deterministic error output are separate controls from
+old/new error-output identity.
+
+The emission selector does not prevent dependency reads or create an OS/offline
+sandbox. Use trusted native projects and pre-provisioned local dependencies,
+recording exact source/reference/compiler closure and all errors. Generic
+controls in `testdata/imports` cover current/referenced sources, partial and
+parent namespaces, aliases/static/global/mixed and unused imports, scope,
+inaccessible/unresolved/ambiguous cases and wrong/duplicate identities. The
+original metadata-source positive remains unqualified. `verify_forward.py`
+checks the distinct explicit unsupported-PE negative and new/new error-order
+contract; it does not waive that historical positive or claim all native cases,
+current-project evidence, default adoption or an overall support grade.

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Verify actual native exporter output; never manufactures oracle answers.
+
+Usage: verify.py valid|error output.json
+These source regression checks are unexecuted until the native exporter runs.
+They are not a language-grade scorer.
+"""
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import sys
+
+
+def verify(mode, output):
+    fixture = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+    expected = json.loads((fixture / "expected.json").read_text())
+    data = json.loads(Path(output).read_text())
+    assert data["schema"] == expected["schema"]
+    assert not data["workspace_failures"], data["workspace_failures"]
+    rows = data["declarations"]
+    assert rows, "No native declaration rows"
+    for file in data["files"]:
+        source = Path(data["repository_root"]) / file["path"]
+        assert file["source_sha256"] == hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+    if mode == "error":
+        diagnostics = "\n".join(error["message"] for error in data["compile_errors"])
+        for code in expected["expected_error_diagnostics"]:
+            assert code in diagnostics, (code, diagnostics)
+        assert any(row["name_value"] == "Invalid" for row in rows)
+        print("PASS native error rows and explicit compilation diagnostics (not a grade)")
+        return
+    assert mode == "valid"
+    assert not data["compile_errors"], data["compile_errors"]
+    assert len(data["files"]) == 2, data["files"]
+    main = [row for row in rows if row["path"].endswith("/Declarations.cs.input")]
+
+    def named(name):
+        hits = [row for row in main if row["name_text"] == name]
+        assert len(hits) == 1, (name, len(hits))
+        return hits[0]
+
+    # Later declarators retain their own name and definition position while
+    # preserving the larger shared statement as independently exposed evidence.
+    for name in ("first", "second", "third", "Ready", "Finished"):
+        row = named(name)
+        assert row["name_span"]["start_line"] == expected["name_lines"][name], row
+        assert row["definition_span"]["start_line"] == expected["name_lines"][name], row
+    assert named("second")["statement_span"]["start_line"] == 6
+    assert named("second")["statement_span"]["end_line"] == 7
+    assert named("Finished")["statement_span"]["start_line"] == 8
+    assert named("Finished")["semantic_kind"] == "Event"
+    assert named("@event")["name_value"] == "event"
+    assert named("café")["name_value"] == "café"
+    assert named("unicodeAfterEmoji")["name_span"]["start_column_utf16"] == expected["unicode_identifier_column_utf16"]
+    assert named("this")["raw_kind"] == "indexer"
+    assert named("Compute")["signature_normalized_candidate"] == expected["expression_signature"]
+    assert named("Compute")["name_span"]["start_line"] == expected["name_lines"]["Compute"]
+    assert named("Compute")["definition_span"]["start_line"] == expected["name_lines"]["Compute"] - 1
+    bodyless = named("Bodyless")
+    assert bodyless["signature_normalized_candidate"] == expected["bodiless_signature"]
+    assert "void Bodyless(int value)" in bodyless["raw_header"]
+    assert bodyless["name_span"]["start_line"] == expected["name_lines"]["Bodyless"]
+    long_method = named(expected["long_method_name"])
+    signature = long_method["signature_normalized_candidate"]
+    assert len(signature) == 200 and signature.endswith("…"), signature
+    assert expected["expected_active"] in {row["name_text"] for row in main}
+    assert expected["expected_absent"] not in {row["name_text"] for row in main}
+    assert "FIXTURE_ACTIVE" in next(file for file in data["files"] if file["path"].endswith("/Declarations.cs.input"))["preprocessor_symbols"]
+    types = [row for row in rows if row["name_text"] == "Host" and row["raw_kind"] == "class"]
+    assert len(types) == 2
+    assert len({row["documentation_id"] for row in types}) == 1
+    assert all(row["metadata_name"] == "Host`1" and len(row["declaring_syntax_references"]) == 2 for row in types)
+    assert all(row["containing_namespace"] == "Fixture.Outer" for row in types)
+    assert any(row["raw_kind"] == "operator" and row["method_kind"] == "UserDefinedOperator" for row in rows)
+    assert any(row["raw_kind"] == "conversionOperator" and row["method_kind"] == "Conversion" for row in rows)
+    assert any(row["raw_kind"] == "destructor" and row["method_kind"] == "Destructor" for row in rows)
+    assert {"record", "recordStruct", "delegate", "enum", "enumMember", "struct"} <= {row["raw_kind"] for row in rows}
+    assert all(not row["signature_contract_applies"] for row in rows if row["raw_kind"] in expected["unsupported_for_product_signature"])
+    assert all(row["binding_status"] == "resolved" for row in rows)
+    print("PASS native spans, containment, partial identity, signature contract, active configuration and raw-kind regressions (not a grade)")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
+        raise SystemExit(__doc__)
+    verify(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2])

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Future native controls; no stubs or Fathom answers construct expected truth.
+
+materialize NEW_ROOT writes only this fixture's static files into a new directory.
+MODE RAW_JSON ROOT checks output from the actual Roslyn DLL, run separately
+under an owned compiler window. This verifier never launches a compiler/restore.
+Positive/negative native exits must also be recorded by the external runner.
+"""
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import sys
+
+FIXTURE = Path(__file__).with_name("fixture.json")
+
+
+def materialize(destination):
+    destination = Path(destination)
+    if destination.exists() or destination.is_symlink():
+        raise ValueError("Fixture root must be new; no overwrite")
+    data = json.loads(FIXTURE.read_text())
+    destination.mkdir(parents=True)
+    for name, text in data["files"].items():
+        parts = name.split("/")
+        if name.startswith("/") or any(p in ("", ".", "..") for p in parts):
+            raise ValueError("Noncanonical static fixture path")
+        target = destination.joinpath(*parts)
+        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        target.write_bytes(text.encode())
+    (destination / "NuGet.Config").write_text(
+        '<configuration><packageSources><clear /></packageSources>'
+        '<auditSources><clear /></auditSources></configuration>\n'
+    )
+    print(json.dumps({"materialized_files": len(data["files"]), "root": str(destination.resolve())}))
+
+
+def check(mode, output, root):
+    data = json.loads(Path(output).read_text())
+    root = Path(root).resolve()
+    assert data["schema"] == "fathom.roslyn.project-imports/v1"
+    assert Path(data["repository_root"]).resolve() == root
+    assert "file_edges" not in data and "imports" not in data
+    assert not data["workspace_failures"], data["workspace_failures"]
+    expected = json.loads(FIXTURE.read_text())["files"]
+    native_hashes = {row["path"]: row["sha256"] for row in data["native_input_hashes"]}
+    for file in data["files"]:
+        path = file["path"]
+        assert path in expected, path
+        digest = hashlib.sha256(expected[path].encode()).hexdigest()
+        assert file["source_sha256"] == digest
+        assert native_hashes[str(root / path)] == digest
+    rows = data["usings"]
+    assert len({(r["project"], r["path"], r["span"]["start_offset"]) for r in rows}) == len(rows)
+
+    def find(path, name, alias=None, static=False, global_using=False):
+        found = [r for r in rows if r["path"] == path and r["written_name"] == name
+                 and r["alias"] == alias and r["is_static"] == static and r["is_global"] == global_using]
+        assert len(found) == 1, (path, name, alias, len(found))
+        return found[0]
+
+    if mode.startswith("metadata"):
+        assert not data["compile_errors"], data["compile_errors"]
+        path = "src/MetadataConsumer/Consumer.cs.input"
+        selected = (find(path, "BoundNamespace"), find(path, "BoundNamespace.Known", alias="Alias"),
+                    find(path, "BoundNamespace.Known", static=True))
+        project = next(p for p in data["projects"] if p["name"] == "MetadataConsumer")
+        binary = root / "binary/NativeDependency.dll"
+        references = [r for r in project["native_references"] if r["path"] and Path(r["path"]).resolve() == binary]
+        assert len(references) == 1 and references[0]["reference_kind"] == "portable-executable"
+        assert project["project_references"] == [], "Do not fake source ProjectReferences for this native control"
+        assert native_hashes[str(binary)] == hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+        for row in selected:
+            if mode == "metadata":
+                assert row["status"] == "source" and row["source_contribution_mapping_complete"]
+                assert set(row["all_source_target_paths"]) == {"src/ExactSource/First.cs.input", "src/ExactSource/Second.cs.input"}
+                assert all("DifferentIdentity" not in t for t in row["all_source_target_paths"])
+            elif mode == "metadata-wrong-identity":
+                assert row["status"] == "external_metadata" and not row["all_source_target_paths"]
+                assert row["source_contribution_mapping_complete"]
+            else:
+                assert mode == "metadata-duplicate-identity"
+                assert row["status"] == "native_mapping_unknown" and not row["all_source_target_paths"]
+                assert row["source_contribution_mapping_complete"] is False
+                assert any(len(c["source_identity_candidates"]) == 2 for c in row["contributions"])
+    elif mode == "negative":
+        assert data["compile_errors"], "Native compile failures must remain failures"
+        path = "src/Error/Broken.cs.input"
+        assert find(path, "Missing.Active")["status"] == "unresolved"
+        ambiguous = find(path, "Clash.Duplicate", alias="Conflict")
+        assert ambiguous["status"] == "ambiguous"
+        assert ambiguous["errors"] and len(ambiguous["candidates"]) >= 2
+        invalid = find(path, "Shared", static=True)
+        assert invalid["status"] == "invalid_statement" and invalid["errors"]
+        inaccessible = find(path, "Shared.Hidden", alias="Hidden")
+        assert inaccessible["status"] == "inaccessible" and inaccessible["errors"]
+        for row in (ambiguous, invalid, inaccessible, find(path, "Missing.Active")):
+            assert not row["all_source_target_paths"]
+            assert row["source_contribution_mapping_complete"] is False
+    else:
+        assert not data["compile_errors"], data["compile_errors"]
+        assert all(r["source_contribution_mapping_complete"] for r in rows), rows
+        if mode == "global":
+            path = "src/Global/Global.cs.input"
+            for row in (find(path, "Shared", global_using=True),
+                        find(path, "Shared.Tools", alias="G", global_using=True)):
+                assert row["scope"] == "compilation" and row["status"] == "source"
+            projects = [p for p in data["projects"] if p["name"] == "Global"]
+            assert len(projects) == 1 and projects[0]["language_version"] == "CSharp10"
+            assert any(f["path"] == "src/Global/Other.cs.input" for f in data["files"])
+        else:
+            path = "src/Consumer/Importer.cs.input"
+            expected_shared = {
+                "src/A/OddPlace.cs.input", "src/A/SecondPartial.cs.input", "src/A/Child.cs.input",
+                "src/B/NothingLikeNamespace.cs.input", "src/Consumer/SameNamespace.cs.input",
+            }
+            wildcard = find(path, "Shared")
+            namespace_alias = find(path, "global::Shared", alias="NS")

+"""Future native forward-contract controls. Does not run a loader/compiler."""
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import re
+import sys
+
+
+def pe_unsupported(raw, root):
+    data = json.loads(Path(raw).read_bytes())
+    root = Path(root).resolve()
+    assert data['schema'] == 'fathom.roslyn.project-imports/v1'
+    assert not data['workspace_failures'] and not data['compile_errors']
+    project = next(p for p in data['projects'] if p['name'] == 'MetadataConsumer')
+    assert project['project_references'] == []  # no manufactured source reference
+    binary = root / 'binary/NativeDependency.dll'
+    refs = [r for r in project['native_references'] if r['path'] and Path(r['path']).resolve() == binary]
+    assert len(refs) == 1 and refs[0]['reference_kind'] == 'portable-executable'
+    hashes = {x['path']: x['sha256'] for x in data['native_input_hashes']}
+    assert hashes[str(binary)] == hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+    rows = [r for r in data['usings'] if r['path'] == 'src/MetadataConsumer/Consumer.cs.input']
+    assert [(r['written_name'], r['alias'], r['is_static']) for r in rows] == [
+        ('BoundNamespace', None, False), ('BoundNamespace.Known', 'Alias', False),
+        ('BoundNamespace.Known', None, True)]
+    identity = 'NativeDependency, Version=1.2.3.4, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=null'
+    for row in rows:
+        assert row['bound_symbol']['assembly'] == identity
+        assert row['status'] == 'native_mapping_unknown'
+        assert row['source_contribution_mapping_complete'] is False
+        assert row['all_source_target_paths'] == row['selected_target_paths'] == row['measured_cross_file_target_paths'] == []
+        for contribution in row['contributions']:
+            assert contribution['status'] == 'source_mapping_unknown' and contribution['declarations'] == []
+            assert contribution['source_identity_method'].startswith('UNSUPPORTED: PE-to-selected-source association;')
+            candidates = contribution['source_identity_candidates']
+            assert len(candidates) == 1 and candidates[0]['assembly'] == identity
+            assert Path(candidates[0]['path']).parent.name == 'ExactSource'
+    print('PE-to-selected-source association explicitly unsupported; all3bound rows UNKNOWN/zero targets. Not native7/7 qualification.')
+
+
+def diagnostic_repeat(left, right):
+    a = Path(left).read_bytes()
+    b = Path(right).read_bytes()
+    assert a == b, 'new/new stdout differs: strict raw bytes; no normalization or waiver'
+    data = json.loads(a)
+    assert data['schema'] == 'fathom.roslyn.project-declarations/v1'
+    assert not data['workspace_failures']
+    rows = data['compile_errors']
+    assert len(rows) == 4 and all(r['project'] == 'Error' for r in rows)
+    messages = [r['message'] for r in rows]
+    # Compare adjacent rendered strings as UTF16 code units; never sort/replace
+    # observed output. The four original fixture diagnostics must all remain.
+    assert all(x.encode('utf-16-be') <= y.encode('utf-16-be') for x, y in zip(messages, messages[1:]))
+    assert [re.search(r'error (CS\d+):', x).group(1) for x in messages] == ['CS0246', 'CS0122', 'CS0433', 'CS7007']
+    print('Strict new/new bytes equal; all4original fixture errors retained in declared ordinal order. Historical old/new RED remains.')
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    if len(sys.argv) != 4:
+        raise SystemExit('verify_forward.py pe-unsupported RAW FIXTURE_ROOT | diagnostic-repeat LEFT RIGHT')
+    if sys.argv[1] == 'pe-unsupported':
+        pe_unsupported(sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3])
+    elif sys.argv[1] == 'diagnostic-repeat':
+        diagnostic_repeat(sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3])
+    else:
+        raise SystemExit('Unknown fixed-purpose control')

+// reconcilePlanObservation compares the two evidence contracts before the
+// general parity check compares every plan count, criterion and provenance.
+func reconcilePlanObservation(verb string, fromVerb, fromPage any) error {
+	if !strings.Contains(verb, "plans status") {
+		return nil
+	}
+	cli, cok := fromVerb.([]any)
+	page, pok := fromPage.([]any)
+	if !cok || !pok || len(cli) != len(page) {
+		return fmt.Errorf("plans status shape differs")
+	}
+	for i := range cli {
+		c, cok := cli[i].(map[string]any)
+		p, pok := page[i].(map[string]any)
+		if !cok || !pok {
+			return fmt.Errorf("plans status row %d shape differs", i)
+		}
+		if p["source_scope"] != "current_worktree" || p["current_worktree_freshness"] != "unknown" {
+			return fmt.Errorf("plans status row %d console claims unsupported freshness", i)
+		}
+		if c["source_scope"] != "current_worktree" || c["current_worktree_freshness"] != "observed_window" {
+			return fmt.Errorf("plans status row %d CLI lacks closed-window observation", i)
+		}
+		delete(c, "source_scope")
+		delete(c, "current_worktree_freshness")
+		delete(p, "source_scope")
+		delete(p, "current_worktree_freshness")
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+func TestConsolePlanObservationRequiresClosedWindow(t *testing.T) {
+	cli := []any{map[string]any{"source_scope": "current_worktree", "current_worktree_freshness": "observed_window", "proven": float64(1)}}
+	page := []any{map[string]any{"source_scope": "current_worktree", "current_worktree_freshness": "unknown", "proven": float64(1)}}
+	if err := reconcilePlanObservation("fathom plans status --json", cli, page); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	cli = []any{map[string]any{"source_scope": "current_worktree", "current_worktree_freshness": "observed_window", "proven": float64(1)}}
+	page = []any{map[string]any{"source_scope": "current_worktree", "current_worktree_freshness": "observed_window", "proven": float64(1)}}
+	if err := reconcilePlanObservation("fathom plans status --json", cli, page); err == nil {
+		t.Fatal("cached console plan advertised an unobserved window")
+	}

+func writeCmdSourceReceipt(t *testing.T, root, path string) {
+	t.Helper()
+	raw, err := os.ReadFile(path)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	var index scippb.Index
+	if err := proto.Unmarshal(raw, &index); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	index.Metadata.ProjectRoot = "file://" + filepath.ToSlash(root)
+	raw, err = proto.Marshal(&index)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if err := os.WriteFile(path, raw, 0644); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	digest := func(data []byte) string { h := sha256.Sum256(data); return hex.EncodeToString(h[:]) }
+	var inputs []scip.SourceInput
+	var names []string
+	for _, doc := range index.Documents {
+		data, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, doc.RelativePath))
+		if err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+		inputs = append(inputs, scip.SourceInput{Path: doc.RelativePath, SHA256: digest(data)})
+		names = append(names, doc.RelativePath)
+	}
+	receipt := scip.SourceReceipt{Schema: scip.SourceReceiptSchema, Status: "complete", Root: root, IndexSHA256: digest(raw), Producer: scip.SourceProducer{Name: index.Metadata.ToolInfo.Name, Version: index.Metadata.ToolInfo.Version}, Inputs: inputs, Inventories: []scip.SourceInventory{{Root: ".", Pattern: "*.ts", Paths: names}}}
+	data, err := json.Marshal(receipt)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if err := os.WriteFile(path+".receipt.json", data, 0644); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+}
+func TestCmdIngest_SourceReceiptRefusalInvalidatesPriorTypedRows(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, mutation := range []string{"source edit", "source addition", "missing receipt", "index corruption"} {
+		t.Run(mutation, func(t *testing.T) {
+			root := t.TempDir()
+			writeTSFixture(t, root, true)
+			path := filepath.Join(root, "index.scip")
+			writeCmdSourceReceipt(t, root, path)
+			store := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "s.sqlite")
+			args := []string{"--service", "source-receipt", "--path", root, "--store", store, "--json"}
+			var out, diagnostics bytes.Buffer
+			if code := cmdIngest(args, &out, &diagnostics); code != 0 {
+				t.Fatalf("fresh exit=%d %s", code, diagnostics.String())
+			}
+			switch mutation {
+			case "source edit":
+				if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, "math.ts"), []byte("export const changed=1;"), 0644); err != nil {
+					t.Fatal(err)
+				}
+			case "source addition":
+				if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, "new.ts"), []byte("export const added=1;"), 0644); err != nil {
+					t.Fatal(err)
+				}
+			case "missing receipt":
+				if err := os.Remove(path + ".receipt.json"); err != nil {
+					t.Fatal(err)
+				}
+			case "index corruption":
+				if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte("broken"), 0644); err != nil {
+					t.Fatal(err)
+				}
+			}
+			out.Reset()
+			diagnostics.Reset()
+			if code := cmdIngest(args, &out, &diagnostics); code == 0 || !strings.Contains(diagnostics.String(), "receipt") {
+				t.Fatalf("stale exit=%d out=%s diagnostics=%s", code, out.String(), diagnostics.String())
+			}
+			c, err := client.NewConstantClient(client.ModeLocal, store)
+			if err != nil {
+				t.Fatal(err)
+			}
+			defer c.Close()
+			edges, err := c.TypedEdges(context.Background(), "source-receipt")
+			if err != nil {
+				t.Fatal(err)
+			}
+			for _, edge := range edges {
+				if edge.Kind == "direct" {
+					t.Fatalf("stale direct edge survived refusal: %+v", edge)
+				}
+			}
+		})
+	}
+}

+func TestPlansStatusGenerationScopeReachesVerifyPlan(t *testing.T) {
+	var mu sync.Mutex
+	var scopes []string
+	ts := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+		if r.URL.Path == "/indexed" {
+			_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`{"indexed":true}`))
+			return
+		}
+		if r.URL.Path != "/rpc" {
+			http.NotFound(w, r)
+			return
+		}
+		var req struct {
+			Method string `json:"method"`
+			Params struct {
+				Arguments struct {
+					SourceScope string `json:"source_scope"`
+				} `json:"arguments"`
+			} `json:"params"`
+		}
+		if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
+			t.Error(err)
+			return
+		}
+		if req.Method == "tools/list" {
+			_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "result": map[string]any{"tools": []any{map[string]any{"name": "verify_plan", "inputSchema": map[string]any{"type": "object", "properties": map[string]any{"service": map[string]any{"type": "string"}}}}}}})
+			return
+		}
+		mu.Lock()
+		scopes = append(scopes, req.Params.Arguments.SourceScope)
+		mu.Unlock()
+		inner := `{"service":"svc","source_scope":"ingest_generation","current_worktree_freshness":"unknown","summary":{"total":1,"unknown":1},"tasks":[{"id":"G-1","title":"one","status":"unknown","label":"spec-generation-only","criteria":[{"name":"spec_covered","status":"unknown","detail":"ingest-generation refs; current worktree freshness unknown"}]}]}`
+		_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "result": map[string]any{"content": []map[string]string{{"type": "text", "text": inner}}}})
+	}))
+	defer ts.Close()
+	plan := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "plan.md")
+	if err := os.WriteFile(plan, []byte("# Plan\n\n- [x] one {id: G-1, symbol: One, spec: [FR-1]}\n"), 0600); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	var out, errOut bytes.Buffer
+	code := run([]string{"plans", "status", "--service", "svc", "--url", ts.URL, "--plan", plan, "--source-scope", "ingest_generation", "--json"}, &out, &errOut)
+	if code != 0 {
+		t.Fatalf("status exit %d: %s", code, errOut.String())
+	}
+	mu.Lock()
+	if len(scopes) == 0 {
+		mu.Unlock()
+		t.Fatal("no verify_plan call")
+	}
+	for _, scope := range scopes {
+		if scope != "ingest_generation" {
+			mu.Unlock()
+			t.Fatalf("verify_plan scope=%q, want ingest_generation", scope)
+		}
+	}
+	mu.Unlock()
+	var rows []struct {
+		SourceScope              string `json:"source_scope"`
+		CurrentWorktreeFreshness string `json:"current_worktree_freshness"`
+		Proven                   int    `json:"proven"`
+	}
+	if err := json.Unmarshal(out.Bytes(), &rows); err != nil || len(rows) != 1 || rows[0].SourceScope != "ingest_generation" || rows[0].CurrentWorktreeFreshness != "unknown" || rows[0].Proven != 0 {
+		t.Fatalf("generation rollup=%s err=%v", out.String(), err)
+	}
+	out.Reset()
+	errOut.Reset()
+	if code := run([]string{"plans", "status", "--service", "svc", "--url", ts.URL, "--plan", plan, "--json"}, &out, &errOut); code != 0 {
+		t.Fatalf("default status exit %d: %s", code, errOut.String())
+	}
+	mu.Lock()
+	defer mu.Unlock()
+	if scopes[len(scopes)-1] != "" {
+		t.Fatalf("default sent source_scope=%q", scopes[len(scopes)-1])
+	}
+}

+	r.deferred(func() { select {} })
+	r.watchExitDeadline(code, 200*time.Millisecond)
+	r.runCleanups() // the watchdog must terminate this subprocess
+	return 99

+func TestCleanupDeadlineRecordsUncleanAndPreservesExitCode(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, code := range []int{143, 0} {
+		t.Run(strconv.Itoa(code), func(t *testing.T) {
+			ledger := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "lifecycle.jsonl")
+			ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 3*time.Second)
+			defer cancel()
+			cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, os.Args[0])
+			cmd.SysProcAttr = &syscall.SysProcAttr{Setpgid: true}
+			cmd.Env = append(os.Environ(), testHelperEnv+"=rt-cleanup-stuck",
+				"RT_CLEANUP_CODE="+strconv.Itoa(code), "RT_CLEANUP_LEDGER="+ledger)
+			out, err := cmd.CombinedOutput()
+			if code == 0 {
+				if err != nil {
+					t.Fatalf("exit %v, want 0: %s", err, out)
+				}
+			} else {
+				var exit *exec.ExitError
+				if !errors.As(err, &exit) || exit.ExitCode() != code {
+					t.Fatalf("exit %v, want %d: %s", err, code, out)
+				}
+			}
+			if err := syscall.Kill(-cmd.Process.Pid, 0); !errors.Is(err, syscall.ESRCH) {
+				t.Fatalf("owned group remains: %v", err)
+			}
+			rows := readRowsT(t, ledger)
+			if len(rows) != 2 || rows[1].Reason != tenancy.ExitUnclean || rows[1].Detail != "cleanup incomplete at exit deadline" {
+				t.Fatalf("unclean cleanup not recorded: %+v", rows)
+			}
+			if !strings.Contains(string(out), "cleanup incomplete at exit deadline") {
+				t.Fatalf("incomplete cleanup not logged: %s", out)
+			}
+		})
+	}

+func TestRequestServeExitWaitsForInflightHTTP(t *testing.T) {
+	entered, release := make(chan struct{}), make(chan struct{})
+	ln, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	defer ln.Close()
+	r := &serveRun{
+		exitRequested: make(chan struct{}), exitDone: make(chan struct{}),
+		stopRefresh:   func() {},
+		flog:          dlog.New(io.Discard, dlog.LevelDebug, time.Now),
+		deadlineTimer: func(time.Duration, func()) {},
+	}
+	r.exitCtx, r.cancelExit = context.WithCancel(context.Background())
+	r.httpSrv = &http.Server{Handler: http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
+		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
+		w.(http.Flusher).Flush()
+		close(entered)
+		<-release
+	})}
+	serveDone := make(chan struct{})
+	go func() { _ = r.httpSrv.Serve(ln); close(serveDone) }()
+	client := &http.Client{Timeout: 3 * time.Second}
+	resp, err := client.Get("http://" + ln.Addr().String())
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	defer resp.Body.Close()
+	<-entered
+	go r.requestServeExit(143, true)
+	select {
+	case <-r.exitDone:
+		t.Fatal("shutdown returned while the request was active")
+	case <-time.After(100 * time.Millisecond):
+	}
+	close(release)
+	select {
+	case <-r.exitDone:
+	case <-time.After(waitSafety):
+		t.Fatal("cooperative request did not finish during shutdown")
+	}
+	if code, ok := r.requestedExitCode(); !ok || code != 143 {
+		t.Fatalf("exit = %d, requested=%v", code, ok)
+	}
+	<-serveDone
+	_, _ = io.Copy(io.Discard, resp.Body)
+}

+func TestCompetingExitsArmDeadlineWithWinningCode(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, first := range []int{143, 130} {
+		t.Run(strconv.Itoa(first), func(t *testing.T) {
+			armed, release := make(chan struct{}), make(chan struct{})
+			var deadline func()
+			forced := -1
+			r := &serveRun{
+				exitRequested: make(chan struct{}), exitDone: make(chan struct{}),
+				stopRefresh: func() {}, httpSrv: &http.Server{},
+				flog: dlog.New(io.Discard, dlog.LevelDebug, time.Now),
+				deadlineTimer: func(_ time.Duration, f func()) {
+					deadline = f
+					close(armed)
+					<-release
+				},
+				deadlineExit: func(code int) { forced = code },
+			}
+			r.exitCtx, r.cancelExit = context.WithCancel(context.Background())
+			firstDone := make(chan struct{})
+			go func() { r.requestServeExit(first, true); close(firstDone) }()
+			<-armed // first exit holds the selection while its timer is armed
+			secondDone := make(chan struct{})
+			go func() { r.requestServeExit(273-first, true); close(secondDone) }()
+			close(release)
+			<-firstDone
+			<-secondDone
+			if got, ok := r.requestedExitCode(); !ok || got != first {
+				t.Fatalf("selected exit = %d, requested=%v, want %d", got, ok, first)
+			}
+			deadline()
+			if forced != first {
+				t.Fatalf("forced exit = %d, selected = %d", forced, first)
+			}
+		})
+	}
+}
