+func TestEnrichCUEEdgesRegistryDenialRemovesOnlyAffectedPriorRows(t *testing.T) {
+	root := cueRegistryFixture(t, map[string]string{
+		"schema/schema.cue":       "package schema\n#Name: string\n",
+		"consumer/main.cue":       "package consumer\nimport \"example.org/native/schema\"\n#Copy: schema.#Name\n",
+		"dependent/dependent.cue": "package dependent\nimport \"example.org/native/consumer\"\n#Copy: consumer.#Copy\n",
+		"stable/stable.cue":       "package stable\nimport \"example.org/native/schema\"\n#Copy: schema.#Name\n",
+	})
+	ctx := context.Background()
+	st := store.NewMemoryStore()
+	const service = "cue-refresh"
+	first, err := EnrichCUEEdges(ctx, st, service, root, nil)
+	if err != nil || first.PackagesFailed != 0 || first.EdgesDirect != 3 {
+		t.Fatalf("initial local native fixture did not establish three prior edges: report=%+v err=%v", first, err)
+	}
+	other := core.Edge{FromService: service, FromFile: "other.cs", FromSymbol: "other-source", ToSymbol: "other-target", Kind: core.EdgeDirect}
+	if err := st.PutTypedEdges(ctx, service, "scip:other", []core.Edge{other}); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	legacy := other
+	legacy.FromSymbol = "legacy-consumer-source"
+	if err := st.PutTypedEdges(ctx, service, "cue:"+filepath.Join(root, "consumer")+":consumer", []core.Edge{legacy}); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	prior, err := st.ListTypedEdgePackages(ctx, service)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	writeCUERegistryFile(t, root, "cue.mod/module.cue", "module: \"example.org/native@v0\"\nlanguage: version: \"v0.16.1\"\ndeps: \"example.org/remote@v0\": v: \"v0.0.1\"\n")
+	writeCUERegistryFile(t, root, "consumer/main.cue", "package consumer\nimport \"example.org/remote/pkg\"\n#Copy: pkg.#Name\n")
+	var loads []string
+	started := time.Now()
+	second, err := enrichCUEEdgesWithLoader(ctx, st, service, root, nil, func(args []string, cfg *load.Config) []*build.Instance {
+		loads = append(loads, args...)
+		return load.Instances(args, cfg)
+	})
+	t.Logf("native denial and selective package inspection: loads=%q duration=%s", loads, time.Since(started))
+	if len(loads) > 1+len(prior) { // at most one native retry per prior CUE identity
+		t.Fatalf("denial inspection performed unbounded/repeated loads: %q, prior=%q", loads, prior)
+	}
+	if err != nil || second.PackagesFailed != 1 || second.PackagesLoaded != 0 {
+		t.Fatalf("expected native synthetic whole-load refusal: report=%+v err=%v", second, err)
+	}
+	edges, err := st.TypedEdges(ctx, service)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	var stable, unrelated bool
+	for _, edge := range edges {
+		if edge.FromFile == "consumer/main.cue" || edge.FromFile == "dependent/dependent.cue" || edge.FromSymbol == legacy.FromSymbol {
+			t.Errorf("registry-denied package retained old typed evidence: %+v", edge)
+		}
+		stable = stable || edge.FromFile == "stable/stable.cue"
+		unrelated = unrelated || edge.FromSymbol == other.FromSymbol
+	}
+	if !stable || !unrelated {
+		t.Fatalf("refusal removed unrelated/local evidence: stable=%v unrelated=%v edges=%+v", stable, unrelated, edges)
+	}
+}

+func TestCUERegistryInspectionRefusesUnsafeIdentities(t *testing.T) {
+	root := cueRegistryFixture(t, map[string]string{"consumer/main.cue": "package consumer\n#A: string\n"})
+	outside := t.TempDir()
+	if err := os.Symlink(outside, filepath.Join(root, "escape")); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	for _, test := range []struct {
+		name, id, want string
+	}{
+		{"native", "example.org/native/consumer@v0", "example.org/native/consumer@v0"},
+		{"native-qualified", "example.org/native/consumer@v0:consumer", "example.org/native/consumer@v0:consumer"},
+		{"in-root-fallback", filepath.Join(root, "consumer") + ":consumer", "./consumer:consumer"},
+		{"outside-fallback", outside + ":consumer", ""},
+		{"symlink-fallback", filepath.Join(root, "escape") + ":consumer", ""},
+		{"file-fallback", filepath.Join(root, "consumer", "main.cue") + ":consumer", ""},
+		{"invalid-fallback-name", filepath.Join(root, "consumer") + ":bad/name", ""},
+		{"invalid-qualifier", "example.org/native/consumer:bad/name", ""},
+		{"traversal", "../outside", ""},
+	} {
+		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			got, err := cueRegistryInspectionArg(root, test.id)
+			if test.want == "" {
+				if err == nil {
+					t.Fatalf("unsafe/invalid identity was admitted: %q -> %q", test.id, got)
+				}
+			} else if err != nil || got != test.want {
+				t.Fatalf("native identity conversion = %q, %v; want %q", got, err, test.want)
+			}
+		})
+	}
+}

+func TestCUERegistryIncompleteInspectionLeavesNoCompletedPass(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, name := range []string{"list-failed", "cancelled-after-load"} {
+		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			root := cueRegistryFixture(t, map[string]string{
+				"consumer/main.cue": "package consumer\nimport \"example.org/remote/pkg\"\n#Copy: pkg.#Name\n",
+			})
+			writeCUERegistryFile(t, root, "cue.mod/module.cue", "module: \"example.org/native@v0\"\nlanguage: version: \"v0.16.1\"\ndeps: \"example.org/remote@v0\": v: \"v0.0.1\"\n")
+			ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
+			defer cancel()
+			memory := store.NewMemoryStore()
+			if err := memory.PutTypedEdges(ctx, "cue-incomplete", "cue:example.org/native/consumer@v0:consumer", []core.Edge{{FromSymbol: "residual-prior-row"}}); err != nil {
+				t.Fatal(err)
+			}
+			var st store.Store = cueRegistryListFailStore{memory}
+			if name == "cancelled-after-load" {
+				st = cueRegistryCancelListStore{memory, cancel}
+			}
+			pipeline := New(connector.NewLocalConnector(), st, Config{})
+			_, _ = pipeline.enrichCUEEdges(ctx, core.ServiceRef{ID: "cue-incomplete", Path: root}, []core.SourceRef{{Path: "consumer/main.cue"}}, nil)
+			if pipeline.CUEPassTotal() != 1 {
+				t.Fatalf("native pass did not execute: %d", pipeline.CUEPassTotal())
+			}
+			fresh := context.Background()
+			if pipeline.passStateOK(fresh, "cue-incomplete", cuePassStateKey) || !cuePassNeeded(nil, pipeline.passStateOK(fresh, "cue-incomplete", cuePassStateKey)) {
+				t.Fatal("incomplete inspection acquired a completed/partial pass stamp and would skip retry")
+			}
+			edges, err := memory.TypedEdges(fresh, "cue-incomplete")
+			if err != nil || len(edges) != 1 {
+				t.Fatalf("fixture lost its explicitly residual evidence: edges=%+v err=%v", edges, err)
+			}
+		})
+	}

+				return nil

+	})

+func TestCUENativePolicyEpochRechecksPrePolicyStores(t *testing.T) {
+	root := cueRegistryFixture(t, map[string]string{
+		"consumer/main.cue": "package consumer\n#Base: string\n#Copy: #Base\n",
+	})

+	gateIngest(t, pipeline, root)
+	if report := gateIngest(t, pipeline, root); pipeline.CUEPassTotal() != 1 || report.CUESkipped == "" {
+		t.Fatalf("same-policy unchanged tree was not gated: count=%d report=%+v", pipeline.CUEPassTotal(), report)
+	}

+		if err := st.SetTypedEdgePackageFingerprint(ctx, "gate", cuePassStateKey, oldState); err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+		want := pipeline.CUEPassTotal() + 1
+		if report := gateIngest(t, pipeline, root); pipeline.CUEPassTotal() != want || report.CUESkipped != "" {
+			t.Fatalf("pre-policy state %q skipped the new registry policy: count=%d want=%d report=%+v", oldState, pipeline.CUEPassTotal(), want, report)
+		}
+		if report := gateIngest(t, pipeline, root); pipeline.CUEPassTotal() != want || report.CUESkipped == "" {

+		}
+	}

+func cueRegistryFixture(t *testing.T, files map[string]string) string {
+	t.Helper()
+	root := t.TempDir()
+	if files == nil {
+		files = make(map[string]string)
+	}
+	files["cue.mod/module.cue"] = "module: \"example.org/native@v0\"\nlanguage: version: \"v0.16.1\"\n"
+	for name, source := range files {
+		name = filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(name))
+		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(name), 0755); err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+		if err := os.WriteFile(name, []byte(source), 0644); err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+	}
+	return root
+}
+
+// This preflight inspects the actual producer configuration before native load.
+// It is safe on the old source: nil Registry fails here without constructing the
+// default network/cache client, even when the fixture declares a remote module.
+func requireCUELocalRegistry(t *testing.T, root string, cfg *load.Config) {
+	t.Helper()
+	if cfg.Registry == nil {
+		t.Fatal("typed CUE producer left Registry nil; inline:{} does not disable the default registry")
+	}
+	if cfg.Dir != root || cfg.ModuleRoot != root {
+		t.Fatalf("typed CUE producer root is not pinned: Dir=%q ModuleRoot=%q want %q", cfg.Dir, cfg.ModuleRoot, root)
+	}
+	if cfg.Env == nil || len(cfg.Env) != 0 {
+		t.Fatalf("typed CUE producer retained ambient/registry environment: %q", cfg.Env)
+	}
+	if cfg.SkipImports {
+		t.Fatal("registry refusal must preserve native local imports and builtins")
+	}
+}

+	if err != nil || !called || report.PackagesTotal != 0 {
+		t.Fatalf("configuration probe did not reach producer loader: called=%v report=%+v err=%v", called, report, err)
+	}

+func TestEnrichCUEEdgesNativeLocalRegistryBoundary(t *testing.T) {
+	root := cueRegistryFixture(t, map[string]string{
+		"schema/schema.cue": "package schema\n#Name: \"local\"\n",
+		"consumer/main.cue": "package consumer\nimport \"example.org/native/schema\"\nimport \"strings\"\n#Copy: schema.#Name\nout: strings.ToUpper(schema.#Name)\n",
+	})
+	cache := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "must-not-create-cache")
+	t.Setenv("CUE_CACHE_DIR", cache)
+	t.Setenv("CUE_REGISTRY", "file:must-not-open-ambient-registry-config")
+	st := store.NewMemoryStore()
+	loaded := false
+	report, err := enrichCUEEdgesWithLoader(context.Background(), st, "cue-local", root, nil,
+		func(args []string, cfg *load.Config) []*build.Instance {
+			requireCUELocalRegistry(t, root, cfg)
+			instances := load.Instances(args, cfg)
+			for _, instance := range instances {
+				if instance.PkgName != "consumer" {
+					continue
+				}
+				loaded = true
+				if instance.Err != nil {
+					t.Fatalf("native consumer loading failed: %v", instance.Err)
+				}
+				value := cuecontext.New().BuildInstance(instance)
+				got, valueErr := value.LookupPath(cue.ParsePath("out")).String()
+				if valueErr != nil || got != "LOCAL" {
+					t.Fatalf("local import + builtin = %q, %v; want LOCAL", got, valueErr)
+				}
+			}
+			return instances
+		})
+	if err != nil || !loaded || report.PackagesFailed != 0 || report.PackagesLoaded != 2 {
+		t.Fatalf("native local producer failed: loaded=%v report=%+v err=%v", loaded, report, err)
+	}
+	edges, err := st.TypedEdges(context.Background(), "cue-local")
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	wantFrom := core.SymbolKey("cue-local", "consumer/consumer", "#Copy")
+	wantTo := core.SymbolKey("cue-local", "schema/schema", "#Name")
+	found := false
+	for _, edge := range edges {
+		if edge.Kind == core.EdgeDirect && edge.FromSymbol == wantFrom && edge.ToSymbol == wantTo {
+			found = true
+		}
+	}
+	if !found {
+		t.Fatalf("native local definition edge missing: %s -> %s; edges=%+v", wantFrom, wantTo, edges)
+	}
+	if _, err := os.Stat(cache); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
+		t.Fatalf("producer created configured module cache: stat=%v", err)
+	}
+}

+func TestEnrichCUEEdgesNativeRemoteRegistryRefused(t *testing.T) {

+	t.Setenv("CUE_REGISTRY", "file:must-not-open-ambient-registry-config")

+	report, err := enrichCUEEdgesWithLoader(context.Background(), st, "cue-remote", root, nil,

+			requireCUELocalRegistry(t, root, cfg)
+			instances := load.Instances(args, cfg)
+			for _, instance := range instances {
+				if instance.Err != nil {
+					failures = append(failures, instance.Err.Error())
+				}
+			}
+			return instances
+		})
+	if err != nil || report.PackagesFailed == 0 || report.PackagesLoaded != 0 || report.EdgesDirect != 0 {
+		t.Fatalf("remote package was not a counted native load refusal: report=%+v err=%v", report, err)
+	}
+	joined := strings.Join(failures, "\n")
+	if !strings.Contains(joined, cueRegistryRefusalReason) || !strings.Contains(joined, "example.org/remote") {
+		t.Fatalf("native remote refusal lost named cause/target: %q", joined)
+	}
+	edges, err := st.TypedEdges(context.Background(), "cue-remote")
+	if err != nil || len(edges) != 0 {
+		t.Fatalf("remote dependency emitted typed edges: edges=%+v err=%v", edges, err)
+	}
+	if _, err := os.Stat(cache); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
+		t.Fatalf("remote refusal created configured module cache: stat=%v", err)
+	}
+}

+Unity assembly definitions: .asmdef files previously fingerprinted as unknown now emit declared assembly names, references and explicit flags through the unity-asmdef doc dialect. Connector discovery and language reporting classify the same format. No typed, file-resolved or runtime call edges are added. The dialect bytes participate in EmbeddedDataDigest; this append-only wave record also changes the composed extractor epoch, without editing the frozen epoch history or C# grammar/calibration. Existing stores re-extract under the new fingerprint salt.

+package fusion
+
+import (
+	"context"
+
+	"github.com/geoffmilleraz/fathom/internal/connector"
+	"github.com/geoffmilleraz/fathom/internal/core"
+)
+
+// Only the concrete LocalConnector has a complete discovery-policy receipt.
+// Wrappers and other connectors may alter Discover semantics, so they ingest
+// normally but cannot publish a sealed reference projection.
+func sourcePolicyDigest(ctx context.Context, c connector.Connector, svc core.ServiceRef) string {
+	provider, ok := c.(*connector.LocalConnector)
+	if !ok {
+		return ""
+	}
+	digest, err := provider.DiscoveryPolicyDigest(ctx, svc)
+	if err != nil {
+		return ""
+	}
+	return digest
+}
+
+func sourceMembershipStable(ctx context.Context, c connector.Connector, svc core.ServiceRef, initial []core.SourceRef) bool {
+	now, err := c.Discover(ctx, svc)
+	if err != nil || len(now) != len(initial) {
+		return false
+	}
+	for i := range initial {
+		if now[i] != initial[i] {
+			return false
+		}
+	}
+	return true
+}

+func TestSourceMembershipStableRejectsConcurrentAdd(t *testing.T) {
+	root := t.TempDir()
+	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, "initial.txt"), []byte("[FIRST-1]"), 0644); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	c := connector.NewLocalConnector()
+	svc := core.ServiceRef{ID: "svc", Path: root}
+	before, err := c.Discover(context.Background(), svc)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, "arrived.txt"), []byte("[LATE-2]"), 0644); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if sourceMembershipStable(context.Background(), c, svc, before) {
+		t.Fatal("concurrent addition passed final membership check")
+	}

+func TestIngestSourceRefProjectionExactBytesAndBackfill(t *testing.T) {
+	ctx := context.Background()
+	root := t.TempDir()
+	st, err := store.NewSQLiteStore(filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "refs.sqlite"))
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	defer st.Close()
+	p := fusion.New(connector.NewLocalConnector(), st, fusion.Config{Concurrency: 2})
+	p.WithStoreStats()
+	p.WithGitHead(func(string) string { return "same-head" })
+	p.WithGitLog(func(string) string { return "" })
+	svc := core.ServiceRef{ID: "svc", Path: root}
+	old := time.Now().Add(-time.Hour)
+	write := func(name string, b []byte) {
+		t.Helper()
+		path := filepath.Join(root, name)
+		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0755); err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+		if err := os.WriteFile(path, b, 0644); err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+		if err := os.Chtimes(path, old, old); err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+	}
+	var zipped bytes.Buffer
+	gz := gzip.NewWriter(&zipped)
+	_, _ = gz.Write([]byte("[ZIP-9]"))
+	_ = gz.Close()
+	inputs := map[string][]byte{
+		"a.go":         []byte("package a\n// [A-1]\nfunc A() {}"),
+		"late/z.json":  []byte(`{"key":"[LATE-7]"}`),
+		"plain.txt":    []byte("no references"),
+		"generated.go": []byte("// Code generated; DO NOT EDIT. [GEN-3]\npackage a"),
+		"binary.bin":   append([]byte{0, 1, 2}, []byte("[BIN-4]")...),
+		"archive.gz":   zipped.Bytes(),
+	}
+	for name, b := range inputs {
+		write(name, b)
+	}
+	if _, err := p.Ingest(ctx, svc); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	check := func(wantComplete bool) {
+		t.Helper()
+		got, ok, err := st.ReadSourceRefProjection(ctx, "svc")
+		if err != nil || !ok {
+			t.Fatalf("projection ok=%v err=%v", ok, err)
+		}
+		if got.Complete != wantComplete || len(got.Rows) != len(inputs) {
+			t.Fatalf("projection %+v", got)
+		}
+		for _, row := range got.Rows {
+			want := sdd.ExtractRefs(string(inputs[row.Path]))
+			if want == nil {
+				want = []string{}
+			}
+			if !reflect.DeepEqual(row.Refs, want) {
+				t.Errorf("%s refs=%v want=%v", row.Path, row.Refs, want)
+			}
+			if row.SourceHash == "" {
+				t.Errorf("%s missing hash", row.Path)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	check(true)
+	rep, err := p.Ingest(ctx, svc)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if rep.StatSkipped == 0 {
+		t.Fatal("expected stat reuse")
+	}
+	check(true)
+	// Losing a previous seal forces reference backfill even when every stat
+	// and symbol fingerprint would otherwise be skipped.
+	if err := st.InvalidateSourceRefProjection(ctx, "svc"); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	rep, err = p.Ingest(ctx, svc)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if rep.StatSkipped != 0 {
+		t.Fatalf("backfill skipped %d files", rep.StatSkipped)
+	}
+	check(true)
+	// Same HEAD is intentionally a new generation only after another ingest.
+	write("late/z.json", []byte(`{"key":"[NEW-8]"}`))
+	inputs["late/z.json"] = []byte(`{"key":"[NEW-8]"}`)
+	oldSnapshot, ok, err := st.ReadSourceRefProjection(ctx, "svc")
+	if err != nil || !ok || oldSnapshot.Scope != store.SourceRefScopeIngestGeneration || oldSnapshot.CurrentWorktreeFreshness != "unknown" {
+		t.Fatalf("dirty same-HEAD snapshot scope: %+v ok=%v err=%v", oldSnapshot, ok, err)
+	}
+	if err := os.Remove(filepath.Join(root, "plain.txt")); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	delete(inputs, "plain.txt")
+	write("new.txt", []byte("[ADD-9]"))
+	inputs["new.txt"] = []byte("[ADD-9]")
+	if err := os.Rename(filepath.Join(root, "a.go"), filepath.Join(root, "renamed.go")); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	inputs["renamed.go"] = inputs["a.go"]
+	delete(inputs, "a.go")
+	if _, err := p.Ingest(ctx, svc); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	check(true)
+}

+		"Assets/Rules/Rules.cs":           "namespace Fixture { public class Rules {} }",
+	})
+	st := store.NewMemoryStore()
+	p := New(connector.NewLocalConnector(), st, Config{})
+	t.Cleanup(p.Close)
+	ctx := context.Background()
+	_, err := p.Ingest(ctx, core.ServiceRef{ID: "unity", Path: dir})
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	obs, err := st.QueryObservations(ctx, "unity", "")
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	var got []string
+	for _, o := range obs {
+		if !strings.HasPrefix(string(o.SourceKind), "UnityAssembly") {
+			continue
+		}
+		got = append(got, o.SourceRef+":"+o.Symbol+":"+string(o.SourceKind))
+		if o.Symbol == "Fixture.Rules" && string(o.SourceKind) == "UnityAssemblyDefinition" && o.Claim != "noEngineReferences=true" {
+			t.Fatalf("declared engine flag was lost in store: %+v", o)
+		}
+		if len(o.Calls) > 0 {
+			t.Fatalf("asmdef dependency became calls: %+v", o)
+		}
+	}
+	sort.Strings(got)
+	want := []string{"Assets/Adapters/Adapters.asmdef:Fixture.Adapters:UnityAssemblyDefinition", "Assets/Adapters/Adapters.asmdef:Fixture.Rules:UnityAssemblyReference", "Assets/Adapters/Adapters.asmdef:Missing.Assembly:UnityAssemblyReference", "Assets/Rules/Rules.asmdef:Fixture.Rules:UnityAssemblyDefinition"}
+	if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
+		t.Fatalf("declarations=%q, want %q", got, want)
+	}
+	edges, err := st.TypedEdges(ctx, "unity")
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if len(edges) != 0 {
+		t.Fatalf("declarations became typed/file call edges: %+v", edges)
+	}
+}
+
+func TestIngestUnityAsmdefInvalidatesUnknownFingerprint(t *testing.T) {
+	dir := t.TempDir()
+	src := `{"name":"Fixture.Rules","noEngineReferences":true}`
+	writeCorpus(t, dir, map[string]string{"Assets/Rules.asmdef": src})
+	st := store.NewMemoryStore()
+	ctx := context.Background()
+	old := sha256.Sum256(append([]byte(src), []byte("\x00fathom-extractor-epoch:64")...))
+	if err := st.SetFingerprint(ctx, "unity", "Assets/Rules.asmdef", hex.EncodeToString(old[:])); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	p := New(connector.NewLocalConnector(), st, Config{})
+	t.Cleanup(p.Close)
+	_, err := p.Ingest(ctx, core.ServiceRef{ID: "unity", Path: dir})
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	obs, err := st.QueryObservations(ctx, "unity", "")
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	found := false
+	for _, o := range obs {
+		found = found || (o.Symbol == "Fixture.Rules" && string(o.SourceKind) == "UnityAssemblyDefinition")
+	}
+	if !found {
+		t.Fatal("previously unclassified asmdef fingerprint prevented new assembly extraction")
+	}
+}

+package langbench
+
+// Unity assembly calibration compares declarations to an independently retained
+// Editor receipt. It neither compiles C# nor invents typed/runtime call edges.
+
+import (
+	"bytes"
+	"crypto/sha256"
+	"encoding/hex"
+	"encoding/json"
+	"fmt"
+	"io"
+	"io/fs"
+	"path"
+	"reflect"
+	"sort"
+	"strings"
+
+	"github.com/geoffmilleraz/fathom/internal/extractor"
+)
+
+const unityAssemblyOracle = "UnityEditor.Compilation.CompilationPipeline.GetAssemblies"
+
+type UnityAssemblyOracle struct {
+	SchemaVersion          int             `json:"schemaVersion"`
+	Oracle                 string          `json:"oracle"`
+	UnityVersion           string          `json:"unityVersion"`
+	BuildTarget            string          `json:"buildTarget"`
+	AssembliesType         string          `json:"assembliesType"`
+	Scope                  string          `json:"scope"`
+	AvailableAssemblyNames []string        `json:"availableAssemblyNames"`
+	Assemblies             []UnityAssembly `json:"assemblies"`
+}
+
+type UnityAssembly struct {
+	Name                          string            `json:"name"`
+	AsmdefPath                    string            `json:"asmdefPath"`
+	Flags                         string            `json:"flags"`
+	OutputPath                    string            `json:"outputPath"`
+	DefinitionSHA256              string            `json:"definitionSha256"`
+	NoEngineReferencesDeclared    bool              `json:"noEngineReferencesDeclared"`
+	OverrideReferencesDeclared    bool              `json:"overrideReferencesDeclared"`
+	PrecompiledReferencesDeclared []string          `json:"precompiledReferencesDeclared"`
+	DeclaredReferences            []string          `json:"declaredReferences"`
+	AssemblyReferences            []string          `json:"assemblyReferences"`
+	EmittedReferencesAvailable    bool              `json:"emittedReferencesAvailable"`
+	EmittedAssemblyReferences     []string          `json:"emittedAssemblyReferences"`
+	CompiledAssemblyReferences    []string          `json:"compiledAssemblyReferences"`
+	SourceFiles                   []string          `json:"sourceFiles"`
+	SourceFacts                   []UnitySourceFact `json:"sourceFacts"`
+}
+
+type UnitySourceFact struct {
+	Path   string `json:"path"`
+	Owner  string `json:"owner"`
+	SHA256 string `json:"sha256"`
+}
+type UnityAsmdefProblem struct {
+	Assembly string `json:"assembly"`
+	Path     string `json:"path"`
+	Kind     string `json:"kind"`
+	Detail   string `json:"detail"`
+}
+type UnityAsmdefReading struct {
+	SchemaVersion          int                  `json:"schema_version"`
+	Evidence               string               `json:"evidence"`
+	NoEnginePolicy         string               `json:"no_engine_policy"`
+	OracleSHA256           string               `json:"oracle_sha256"`
+	UnityVersion           string               `json:"unity_version"`
+	BuildTarget            string               `json:"build_target"`
+	AssembliesType         string               `json:"assemblies_type"`
+	Passed                 bool                 `json:"passed"`
+	Complete               bool                 `json:"complete"`
+	Assemblies             int                  `json:"assemblies"`
+	DefinitionMatches      int                  `json:"definition_matches"`
+	SourceFiles            int                  `json:"source_files"`
+	OwnerMatches           int                  `json:"owner_matches"`
+	NamedReferences        int                  `json:"named_references"`
+	ReferenceMatches       int                  `json:"reference_matches"`
+	NoEngineAssertions     int                  `json:"no_engine_assertions"`
+	NoEngineMatches        int                  `json:"no_engine_matches"`
+	EmittedReferenceChecks int                  `json:"emitted_reference_checks"`
+	EmittedNoUnityMatches  int                  `json:"emitted_no_unity_matches"`
+	Notices                []UnityAsmdefProblem `json:"notices"`
+	Problems               []UnityAsmdefProblem `json:"problems"`
+	Unjudged               []UnityAsmdefProblem `json:"unjudged"`
+}
+
+type unityDefinition struct {
+	name        string
+	refs        []string
+	noEngine    bool
+	override    bool
+	precompiled []string
+}
+
+// CalibrateUnityAsmdefs reads only Assets assembly declarations and the exact
+// source files named by a receipt. All receipt paths must be valid relative FS
+// paths. The caller supplies a snapshot FS, with no symlinks outside its root.
+// A successful comparison is compiler calibration of this receipt's observed
+// assembly configuration, not a language support grade or a call-graph oracle.
+func CalibrateUnityAsmdefs(files fs.FS, raw []byte) (UnityAsmdefReading, error) {
+	var oracle UnityAssemblyOracle
+	dec := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(raw))
+	dec.DisallowUnknownFields()
+	if err := dec.Decode(&oracle); err != nil {
+		return UnityAsmdefReading{}, fmt.Errorf("Unity assembly receipt: %w", err)
+	}
+	var trailing any
+	if err := dec.Decode(&trailing); err != io.EOF {
+		return UnityAsmdefReading{}, fmt.Errorf("Unity assembly receipt: trailing JSON data")
+	}
+	if oracle.SchemaVersion != 1 || oracle.Oracle != unityAssemblyOracle || oracle.UnityVersion == "" || oracle.BuildTarget == "" || (oracle.AssembliesType != "Editor" && oracle.AssembliesType != "Player") || len(oracle.Assemblies) == 0 {
+		return UnityAsmdefReading{}, fmt.Errorf("Unity assembly receipt: unsupported or incomplete header")
+	}
+	r := UnityAsmdefReading{SchemaVersion: 1, Evidence: "declared-assembly-facts; compiler-calibrated; no typed or runtime call edges", NoEnginePolicy: "compiler core: no UnityEngine* or exact UnityEditor/UnityEditor.CoreModule; other available Unity SDK/plugin names disclosed; emitted metadata: no Unity* dependencies when observed",
+		OracleSHA256: unityHash(raw), UnityVersion: oracle.UnityVersion, BuildTarget: oracle.BuildTarget, AssembliesType: oracle.AssembliesType, Problems: []UnityAsmdefProblem{}, Unjudged: []UnityAsmdefProblem{}, Notices: []UnityAsmdefProblem{}}
+	problem := func(a, p, k, d string) { r.Problems = append(r.Problems, UnityAsmdefProblem{a, p, k, d}) }
+	unjudged := func(a, p, k, d string) { r.Unjudged = append(r.Unjudged, UnityAsmdefProblem{a, p, k, d}) }
+	x, err := extractor.NewDocDialectExtractor("unity-asmdef")
+	if err != nil {
+		return r, err
+	}
+	defs := map[string]unityDefinition{}
+	dirs := map[string][]string{}
+	asmrefs := map[string]bool{}
+	err = fs.WalkDir(files, "Assets", func(p string, d fs.DirEntry, walkErr error) error {
+		if walkErr != nil {
+			return walkErr
+		}
+		if d.Type()&fs.ModeSymlink != 0 {
+			return fmt.Errorf("Unity calibration refuses symlink %q", p)
+		}
+		if d.IsDir() {
+			return nil
+		}
+		if path.Ext(p) == ".asmref" {
+			asmrefs[path.Dir(p)] = true
+			return nil
+		}
+		if path.Ext(p) != ".asmdef" {
+			return nil
+		}
+		b, err := fs.ReadFile(files, p)
+		if err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		result, err := x.ExtractDoc("unity-calibration", p, b)
+		if err != nil {
+			return fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", p, err)
+		}
+		def := unityDefinition{}
+		for _, n := range result.Nodes {
+			if string(n.Kind) == "UnityAssemblyDefinition" {
+				if def.name != "" {
+					return fmt.Errorf("%s: multiple definitions", p)
+				}
+				def.name = n.Name
+			}
+		}
+		if def.name == "" {
+			return fmt.Errorf("%s: no named assembly definition", p)
+		}
+		for _, f := range result.Facts {
+			switch f.Key {
+			case "reference":
+				def.refs = append(def.refs, f.Value)
+			case "noEngineReferences":
+				def.noEngine = f.Value == "true"
+			case "overrideReferences":
+				def.override = f.Value == "true"
+			case "precompiledReference":
+				def.precompiled = append(def.precompiled, f.Value)
+			}
+		}
+		defs[p] = def
+		dirs[path.Dir(p)] = append(dirs[path.Dir(p)], p)
+		return nil
+	})
+	if err != nil {
+		return r, fmt.Errorf("Unity project snapshot: %w", err)
+	}
+	available := unitySet(oracle.AvailableAssemblyNames)
+	seenAssemblies := map[string]bool{}
+	for _, a := range oracle.Assemblies {
+		r.Assemblies++
+		if seenAssemblies[a.Name] {
+			problem(a.Name, a.AsmdefPath, "duplicate-assembly", "oracle repeats an assembly")
+			continue
+		}
+		seenAssemblies[a.Name] = true
+		if !unityPath(a.AsmdefPath) || path.Ext(a.AsmdefPath) != ".asmdef" {
+			problem(a.Name, a.AsmdefPath, "invalid-definition-path", "expected a project-relative Assets .asmdef path")
+			continue
+		}
+		b, readErr := fs.ReadFile(files, a.AsmdefPath)
+		def, found := defs[a.AsmdefPath]
+		if readErr != nil || !found {
+			problem(a.Name, a.AsmdefPath, "definition-unreadable", "definition is missing from snapshot")
+			continue
+		}
+		if a.DefinitionSHA256 == "" || unityHash(b) != a.DefinitionSHA256 {
+			problem(a.Name, a.AsmdefPath, "definition-digest-mismatch", "receipt does not bind current declaration")
+			continue
+		}
+		if def.name != a.Name {
+			problem(a.Name, a.AsmdefPath, "assembly-name-mismatch", def.name)
+			continue
+		}
+		r.DefinitionMatches++
+		if !reflect.DeepEqual(unitySorted(def.refs), unitySorted(a.DeclaredReferences)) {
+			problem(a.Name, a.AsmdefPath, "declaration-reference-mismatch", "extracted declarations differ from receipt")
+		}
+		if def.noEngine != a.NoEngineReferencesDeclared {
+			problem(a.Name, a.AsmdefPath, "no-engine-declaration-mismatch", "extracted declaration differs from receipt")
+		}
+		if def.override != a.OverrideReferencesDeclared {
+			problem(a.Name, a.AsmdefPath, "override-declaration-mismatch", "extracted declaration differs from receipt")
+		}
+		if !reflect.DeepEqual(unitySorted(def.precompiled), unitySorted(a.PrecompiledReferencesDeclared)) {
+			problem(a.Name, a.AsmdefPath, "precompiled-declaration-mismatch", "extracted declaration differs from receipt")
+		}
+		compiled := unitySet(a.AssemblyReferences)
+		for _, ref := range def.refs {
+			if strings.HasPrefix(ref, "GUID:") {
+				unjudged(a.Name, a.AsmdefPath, "guid-reference", ref)
+				continue
+			}
+			r.NamedReferences++
+			if !available[ref] {
+				problem(a.Name, a.AsmdefPath, "reference-not-available", ref)
+			} else if !compiled[ref] {
+				problem(a.Name, a.AsmdefPath, "reference-not-compiled", ref)
+			} else {
+				r.ReferenceMatches++
+			}
+		}
+		if def.noEngine {
+			r.NoEngineAssertions++
+			if a.CompiledAssemblyReferences == nil {
+				problem(a.Name, a.AsmdefPath, "compiled-references-missing", "engine-free check requires an observed compiled reference list")
+				continue
+			}
+			engine := false
+			for _, ref := range a.CompiledAssemblyReferences {
+				base := strings.TrimSuffix(path.Base(strings.ReplaceAll(ref, "\\", "/")), ".dll")
+				if base == "UnityEngine" || strings.HasPrefix(base, "UnityEngine.") || base == "UnityEditor" || base == "UnityEditor.CoreModule" {
+					engine = true
+					problem(a.Name, a.AsmdefPath, "engine-reference-present", base)
+				} else if strings.HasPrefix(base, "Unity") {
+					r.Notices = append(r.Notices, UnityAsmdefProblem{a.Name, a.AsmdefPath, "other-unity-prefixed-available-reference", base + ": compiler availability is not emitted use; may be an injected SDK or plugin"})
+				}
+			}
+			if !engine {
+				r.NoEngineMatches++
+			}
+			if !a.EmittedReferencesAvailable || a.EmittedAssemblyReferences == nil {
+				unjudged(a.Name, a.AsmdefPath, "emitted-references-unavailable", "loaded assembly reference metadata was not observed")
+			} else {
+				r.EmittedReferenceChecks++
+				emittedUnity := false
+				for _, ref := range a.EmittedAssemblyReferences {
+					base := strings.TrimSuffix(path.Base(strings.ReplaceAll(ref, "\\", "/")), ".dll")
+					if strings.HasPrefix(base, "Unity") {
+						emittedUnity = true
+						problem(a.Name, a.AsmdefPath, "emitted-unity-reference", base)
+					}
+				}
+				if !emittedUnity {
+					r.EmittedNoUnityMatches++
+				}
+			}
+		}
+		facts := map[string]UnitySourceFact{}
+		for _, f := range a.SourceFacts {
+			if _, dup := facts[f.Path]; dup {
+				problem(a.Name, f.Path, "duplicate-source-fact", "receipt repeats source")
+			}
+			facts[f.Path] = f
+		}
+		sources := unitySet(a.SourceFiles)
+		for p := range facts {
+			if !sources[p] {
+				problem(a.Name, p, "unexpected-source-fact", "not in compiler sourceFiles")
+			}
+		}
+		for _, p := range unitySorted(a.SourceFiles) {
+			r.SourceFiles++
+			if !unityPath(p) || path.Ext(p) != ".cs" {
+				problem(a.Name, p, "invalid-source-path", "expected a project-relative Assets .cs path")
+				continue
+			}
+			f, ok := facts[p]
+			if !ok {
+				problem(a.Name, p, "source-fact-missing", "source lacks owner and digest")
+				continue
+			}
+			b, err := fs.ReadFile(files, p)
+			if err != nil {
+				problem(a.Name, p, "source-unreadable", "compiler source missing from snapshot")
+				continue
+			}
+			if f.SHA256 == "" || unityHash(b) != f.SHA256 {
+				problem(a.Name, p, "source-digest-mismatch", "receipt does not bind current source")
+				continue
+			}
+			owner := ""
+			unsupported := false
+			for d := path.Dir(p); d != "."; d = path.Dir(d) {
+				if asmrefs[d] {
+					unsupported = true
+					unjudged(a.Name, p, "asmref-owner", "assembly reference directories are unsupported")
+					break
+				}
+				if ds := dirs[d]; len(ds) > 0 {
+					if len(ds) != 1 {
+						problem(a.Name, p, "ambiguous-owner", "multiple asmdefs in nearest directory")
+					} else {
+						owner = defs[ds[0]].name
+					}
+					break
+				}
+			}
+			if unsupported {
+				continue
+			}
+			if owner != a.Name || strings.TrimSuffix(f.Owner, ".dll") != a.Name {
+				problem(a.Name, p, "owner-mismatch", fmt.Sprintf("nearest=%s oracle=%s assembly=%s", owner, f.Owner, a.Name))
+			} else {
+				r.OwnerMatches++
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	sortProblems := func(ps []UnityAsmdefProblem) {
+		sort.Slice(ps, func(i, j int) bool {
+			a, b := ps[i], ps[j]
+			return a.Assembly+"\x00"+a.Path+"\x00"+a.Kind+"\x00"+a.Detail < b.Assembly+"\x00"+b.Path+"\x00"+b.Kind+"\x00"+b.Detail
+		})
+	}
+	sortProblems(r.Problems)
+	sortProblems(r.Unjudged)
+	sortProblems(r.Notices)
+	r.Passed = len(r.Problems) == 0
+	r.Complete = len(r.Unjudged) == 0
+	return r, nil
+}
+
+func unityHash(b []byte) string { h := sha256.Sum256(b); return hex.EncodeToString(h[:]) }
+func unityPath(p string) bool {
+	return fs.ValidPath(p) && strings.HasPrefix(p, "Assets/") && !strings.Contains(p, "\\")
+}
+func unitySet(ss []string) map[string]bool {
+	m := map[string]bool{}
+	for _, s := range ss {
+		m[s] = true
+	}
+	return m
+}
+func unitySorted(ss []string) []string {
+	out := make([]string, 0, len(ss))
+	for _, s := range ss {
+		out = append(out, s)
+	}
+	sort.Strings(out)
+	return out
+}

+package langbench
+
+import (
+	"crypto/sha256"
+	"encoding/hex"
+	"encoding/json"
+	"io/fs"
+	"strings"
+	"testing"
+	"testing/fstest"
+)
+
+func unityFixture(t *testing.T) (fstest.MapFS, []byte) {
+	t.Helper()
+	files := fstest.MapFS{
+		"Assets/Root/Root.asmdef":        {Data: []byte(`{"name":"Fixture.Root","references":["Fixture.Core"]}`)},
+		"Assets/Root/Root.cs":            {Data: []byte("namespace Fixture { class Root {} }\n")},
+		"Assets/Root/Nested/Core.asmdef": {Data: []byte(`{"name":"Fixture.Core","noEngineReferences":true,"overrideReferences":true,"precompiledReferences":[]}`)},
+		"Assets/Root/Nested/Core.cs":     {Data: []byte("namespace Fixture { class Core {} }\n")},
+	}

+func TestUnityAsmdefCalibrationRefusesFalseOrMissingFacts(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, tc := range []struct {
+		name, want string
+		mutate     func(fstest.MapFS, []byte) []byte
+	}{
+		{"wrong owner", "owner-mismatch", func(f fstest.MapFS, b []byte) []byte {
+			return []byte(strings.Replace(string(b), "Fixture.Core.dll", "Fixture.Root.dll", 1))
+		}},
+		{"missing source", "source-unreadable", func(f fstest.MapFS, b []byte) []byte { delete(f, "Assets/Root/Nested/Core.cs"); return b }},
+		{"changed source", "source-digest-mismatch", func(f fstest.MapFS, b []byte) []byte {
+			f["Assets/Root/Nested/Core.cs"].Data = []byte("changed")
+			return b
+		}},
+		{"missing definition", "definition-unreadable", func(f fstest.MapFS, b []byte) []byte { delete(f, "Assets/Root/Nested/Core.asmdef"); return b }},
+		{"false compiler reference", "reference-not-compiled", func(f fstest.MapFS, b []byte) []byte {
+			return []byte(strings.Replace(string(b), `"assemblyReferences":["Fixture.Core"]`, `"assemblyReferences":[]`, 1))
+		}},
+		{"missing target assembly", "reference-not-available", func(f fstest.MapFS, b []byte) []byte {
+			return []byte(strings.Replace(string(b), `"availableAssemblyNames":["Fixture.Core","Fixture.Root"]`, `"availableAssemblyNames":["Fixture.Root"]`, 1))
+		}},
+		{"engine dependency in engine-free assembly", "engine-reference-present", func(f fstest.MapFS, b []byte) []byte {
+			return []byte(strings.Replace(string(b), `"System.Runtime"`, `"UnityEngine.CoreModule"`, 1))
+		}},
+		{"missing compiled reference coverage", "compiled-references-missing", func(f fstest.MapFS, b []byte) []byte {
+			return []byte(strings.Replace(string(b), `"compiledAssemblyReferences":["System.Runtime"]`, `"compiledAssemblyReferences":null`, 1))
+		}},
+		{"false override declaration", "override-declaration-mismatch", func(f fstest.MapFS, b []byte) []byte {
+			return []byte(strings.Replace(string(b), `"overrideReferencesDeclared":true`, `"overrideReferencesDeclared":false`, 1))
+		}},
+		{"source fact outside project", "invalid-source-path", func(f fstest.MapFS, b []byte) []byte {
+			return []byte(strings.ReplaceAll(string(b), "Assets/Root/Nested/Core.cs", "../Core.cs"))
+		}},
+	} {
+		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			f, b := unityFixture(t)
+			b = tc.mutate(f, b)
+			r, err := CalibrateUnityAsmdefs(f, b)
+			if err != nil {
+				t.Fatal(err)
+			}
+			if r.Passed {
+				t.Fatalf("false pass: %+v", r)
+			}
+			found := false
+			for _, p := range r.Problems {
+				found = found || p.Kind == tc.want
+			}
+			if !found {
+				t.Fatalf("want %s: %+v", tc.want, r)
+			}
+		})
+	}
+}

+func TestUnityAsmdefSeparatesAvailableAndEmittedReferences(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, tc := range []struct {
+		name                      string
+		available, emitted        []string
+		observed                  bool
+		wantProblem, wantUnjudged string
+	}{
+		{name: "Editor SDK availability is not emitted use", available: []string{"System.Runtime", "UnityEditor.iOS.Extensions.Xcode", "Unity.Android.Gradle"}, emitted: []string{"System.Runtime"}, observed: true},
+		{name: "emitted Unity dependency refuses", available: []string{"System.Runtime"}, emitted: []string{"System.Runtime", "UnityEngine.CoreModule"}, observed: true, wantProblem: "emitted-unity-reference"},
+		{name: "unavailable emitted metadata stays unjudged", available: []string{"System.Runtime"}, observed: false, wantUnjudged: "emitted-references-unavailable"},
+	} {
+		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			f, b := unityFixture(t)
+			var receipt map[string]any
+			if err := json.Unmarshal(b, &receipt); err != nil {
+				t.Fatal(err)
+			}
+			core := receipt["assemblies"].([]any)[1].(map[string]any)
+			core["compiledAssemblyReferences"] = tc.available
+			core["emittedReferencesAvailable"] = tc.observed
+			core["emittedAssemblyReferences"] = tc.emitted
+			raw, err := json.Marshal(receipt)
+			if err != nil {
+				t.Fatal(err)
+			}
+			r, err := CalibrateUnityAsmdefs(f, raw)
+			if err != nil {
+				t.Fatal(err)
+			}
+			if tc.wantProblem != "" {
+				if r.Passed || len(r.Problems) != 1 || r.Problems[0].Kind != tc.wantProblem {
+					t.Fatalf("emitted dependency not refused: %+v", r)
+				}
+			} else if tc.wantUnjudged != "" {
+				if r.Complete || len(r.Unjudged) != 1 || r.Unjudged[0].Kind != tc.wantUnjudged {
+					t.Fatalf("unobserved metadata claimed: %+v", r)
+				}
+			} else {
+				if !r.Passed || !r.Complete || r.NoEngineMatches != 1 {
+					t.Fatalf("available SDK misclassified as engine use: %+v", r)
+				}
+				encoded, _ := json.Marshal(r)
+				if !strings.Contains(string(encoded), "other-unity-prefixed-available-reference") {
+					t.Fatal("available SDK caveat disappeared")
+				}
+			}
+		})
+	}
+}

+// Encoding the response is the independent oracle for a dispatch byte budget:
+// every single byte, including malformed UTF-8, must cost exactly its encoding.
+func TestJSONStringSizeAllBytesAndMalformedUTF8(t *testing.T) {
+	for i := 0; i <= 255; i++ {
+		t.Run(fmt.Sprintf("byte-%02x", i), func(t *testing.T) {
+			assertJSONStringSize(t, string([]byte{byte(i)}))
+		})
+	}
+	for _, s := range []string{"é日本", "\u2028\u2029", "\xff日本", "a\xffz", "\xc0\xaf", "\xed\xa0\x80", "\xf0\x9f", "\xef\xbf\xbd"} {
+		assertJSONStringSize(t, s)
+	}
+}
+
+func assertJSONStringSize(t *testing.T, s string) {
+	t.Helper()
+	for _, value := range []any{s, map[string]any{s: []string{s}}} {
+		b, err := json.Marshal(value)
+		if err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+		n, err := jsonSize(value, 1<<30)
+		if err != nil || n != len(b) {
+			t.Errorf("input %q: size = %d, %v; Marshal = %d: %s", s, n, err, len(b), b)
+		}
+	}
+}

+package mcp_test

+// A controlled typed graph exercises the gate's test-identity seam. These
+// generic parser fixtures are not a compiler receipt or an executed test run.
+func TestVerifyPlanCSharpAttributedTestsWithoutNamePrefix(t *testing.T) {
+	e, err := extractor.NewTSExtractor("csharp")
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	defer e.Close()
+	nodes, err := e.Extract("svc", "Specs/Cases.cs", []byte(`
+namespace Workshop {
+    class Cases {
+        [Test] public void KeepsStock() { }
+        [UnityEngine.TestTools.UnityTest] public IEnumerator EventuallyPlaces() { yield break; }
+        [NUnit.Framework.TestCase(1, 2)] public void AcceptsOne(int a, int b) { }
+        [TestCaseSource(nameof(Data))] public void SourceCases(int x) { }
+        [SetUp] public void Prepare() { }
+        [TearDown] public void Cleanup() { }
+        [Other.Test] public void OtherAttribute() { }
+        [Description("[Test]")] public void AttributeInString() { }
+        public void TestWithoutAttribute() { }
+    }
+    class Worker { public static void Accept() { } public static void Unchecked() { } }
+}`))
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	byName := map[string]core.SymbolNode{}
+	for _, n := range nodes {
+		byName[n.Name] = n
+	}
+	var edges []core.Edge
+	for _, name := range []string{"KeepsStock", "EventuallyPlaces", "AcceptsOne", "SourceCases", "Prepare", "Cleanup", "OtherAttribute", "AttributeInString", "TestWithoutAttribute"} {
+		from := byName["Cases."+name]
+		to := byName["Worker.Unchecked"]
+		if name == "KeepsStock" || name == "EventuallyPlaces" || name == "AcceptsOne" || name == "SourceCases" {
+			to = byName["Worker.Accept"]
+		}
+		if from.Name == "" || to.Name == "" {
+			t.Fatalf("fixture missing source node %s", name)
+		}
+		edges = append(edges, core.Edge{FromService: "svc", FromFile: from.FilePath, FromSymbol: from.Key(), ToSymbol: to.Key(), Kind: core.EdgeDirect})
+	}

+		map[string]any{"id": "N-2", "title": "non-test callers", "symbol": "Worker.Unchecked"},

+			}

+		}

+func scipSourceMCPFixture(t *testing.T) (*client.Client, string) {
+	t.Helper()
+	root := t.TempDir()
+	index := scip.BuildTSFixtureIndex()
+	index.Metadata.ProjectRoot = "file://" + filepath.ToSlash(root)
+	digest := func(data []byte) string { h := sha256.Sum256(data); return hex.EncodeToString(h[:]) }
+	var inputs []scip.SourceInput
+	var names []string
+	for _, doc := range index.Documents {
+		data, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join("..", "scip", "testdata", "tsfixture", doc.RelativePath))
+		if err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, doc.RelativePath), data, 0644); err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+		inputs = append(inputs, scip.SourceInput{Path: doc.RelativePath, SHA256: digest(data)})
+		names = append(names, doc.RelativePath)
+	}
+	raw, err := proto.Marshal(index)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	path := filepath.Join(root, "index.scip")
+	if err := os.WriteFile(path, raw, 0644); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	receipt := scip.SourceReceipt{Schema: scip.SourceReceiptSchema, Status: "complete", Root: root, IndexSHA256: digest(raw), Producer: scip.SourceProducer{Name: index.Metadata.ToolInfo.Name, Version: index.Metadata.ToolInfo.Version}, Inputs: inputs, Inventories: []scip.SourceInventory{{Root: ".", Pattern: "*.ts", Paths: names}}}
+	body, err := json.Marshal(receipt)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if err := os.WriteFile(path+".receipt.json", body, 0644); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	c := client.New(connector.NewLocalConnector(), store.NewMemoryStore())
+	return c, root

+package mcp
+
+import (
+	"bytes"
+	"context"
+	"crypto/rand"
+	"encoding/hex"
+	"encoding/json"
+	"fmt"
+	"io"
+	"sync"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/geoffmilleraz/fathom/internal/store"
+	"github.com/geoffmilleraz/fathom/pkg/client"
+)
+
+type sourceWindowInput struct {
+	Op       string          `json:"op"`
+	Token    string          `json:"token"`
+	ReportID string          `json:"report_id"`
+	Expected json.RawMessage `json:"expected_exclusions"`
+}
+
+func parseSourceWindowInput(raw json.RawMessage) (sourceWindowInput, error) {
+	if len(raw) == 0 {
+		return sourceWindowInput{}, nil
+	}
+	var p sourceWindowInput
+	d := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(raw))
+	d.DisallowUnknownFields()
+	if err := d.Decode(&p); err != nil {
+		return p, fmt.Errorf("current source window: invalid input: %w", err)
+	}
+	var extra any
+	if err := d.Decode(&extra); err != io.EOF {
+		return p, fmt.Errorf("current source window: trailing input")
+	}
+	return p, nil
+}
+
+// The optional source-window capability is carried by verify_plan, so the
+// existing tree-class admission, tool surface and response budget apply.
+type sourceWindowBackend interface {
+	BeginSourceWindow(context.Context, string) (*client.SourceWindow, error)
+	AdvanceSourceWindow(context.Context, *client.SourceWindow, int64, time.Duration) error
+}
+
+type serverSourceWindow struct {
+	mu              sync.Mutex
+	service         string
+	token           string
+	opened          time.Time
+	closedAt        time.Time
+	state           *client.SourceWindow
+	failed          bool
+	closing         bool
+	active          int
+	reviewed        bool
+	projectionBytes int
+	reportBytes     int
+	reports         map[string]json.RawMessage
+}
+
+const sourceWindowTTL = 30 * time.Minute
+const sourceWindowMax = 4
+const sourceWindowCacheBytes = 32 << 20
+
+func (s *Server) sourceWindowNow() time.Time {
+	if s.windowClock != nil {
+		return s.windowClock()
+	}
+	return time.Now()
+}
+
+func (s *Server) sourceWindowGet(service, token string) (*serverSourceWindow, error) {
+	s.windowMu.Lock()
+	defer s.windowMu.Unlock()
+	s.sourceWindowPruneLocked()
+	w := s.windows[service]
+	if w == nil || w.token != token {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("current source window: missing, expired or wrong service")
+	}
+	return w, nil
+}
+
+func (s *Server) sourceWindowPruneLocked() {
+	for key, w := range s.windows {
+		if s.sourceWindowNow().Sub(w.opened) > sourceWindowTTL {
+			delete(s.windows, key)
+		}
+	}
+	for token, w := range s.closedWindows {
+		if s.sourceWindowNow().Sub(w.closedAt) > 5*time.Minute {
+			delete(s.closedWindows, token)
+		}
+	}
+}
+
+func (s *Server) sourceWindowCurrent(w *serverSourceWindow) bool {
+	s.windowMu.Lock()
+	defer s.windowMu.Unlock()
+	s.sourceWindowPruneLocked()
+	return s.windows[w.service] == w && s.sourceWindowNow().Sub(w.opened) <= sourceWindowTTL
+}
+
+func (s *Server) sourceWindowDelete(w *serverSourceWindow) {
+	s.windowMu.Lock()
+	defer s.windowMu.Unlock()
+	if s.windows[w.service] == w {
+		delete(s.windows, w.service)
+	}
+}
+
+func (s *Server) sourceWindowUsedLocked() int {
+	n := 0
+	for _, w := range s.windows {
+		n += w.projectionBytes + w.reportBytes
+	}
+	for _, w := range s.closedWindows {
+		n += w.projectionBytes + w.reportBytes
+	}
+	return n
+}
+
+func reviewedExclusions(p store.SourceRefProjection, raw json.RawMessage) (bool, error) {
+	if len(raw) == 0 {
+		return p.Complete, nil
+	}
+	if len(raw) > 1<<20 {
+		return false, fmt.Errorf("current source window: expected exclusion manifest exceeds 1 MiB")
+	}
+	var expected []struct {
+		Path   string `json:"path"`
+		Reason string `json:"reason"`
+	}
+	d := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(raw))
+	d.DisallowUnknownFields()
+	if err := d.Decode(&expected); err != nil || expected == nil {
+		return false, fmt.Errorf("current source window: expected exclusion manifest invalid")
+	}
+	var extra any
+	if err := d.Decode(&extra); err != io.EOF {
+		return false, fmt.Errorf("current source window: expected exclusion manifest invalid")
+	}
+	i := 0
+	for _, row := range p.Rows {
+		if row.Excluded != "" {
+			if i >= len(expected) || expected[i].Path != row.Path || expected[i].Reason != row.Excluded {
+				return false, fmt.Errorf("current source window: reviewed exclusions differ")
+			}
+			i++
+		}
+	}
+	if i != len(expected) {
+		return false, fmt.Errorf("current source window: reviewed exclusions differ")
+	}
+	return true, nil
+}
+
+func (s *Server) sourceWindowOperation(ctx context.Context, backend QueryInterface, raw json.RawMessage) (any, *rpcError) {
+	capable, ok := backend.(sourceWindowBackend)
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, &rpcError{Code: ErrCodeNotFound, Message: "current source window: unsupported backend"}
+	}
+	var outer struct {
+		Service string          `json:"service"`
+		Window  json.RawMessage `json:"source_window"`
+	}
+	if json.Unmarshal(raw, &outer) != nil || outer.Service == "" {
+		return nil, &rpcError{Code: ErrCodeParams, Message: "current source window: service required"}
+	}
+	p, err := parseSourceWindowInput(outer.Window)
+	if err != nil || p.Op == "" {
+		return nil, &rpcError{Code: ErrCodeParams, Message: "current source window: operation required or invalid"}
+	}
+	service := outer.Service
+	if p.Op == "result" {
+		s.windowMu.Lock()
+		s.sourceWindowPruneLocked()
+		w := s.closedWindows[p.Token]
+		s.windowMu.Unlock()
+		if w == nil || w.service != service {
+			return nil, &rpcError{Code: ErrCodeInternal, Message: "current source window: closed token missing or expired"}
+		}
+		w.mu.Lock()
+		defer w.mu.Unlock()
+		s.windowMu.Lock()
+		s.sourceWindowPruneLocked()
+		valid := s.closedWindows[p.Token] == w
+		s.windowMu.Unlock()
+		if !valid {
+			return nil, &rpcError{Code: ErrCodeInternal, Message: "current source window: closed token expired"}
+		}
+		result := w.reports[p.ReportID]
+		if len(result) == 0 {
+			return nil, &rpcError{Code: ErrCodeInternal, Message: "current source window: report missing"}
+		}
+		return result, nil
+	}
+	if p.Op == "begin" {
+		state, err := capable.BeginSourceWindow(ctx, service)
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, &rpcError{Code: ErrCodeInternal, Message: err.Error()}
+		}
+		reviewed, err := reviewedExclusions(state.Projection, p.Expected)
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, &rpcError{Code: ErrCodeParams, Message: err.Error()}
+		}
+		// The sealed projection is compact, but bound the sum of all live
+		// session metadata before accepting another service.
+		b, _ := json.Marshal(state.Projection)
+		s.windowMu.Lock()
+		defer s.windowMu.Unlock()
+		s.sourceWindowPruneLocked()
+		used := len(b) + s.sourceWindowUsedLocked()
+		if s.windows[service] != nil || len(s.windows) >= sourceWindowMax || used > sourceWindowCacheBytes {
+			return nil, &rpcError{Code: ErrCodeInternal, Message: "current source window: service busy or cache cap"}
+		}
+		var secret [24]byte
+		if _, err = rand.Read(secret[:]); err != nil {
+			return nil, &rpcError{Code: ErrCodeInternal, Message: "current source window: token unavailable"}
+		}
+		token := hex.EncodeToString(secret[:])
+		if s.windows == nil {
+			s.windows = make(map[string]*serverSourceWindow)
+		}
+		s.windows[service] = &serverSourceWindow{service: service, token: token, opened: s.sourceWindowNow(), state: state, reviewed: reviewed, projectionBytes: len(b), reports: make(map[string]json.RawMessage)}
+		return map[string]any{"source_window_token": token, "source_window_state": "hashing_before", "watermark": state.Projection.Watermark, "total": len(state.Projection.Rows), "exclusion_review": map[bool]string{true: "matched", false: "unsupplied"}[reviewed]}, nil
+	}
+	w, err := s.sourceWindowGet(service, p.Token)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, &rpcError{Code: ErrCodeInternal, Message: err.Error()}
+	}
+	if !w.mu.TryLock() {
+		return nil, &rpcError{Code: ErrCodeInternal, Message: "current source window: concurrent continuation"}
+	}
+	defer w.mu.Unlock()
+	if !s.sourceWindowCurrent(w) {
+		return nil, &rpcError{Code: ErrCodeInternal, Message: "current source window: expired or replaced"}
+	}
+	if p.Op == "abort" {
+		w.failed = true
+		s.sourceWindowDelete(w)
+		return map[string]any{"source_window_state": "aborted"}, nil
+	}
+	if p.Op != "advance" && p.Op != "close" {
+		return nil, &rpcError{Code: ErrCodeParams, Message: "current source window: invalid operation"}
+	}
+	if p.Op == "advance" && w.state.Pass != 0 || p.Op == "close" && w.state.Pass != 1 {
+		return nil, &rpcError{Code: ErrCodeParams, Message: "current source window: wrong phase"}
+	}
+	if p.Op == "close" && w.active != 0 {
+		return nil, &rpcError{Code: ErrCodeInternal, Message: "current source window: verification calls still active"}
+	}
+	if p.Op == "close" {
+		w.closing = true
+	}
+	if err := capable.AdvanceSourceWindow(ctx, w.state, 0, 0); err != nil {
+		w.failed = true
+		s.sourceWindowDelete(w)
+		return nil, &rpcError{Code: ErrCodeInternal, Message: err.Error(), Data: map[string]any{"bytes": w.state.Bytes, "files": w.state.Files, "pass": w.state.Pass, "index": w.state.Index, "offset": w.state.Offset}}
+	}
+	status := "hashing_before"
+	if w.state.Pass == 1 {
+		status = "provisional"
+	}
+	if w.state.Ready {
+		status = "closed"
+		s.windowMu.Lock()
+		if s.windows[service] != w || s.sourceWindowNow().Sub(w.opened) > sourceWindowTTL {
+			s.windowMu.Unlock()
+			w.failed = true
+			return nil, &rpcError{Code: ErrCodeInternal, Message: "current source window: expired or replaced at close"}
+		}
+		delete(s.windows, service)
+		w.closedAt = s.sourceWindowNow()
+		if s.closedWindows == nil {
+			s.closedWindows = make(map[string]*serverSourceWindow)
+		}
+		s.closedWindows[w.token] = w
+		s.windowMu.Unlock()
+	}
+	answer := map[string]any{"source_window_state": status, "pass": w.state.Pass, "index": w.state.Index, "offset": w.state.Offset, "bytes": w.state.Bytes, "files": w.state.Files, "watermark": w.state.Projection.Watermark}
+	if w.state.Ready {
+		answer["excluded_hashes"] = w.state.ExcludedHashes()
+		answer["observation_scope"] = "bounded current-source window"
+		answer["exclusion_review"] = map[bool]string{true: "matched", false: "unsupplied"}[w.reviewed]
+	}
+	return answer, nil
+}
+
+func (s *Server) sourceWindowPending(ctx context.Context, w *serverSourceWindow, out map[string]any) (map[string]any, error) {
+	var idBytes [18]byte
+	if _, err := rand.Read(idBytes[:]); err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("current source window: report ID unavailable")
+	}
+	id := hex.EncodeToString(idBytes[:])
+	out["source_window_state"] = "closed"
+	out["current_worktree_freshness"] = "observed_window"
+	out["source_window_report_id"] = id
+	if w.reviewed {
+		out["exclusion_review"] = "matched"
+	} else {
+		out["exclusion_review"] = "unsupplied"
+	}
+	budget := defaultCharBudget
+	if n := declaredBudgetFrom(ctx); n > 0 {
+		budget = n
+	}
+	if budget > 256 {
+		budget -= 256
+	}
+	final := budgetedResult(out, budget)
+	raw, err := json.Marshal(final)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	// A report can have two large arrays (task verdicts and projection
+	// details). Trim until the whole saved result fits, so the outer MCP
+	// budget cannot silently change its task IDs after the pending receipt.
+	for tries := 0; len(raw) > budget && tries < 8; tries++ {
+		final = budgetedResult(final, budget)
+		raw, err = json.Marshal(final)
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+	}
+	if len(raw) > budget {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("current source window: final report exceeds response budget")
+	}
+	var finalMap map[string]any
+	if err = json.Unmarshal(raw, &finalMap); err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	items, ok := finalMap["tasks"].([]any)
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("current source window: final report could not fit task envelope")
+	}
+	pendingTasks := make([]map[string]any, 0, len(items))
+	for _, item := range items {
+		row, ok := item.(map[string]any)
+		if !ok {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("current source window: invalid task envelope")
+		}
+		pendingTasks = append(pendingTasks, map[string]any{"id": row["id"], "title": row["title"], "status": "unknown", "label": "source-window-pending", "criteria": []any{}})
+	}
+	pending := map[string]any{"service": out["service"], "source_scope": "current_worktree", "source_window_state": "pending", "source_window_report_id": id, "current_worktree_freshness": "unknown_until_close", "summary": map[string]any{"total": len(pendingTasks), "pass": 0, "fail": 0, "unknown": len(pendingTasks)}, "tasks": pendingTasks}
+	if v, ok := finalMap["elided"]; ok {
+		pending["elided"] = v
+	}
+	if v, ok := finalMap["partial"]; ok {
+		pending["partial"] = v
+	}
+	if n, e := jsonSize(pending, budget); e != nil || n > budget {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("current source window: pending receipt exceeds response budget")
+	}
+	w.mu.Lock()
+	defer w.mu.Unlock()
+	if w.failed || w.closing || !s.sourceWindowCurrent(w) {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("current source window: no longer active")
+	}
+	s.windowMu.Lock()
+	if s.sourceWindowUsedLocked()+len(raw) > sourceWindowCacheBytes {
+		s.windowMu.Unlock()
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("current source window: report cache cap")
+	}
+	w.reports[id] = raw
+	w.reportBytes += len(raw)
+	s.windowMu.Unlock()
+	return pending, nil
+}
+
+func (s *Server) sourceWindowProjection(service, token string) (store.SourceRefProjection, func(), error) {
+	w, err := s.sourceWindowGet(service, token)
+	if err != nil {
+		return store.SourceRefProjection{}, nil, err
+	}
+	w.mu.Lock()
+	defer w.mu.Unlock()
+	if !s.sourceWindowCurrent(w) || w.failed || w.closing || w.state.Pass != 1 || w.state.Ready {
+		return store.SourceRefProjection{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("current source window: before-hash incomplete")
+	}
+	w.active++
+	release := func() { w.mu.Lock(); w.active--; w.mu.Unlock() }
+	return w.state.Projection, release, nil
+}

+func TestSourceWindowExpiredPointerCannotUseOrDeleteReplacement(t *testing.T) {
+	b := windowBackendFixture{}
+	s := NewServer(b)
+	var stamp atomic.Int64
+	stamp.Store(time.Date(2026, 10, 20, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC).UnixNano())
+	s.windowClock = func() time.Time { return time.Unix(0, stamp.Load()) }
+	begin, e := windowOp(t, s, b, "svc", "begin", "")
+	if e != nil {
+		t.Fatal(e)
+	}
+	oldToken := begin["source_window_token"].(string)
+	old, err := s.sourceWindowGet("svc", oldToken)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	old.mu.Lock()
+	answer := make(chan error, 1)
+	go func() {
+		_, release, e := s.sourceWindowProjection("svc", oldToken)
+		if release != nil {
+			release()
+		}
+		answer <- e
+	}()
+	stamp.Add(int64(sourceWindowTTL + time.Second))
+	newBegin, e := windowOp(t, s, b, "svc", "begin", "")
+	if e != nil {
+		old.mu.Unlock()
+		t.Fatal(e)
+	}
+	newToken := newBegin["source_window_token"].(string)
+	old.mu.Unlock()
+	if e := <-answer; e == nil {
+		t.Fatal("expired pointer admitted")
+	}
+	s.sourceWindowDelete(old)
+	if _, e := s.sourceWindowGet("svc", newToken); e != nil {
+		t.Fatal("old window deleted replacement", e)
+	}
+}

+func (windowBackendFixture) AdvanceSourceWindow(_ context.Context, w *client.SourceWindow, _ int64, _ time.Duration) error {
+	if w.Pass == 0 {
+		w.Pass = 1
+	} else {
+		w.Ready = true
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+func windowOp(t *testing.T, s *Server, backend QueryInterface, service, op, token string) (map[string]any, *rpcError) {
+	t.Helper()
+	raw, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"service": service, "source_window": map[string]string{"op": op, "token": token}})
+	v, e := s.sourceWindowOperation(context.Background(), backend, raw)
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	return v.(map[string]any), nil
+}
+func TestSourceWindowLifecycleTokenExpiryAndReplay(t *testing.T) {
+	b := windowBackendFixture{}
+	s := NewServer(b)
+	now := time.Date(2026, 10, 20, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
+	s.windowClock = func() time.Time { return now }
+	begin, e := windowOp(t, s, b, "svc", "begin", "")
+	if e != nil {
+		t.Fatal(e)
+	}
+	token := begin["source_window_token"].(string)
+	if _, _, e := s.sourceWindowProjection("svc", token); e == nil {
+		t.Fatal("before-hash projection exposed")
+	}
+	if _, e := windowOp(t, s, b, "svc", "begin", ""); e == nil {
+		t.Fatal("concurrent window admitted")
+	}
+	if _, e := windowOp(t, s, b, "other", "advance", token); e == nil {
+		t.Fatal("cross-service token admitted")
+	}
+	advance, e := windowOp(t, s, b, "svc", "advance", token)
+	if e != nil || advance["source_window_state"] != "provisional" {
+		t.Fatalf("advance=%v err=%v", advance, e)
+	}
+	if _, release, e := s.sourceWindowProjection("svc", token); e != nil {
+		t.Fatal(e)
+	} else {
+		release()
+	}
+	close, e := windowOp(t, s, b, "svc", "close", token)
+	if e != nil || close["source_window_state"] != "closed" {
+		t.Fatalf("close=%v err=%v", close, e)
+	}
+	if _, _, e := s.sourceWindowProjection("svc", token); e == nil {
+		t.Fatal("closed token replayed")
+	}
+	begin, e = windowOp(t, s, b, "svc", "begin", "")
+	if e != nil {
+		t.Fatal(e)
+	}
+	now = now.Add(sourceWindowTTL + time.Second)
+	if _, e := windowOp(t, s, b, "svc", "advance", begin["source_window_token"].(string)); e == nil {
+		t.Fatal("expired window accepted")
+	}
+}

+type specProjectionBackend struct {
+	QueryInterface
+	scan func(context.Context, corpus.Budget, func(core.SourceFile) bool) (corpus.Coverage, error)
+}
+
+func (b specProjectionBackend) ScanSources(ctx context.Context, _ string, budget corpus.Budget, fn func(core.SourceFile) bool) (corpus.Coverage, error) {
+	return b.scan(ctx, budget, fn)
+}
+
+// Unchanged materializing reference from the exact reviewed H1 source. This
+// keeps the semantic oracle independent of the new streaming implementation.
+func materializedSpecMatrix(ctx context.Context, backend QueryInterface, nodes []core.SymbolNode, specs []string) (sdd.Matrix, corpus.Coverage, error) {
+	codeRefs := map[string][]string{}
+	for _, n := range nodes {
+		if refs := sdd.ExtractRefs(n.Signature + " " + n.Name); len(refs) > 0 {
+			codeRefs[n.Name] = refs
+		}
+	}
+	files, cov, err := collectSources(ctx, backend, "svc")
+	if errors.Is(err, core.ErrSourcesBusy) {
+		return sdd.Matrix{}, corpus.Coverage{}, err
+	}
+	if err != nil {
+		cov = corpus.Coverage{}
+	} else {
+		for _, f := range files {
+			if refs := sdd.ExtractRefs(string(f.Content)); len(refs) > 0 {
+				codeRefs[f.Path] = append(codeRefs[f.Path], refs...)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return sdd.BuildMatrix(specs, codeRefs), cov, nil
+}
+
+func deliveredSpecBackend(files []core.SourceFile, terminal corpus.Coverage, err error) specProjectionBackend {
+	return specProjectionBackend{scan: func(_ context.Context, budget corpus.Budget, fn func(core.SourceFile) bool) (corpus.Coverage, error) {
+		if budget.Bytes != 64<<20 || budget.Wall != 5*time.Second {
+			panic("spec projection changed its scan budget")
+		}
+		for _, file := range files {
+			if fn(file) {
+				panic("spec projection introduced a hit stop")
+			}
+		}
+		return terminal, err
+	}}
+}
+
+func TestSpecMatrixProjectionDifferentialCallbacksAndErrors(t *testing.T) {
+	files := []core.SourceFile{
+		{Path: "collision.cs", Content: []byte("[FR-1] [US-2] [FR-1]"), Generated: true},
+		{Path: "collision.cs", Content: []byte("[FR-1] [EP-3]")},
+		{Path: "values.json", Content: []byte("{\"key\":\"[NFR-4] [FR-999]\"}")},
+		{Path: "notes.md", Content: []byte("\xff[FR-1]\x00 [X-2]")},
+	}
+	nodes := []core.SymbolNode{
+		{Name: "collision.cs", Signature: "[FR-1]"},
+		{Name: "same", Signature: "[US-2]"},
+		{Name: "same", Signature: "[EP-3]"},
+	}
+	specs := []string{"[FR-1]", "[US-2]", "[EP-3]", "[NFR-4]", "[FR-0]"}
+	full := corpus.Coverage{Scanned: len(files), Total: len(files), BytesRead: 123}
+	for _, tc := range []struct {
+		name string
+		cov  corpus.Coverage
+		err  error
+	}{
+		{"complete", full, nil},
+		{"excluded", corpus.Coverage{Scanned: 4, Total: 5, BytesRead: 123, Excluded: []corpus.Excluded{{Path: "unreadable", Reason: corpus.ReasonUnreadable, Err: errors.New("permission denied")}}}, nil},
+		{"bytes", corpus.Coverage{Scanned: 4, Total: 8, BytesRead: 123, Stopped: corpus.StopBytes}, nil},
+		{"files", corpus.Coverage{Scanned: 4, Total: 8, BytesRead: 123, Stopped: corpus.StopFiles}, nil},
+		{"meter", corpus.Coverage{Scanned: 4, Total: 8, BytesRead: 123, Stopped: corpus.StopMeter}, nil},
+		{"late-error", full, errors.New("terminal read failed after callbacks")},
+		{"late-cancel", corpus.Coverage{Scanned: 4, Total: 8, Stopped: corpus.StopCtx}, context.Canceled},
+		{"busy", full, fmt.Errorf("wrapped: %w", core.ErrSourcesBusy)},
+	} {
+		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			backend := deliveredSpecBackend(files, tc.cov, tc.err)
+			want, wc, we := materializedSpecMatrix(context.Background(), backend, nodes, specs)
+			got, gc, ge := buildSpecMatrix(context.Background(), backend, "svc", nodes, specs)
+			if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) || !reflect.DeepEqual(gc, wc) || !errors.Is(ge, we) {
+				t.Fatalf("projection differs from materializing reference: matrix=%v coverage=%+v/%+v err=%v/%v", reflect.DeepEqual(got, want), gc, wc, ge, we)
+			}
+			if ge == nil {
+				plan := verify.Plan{Service: "svc", Tasks: []verify.Task{
+					{ID: "covered", SpecIDs: []string{"[FR-1]"}, Claimed: true},
+					{ID: "uncovered", SpecIDs: []string{"[FR-0]"}, Claimed: true},
+				}}
+				gotReport := verifyReportToMap(verify.VerifyPlan(plan, &verifyEvidence{haveMat: true, matrix: got}))
+				wantReport := verifyReportToMap(verify.VerifyPlan(plan, &verifyEvidence{haveMat: true, matrix: want}))
+				if !reflect.DeepEqual(gotReport, wantReport) || partialNote(gc) != partialNote(wc) {
+					t.Fatal("rendered verify report or named partial changed")
+				}
+			}
+			if tc.name == "complete" {
+				// Symbol contribution plus BOTH repeated-path callbacks survive.
+				wantIDs := []string{"collision.cs", "collision.cs", "collision.cs", "notes.md"}
+				if !reflect.DeepEqual(got.Coverage("[FR-1]"), wantIDs) {
+					t.Fatalf("callback or symbol contributions deduplicated: %v", got.Coverage("[FR-1]"))
+				}
+				if !reflect.DeepEqual(got.Coverage("[FR-999]"), []string{"values.json"}) {
+					t.Fatal("undeclared/orphan refs were filtered")
+				}
+			}
+			if tc.err != nil && !errors.Is(tc.err, core.ErrSourcesBusy) && len(got.Coverage("[FR-1]")) != 1 {
+				t.Fatal("late scan error kept file contributions or lost the symbol")
+			}
+		})
+	}
+}

+func TestSpecMatrixProjectionScanSourceFilesLastWins(t *testing.T) {
+	files := []core.SourceFile{
+		{Path: "same.json", Content: []byte("[FR-1]")},
+		{Path: "same.json", Content: []byte("[FR-2]")},

+		return corpus.ScanSourceFiles(ctx, files, budget, fn)
+	}}

+	if err != nil || cov.Total != 1 || cov.Scanned != 1 || len(got.Coverage("[FR-1]")) != 0 || !reflect.DeepEqual(got.Coverage("[FR-2]"), []string{"same.json"}) {
+		t.Fatalf("scan-level last-wins changed: %+v %v %v", cov, err, got)
+	}
+}

+func TestSpecMatrixProjectionWallStopAndFinalCallbackCancellation(t *testing.T) {
+	backend := specProjectionBackend{scan: func(ctx context.Context, budget corpus.Budget, fn func(core.SourceFile) bool) (corpus.Coverage, error) {
+		now := time.Unix(0, 0)
+		budget.Now = func() time.Time { return now }
+		return corpus.ScanFetch(ctx, []string{"a", "b", "c"}, budget,
+			func(context.Context, string) ([]byte, error) { return []byte("[FR-1]"), nil },
+			func(path string, content []byte) bool {
+				stop := fn(core.SourceFile{Path: path, Content: content})
+				now = now.Add(3 * time.Second) // deterministic callback work charge
+				return stop
+			})
+	}}
+	got, cov, err := buildSpecMatrix(context.Background(), backend, "svc", nil, []string{"[FR-1]"})
+	if err != nil || cov.Stopped != corpus.StopTime || cov.Scanned != 2 || !reflect.DeepEqual(got.Coverage("[FR-1]"), []string{"a", "b"}) {
+		t.Fatalf("wall stop changed: %+v %v %v", cov, err, got)
+	}
+	// ScanFetch checks cancellation before each file, not after the final
+	// callback. Cancellation within the final delivery must not add a new
+	// terminal check, rename the stop, or discard a nil-error complete scan.
+	for _, terminalError := range []bool{false, true} {
+		ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
+		backend := specProjectionBackend{scan: func(ctx context.Context, budget corpus.Budget, fn func(core.SourceFile) bool) (corpus.Coverage, error) {
+			cov, err := corpus.ScanFetch(ctx, []string{"final"}, budget,
+				func(context.Context, string) ([]byte, error) { return []byte("[FR-1]"), nil },
+				func(path string, content []byte) bool {
+					cancel()
+					return fn(core.SourceFile{Path: path, Content: content})
+				})
+			if terminalError {
+				return cov, context.Canceled
+			}
+			return cov, err
+		}}
+		matrix, cov, err := buildSpecMatrix(ctx, backend, "svc", nil, []string{"[FR-1]"})
+		if ctx.Err() == nil || err != nil {
+			t.Fatalf("final cancellation setup/error changed: %v %v", ctx.Err(), err)
+		}
+		if terminalError {
+			if len(matrix.Coverage("[FR-1]")) != 0 || !reflect.DeepEqual(cov, corpus.Coverage{}) {
+				t.Fatal("terminal nonbusy error did not discard all file refs and coverage")
+			}
+		} else if cov.Stopped != "" || cov.Scanned != 1 || !reflect.DeepEqual(matrix.Coverage("[FR-1]"), []string{"final"}) {
+			t.Fatalf("new context check after final callback: %+v %v", cov, matrix)
+		}
+		cancel()
+	}
+}

+	return []byte("[FR-1]"), nil

+	return "", nil

+func TestSpecMatrixProjectionSourcesScopeContentionAndRelease(t *testing.T) {
+	c := client.New(specProjectionConnector{}, store.NewMemoryStore())
+	specs := []string{"[FR-1]"}
+	s1, done1 := client.WithSourcesScope(context.Background(), nil)
+	s2, done2 := client.WithSourcesScope(context.Background(), nil)
+	defer done1()
+	defer done2()
+	for _, ctx := range []context.Context{s1, s2} {
+		if matrix, _, err := buildSpecMatrix(ctx, c, "svc", nil, specs); err != nil || len(matrix.Coverage("[FR-1]")) != 1 {
+			t.Fatalf("scoped projection: %v %v", matrix, err)
+		}
+	}
+	if _, _, err := buildSpecMatrix(client.WithHookOrigin(context.Background()), c, "svc", nil, specs); !errors.Is(err, core.ErrSourcesBusy) {
+		t.Fatalf("busy hook projection = %v, want named refusal", err)
+	}
+	cancelled, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
+	cancel()
+	matrix, cov, err := buildSpecMatrix(cancelled, c, "svc", nil, specs)
+	if err != nil || len(matrix.Coverage("[FR-1]")) != 0 || !reflect.DeepEqual(cov, corpus.Coverage{}) {
+		t.Fatal("cancelled slot wait changed existing nonbusy best-effort behavior")
+	}
+	done1()
+	done1()
+	if matrix, _, err := buildSpecMatrix(client.WithHookOrigin(context.Background()), c, "svc", nil, specs); err != nil || len(matrix.Coverage("[FR-1]")) != 1 {
+		t.Fatalf("slot not released at scope completion: %v %v", matrix, err)
+	}
+}

+func specProjectionAllocationFixture() ([]core.SourceFile, specProjectionBackend) {
+	files := make([]core.SourceFile, 32)
+	for i := range files {
+		content := bytes.Repeat([]byte{'x'}, 1<<20)
+		copy(content[8190:], "[FR-1]")
+		files[i] = core.SourceFile{Path: fmt.Sprintf("file-%02d.json", i), Content: content}
+	}
+	backend := specProjectionBackend{scan: func(ctx context.Context, budget corpus.Budget, fn func(core.SourceFile) bool) (corpus.Coverage, error) {
+		return corpus.ScanSourceFiles(ctx, files, budget, fn)
+	}}
+	return files, backend
+}

+func requireSpecProjectionFixture(tb testing.TB, matrix sdd.Matrix, cov corpus.Coverage, err error) {
+	tb.Helper()
+	if err != nil || cov.Stopped != "" || cov.Scanned != 32 || cov.Total != 32 || cov.BytesRead != projectionFixtureBytes || len(matrix.Coverage("[FR-1]")) != 32 {
+		tb.Fatalf("allocation win cannot reduce corpus: %+v err=%v refs=%d", cov, err, len(matrix.Coverage("[FR-1]")))
+	}
+}

+// Fixed proposed RED/GREEN threshold: input setup and materializing oracle
+// are outside the observation. Baseline's full-file string copies exceed8MiB.
+// This has not been executed or calibrated as a production memory bound.
+func TestSpecMatrixProjectionAllocationBound(t *testing.T) {
+	files, backend := specProjectionAllocationFixture()
+	specs := []string{"[FR-1]"}
+	want, wc, we := materializedSpecMatrix(context.Background(), backend, nil, specs)
+	requireSpecProjectionFixture(t, want, wc, we)
+	var before, after runtime.MemStats
+	runtime.ReadMemStats(&before)
+	got, cov, err := buildSpecMatrix(context.Background(), backend, "svc", nil, specs)
+	runtime.ReadMemStats(&after)
+	requireSpecProjectionFixture(t, got, cov, err)
+	if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
+		t.Fatal("allocation target changed the matrix")
+	}
+	if used := after.TotalAlloc - before.TotalAlloc; used >= projectionFixtureBytes/4 {
+		t.Fatalf("extraction overhead = %d bytes, want <8MiB for32MiB delivered", used)
+	}
+	runtime.KeepAlive(files)
+}

+func BenchmarkBuildSpecMatrixProjection(b *testing.B) {

+	for i := 0; i < b.N; i++ {
+		matrix, cov, err := buildSpecMatrix(context.Background(), backend, "svc", nil, []string{"[FR-1]"})
+		requireSpecProjectionFixture(b, matrix, cov, err)

+	b.StopTimer()
+	b.ReportMetric(32, "files/op")
+	b.ReportMetric(projectionFixtureBytes, "delivered-B/op")
+	runtime.KeepAlive(files)
+}

+// Synthetic retained-heap observation, deliberately separate from allocation
+// and from daemon footprint. Explicit GC is confined to this test workload.
+// It reports the in-flight sample without claiming a peak or setting policy.
+func TestSpecMatrixProjectionRetainedWorkload(t *testing.T) {
+	var initial, during runtime.MemStats
+	runtime.GC()
+	runtime.ReadMemStats(&initial)
+	backend := specProjectionBackend{scan: func(_ context.Context, _ corpus.Budget, fn func(core.SourceFile) bool) (corpus.Coverage, error) {
+		for i := 0; i < 32; i++ {
+			content := bytes.Repeat([]byte{'x'}, 1<<20)
+			copy(content, "[FR-1]")
+			fn(core.SourceFile{Path: fmt.Sprintf("file-%02d.json", i), Content: content})
+			content = nil
+			if i == 30 {
+				runtime.GC()
+				runtime.ReadMemStats(&during)
+			}
+		}
+		return corpus.Coverage{Scanned: 32, Total: 32, BytesRead: projectionFixtureBytes}, nil
+	}}
+	matrix, cov, err := buildSpecMatrix(context.Background(), backend, "svc", nil, []string{"[FR-1]"})
+	requireSpecProjectionFixture(t, matrix, cov, err)
+	t.Logf("synthetic in-flight sampled heap delta after31callbacks: %d bytes (not process peak)", int64(during.HeapAlloc)-int64(initial.HeapAlloc))
+	runtime.KeepAlive(matrix)
+}
