+package mcp
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"fmt"
+
+	"github.com/geoffmilleraz/fathom/internal/core"
+	"github.com/geoffmilleraz/fathom/internal/sdd"
+	"github.com/geoffmilleraz/fathom/internal/store"
+	"github.com/geoffmilleraz/fathom/internal/verify"
+)
+
+// generationRefsBackend is deliberately optional. An older store or a
+// backend without this read cannot satisfy an explicit generation request.
+type generationRefsBackend interface {
+	SourceRefProjection(context.Context, string) (store.SourceRefProjection, bool, error)
+}
+
+func buildGenerationSpecMatrix(ctx context.Context, backend QueryInterface, service string, nodes []core.SymbolNode, specs []string) (sdd.Matrix, store.SourceRefProjection, error) {
+	reader, ok := backend.(generationRefsBackend)
+	if !ok {
+		return sdd.Matrix{}, store.SourceRefProjection{}, fmt.Errorf("sealed ingest-generation reference facts unavailable")
+	}
+	p, found, err := reader.SourceRefProjection(ctx, service)
+	if err != nil {
+		return sdd.Matrix{}, store.SourceRefProjection{}, err
+	}
+	if !found || p.ServiceID != service || p.Scope != store.SourceRefScopeIngestGeneration || p.CurrentWorktreeFreshness != "unknown" || !store.ValidSourceRefProjection(p) {
+		return sdd.Matrix{}, store.SourceRefProjection{}, fmt.Errorf("sealed ingest-generation reference facts unavailable or invalid")
+	}
+	return buildProjectionSpecMatrix(p, nodes, specs), p, nil
+}
+
+func buildProjectionSpecMatrix(p store.SourceRefProjection, nodes []core.SymbolNode, specs []string) sdd.Matrix {
+	refs := make(map[string][]string)
+	for _, n := range nodes {
+		if tokens := sdd.ExtractRefs(n.Signature + " " + n.Name); len(tokens) > 0 {
+			refs[n.Name] = tokens
+		}
+	}
+	for _, row := range p.Rows {
+		if row.Excluded == "" && len(row.Refs) > 0 {
+			refs[row.Path] = append(refs[row.Path], row.Refs...)
+		}
+	}
+	return sdd.BuildMatrix(specs, refs)
+}
+
+// Generation facts have unknown current-worktree freshness. Preserve failures
+// from other criteria, but never pass or fail a row solely on these refs.
+func markGenerationSpecUnknown(rep *verify.Report) {
+	rep.Summary = verify.Summary{Total: len(rep.Tasks)}
+	for i := range rep.Tasks {
+		t := &rep.Tasks[i]
+		hasSpec, otherFail := false, false
+		for j := range t.Criteria {
+			c := &t.Criteria[j]
+			if c.Name == "spec_covered" {
+				hasSpec = true
+				c.Status = verify.Unknown
+				c.Detail = "ingest-generation refs; current worktree freshness unknown"
+			} else if c.Status == verify.Fail {
+				otherFail = true
+			}
+		}
+		if hasSpec && !otherFail {
+			t.Status = verify.Unknown
+			t.Label = "spec-generation-only"
+		} else if hasSpec && t.Label == "spec-uncovered" {
+			t.Label = "other-criterion-failed"
+		}
+		switch t.Status {
+		case verify.Pass:
+			rep.Summary.Pass++
+		case verify.Fail:
+			rep.Summary.Fail++
+		default:
+			rep.Summary.Unknown++
+		}
+	}
+}
+
+// Excluded bytes were not examined at ingest. A present binding in an
+// examined row is usable after full window identity; absence remains Unknown.
+func markCurrentExcludedUnknown(rep *verify.Report, matrix sdd.Matrix, p store.SourceRefProjection) {
+	excluded := false
+	for _, row := range p.Rows {
+		if row.Excluded != "" {
+			excluded = true
+			break
+		}
+	}
+	if !excluded {
+		return
+	}
+	rep.Summary = verify.Summary{Total: len(rep.Tasks)}
+	for i := range rep.Tasks {
+		t := &rep.Tasks[i]
+		otherFail := false
+		for _, c := range t.Criteria {
+			if c.Name != "spec_covered" && c.Status == verify.Fail {
+				otherFail = true
+			}
+		}
+		for j := range t.Criteria {
+			c := &t.Criteria[j]
+			if c.Name != "spec_covered" || c.Status != verify.Fail {
+				continue
+			}
+			c.Status = verify.Unknown
+			c.Detail = "excluded source bytes were not examined at ingest; absence is unknown"
+			if !otherFail {
+				t.Status = verify.Unknown
+				t.Label = "spec-excluded-unknown"
+			}
+		}
+		switch t.Status {
+		case verify.Pass:
+			rep.Summary.Pass++
+		case verify.Fail:
+			rep.Summary.Fail++
+		default:
+			rep.Summary.Unknown++
+		}
+	}
+	_ = matrix
+}
+
+func generationProjectionReport(p store.SourceRefProjection, matrix sdd.Matrix, specs []string) map[string]any {
+	excluded := make([]map[string]string, 0)
+	examined := 0
+	bindings := make(map[string][]string)
+	for _, spec := range specs {
+		bindings[spec] = matrix.Coverage(spec)
+		if bindings[spec] == nil {
+			bindings[spec] = []string{}
+		}
+	}
+	for _, row := range p.Rows {
+		if row.Excluded != "" {
+			excluded = append(excluded, map[string]string{"path": row.Path, "reason": row.Excluded})
+		} else {
+			examined++
+		}
+	}
+	return map[string]any{
+		"watermark": p.Watermark, "root": p.Root, "policy": p.Policy,
+		"extractor_version": p.ExtractorVersion, "membership_hash": p.MembershipHash,
+		"produced_at": p.ProducedAt, "complete": p.Complete,
+		"examined": examined, "total": len(p.Rows), "excluded": excluded,
+		"bindings": bindings,
+	}
+}

+	found bool

+func generationFixture() store.SourceRefProjection {
+	h := sha256.Sum256([]byte("[FR-1]"))
+	p := store.SourceRefProjection{
+		ServiceID: "svc", Scope: store.SourceRefScopeIngestGeneration,
+		CurrentWorktreeFreshness: "unknown", Root: "/fixture", Policy: "policy",
+		Watermark: "head@1", ExtractorVersion: store.SourceRefExtractorVersion,
+		Rows: []store.SourceRefFact{
+			{Path: "a.go", SourceHash: hex.EncodeToString(h[:]), ExtractorVersion: store.SourceRefExtractorVersion, Refs: []string{"[FR-1]"}},
+			{Path: "empty.go", SourceHash: hex.EncodeToString(h[:]), ExtractorVersion: store.SourceRefExtractorVersion, Refs: []string{}},
+			{Path: "large.dat", ExtractorVersion: store.SourceRefExtractorVersion, Excluded: "oversize"},
+		},
+	}
+	p.MembershipHash = store.SourceRefMembershipHash(p.Rows)
+	return p
+}

+func generationPlanCall(t *testing.T, b *generationVerifyBackend, scope string) map[string]any {
+	t.Helper()
+	args := map[string]any{
+		"service": "svc", "source_scope": scope,
+		"tasks": []any{map[string]any{"id": "T-1", "title": "reference", "symbol": "DoWork", "spec_ids": []string{"[FR-1]"}, "claimed": true}},
+	}
+	return roundtrip(t, mcp.NewServer(b), request{JSONRPC: "2.0", ID: 1, Method: "tools/call", Params: map[string]any{"name": "verify_plan", "arguments": args}})
+}

+func TestVerifyPlanGenerationProjectionExplicitAndUnknown(t *testing.T) {
+	b := &generationVerifyBackend{verifyFakeBackend: newVerifyBackend(), p: generationFixture(), found: true}
+	resp := generationPlanCall(t, b, store.SourceRefScopeIngestGeneration)
+	if resp["error"] != nil || b.scans != 0 {
+		t.Fatalf("generation request failed or scanned live source: %v scans=%d", resp, b.scans)
+	}
+	p := xtraPayload(t, resp)
+	if p["source_scope"] != store.SourceRefScopeIngestGeneration || p["current_worktree_freshness"] != "unknown" {
+		t.Fatalf("scope disclosure: %v", p)
+	}
+	proj := p["source_reference_projection"].(map[string]any)
+	if proj["examined"] != float64(2) || proj["total"] != float64(3) || proj["complete"] != false {
+		t.Fatalf("coverage: %v", proj)
+	}
+	ex := proj["excluded"].([]any)
+	if len(ex) != 1 || ex[0].(map[string]any)["path"] != "large.dat" || ex[0].(map[string]any)["reason"] != "oversize" {
+		t.Fatalf("exclusions: %v", ex)
+	}
+	task := p["tasks"].([]any)[0].(map[string]any)
+	if task["status"] != "unknown" || task["label"] != "spec-generation-only" {
+		t.Fatalf("generation facts falsely gated a current row: %v", task)
+	}
+	_ = generationPlanCall(t, b, "current_worktree")
+	if b.scans != 1 {
+		t.Fatalf("default live scan bypassed: scans=%d", b.scans)
+	}
+}

+func TestVerifyPlanGenerationRefusesMissingOrInvalidSeal(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, mutate := range []struct {
+		name string
+		fn   func(*generationVerifyBackend)
+	}{
+		{"old store", func(b *generationVerifyBackend) { b.found = false }},
+		{"stale watermark", func(b *generationVerifyBackend) { b.p.Watermark = "" }},
+		{"stale root", func(b *generationVerifyBackend) { b.p.Root = "" }},
+		{"policy", func(b *generationVerifyBackend) { b.p.Policy = "" }},
+		{"version", func(b *generationVerifyBackend) { b.p.ExtractorVersion = "old" }},
+		{"membership", func(b *generationVerifyBackend) { b.p.Rows = b.p.Rows[:2] }},
+		{"ref hash", func(b *generationVerifyBackend) {
+			b.p.Rows[0].SourceHash = "bad"
+			b.p.MembershipHash = store.SourceRefMembershipHash(b.p.Rows)
+		}},
+		{"nil refs", func(b *generationVerifyBackend) {
+			b.p.Rows[1].Refs = nil
+			b.p.MembershipHash = store.SourceRefMembershipHash(b.p.Rows)
+		}},
+	} {
+		t.Run(mutate.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			b := &generationVerifyBackend{verifyFakeBackend: newVerifyBackend(), p: generationFixture(), found: true}
+			mutate.fn(b)
+			resp := generationPlanCall(t, b, store.SourceRefScopeIngestGeneration)
+			if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(respErrorText(resp)), "reference facts") || b.scans != 0 {
+				t.Fatalf("invalid projection accepted or live fallback: %v scans=%d", resp, b.scans)
+			}
+		})
+	}
+}

+func TestVerifyPlanGenerationRejectsUnknownScope(t *testing.T) {

+	resp := generationPlanCall(t, b, "unknown")
+	if !strings.Contains(respErrorText(resp), "unsupported source_scope") || b.scans != 0 {

+	}

+func respErrorText(resp map[string]any) string {
+	err, ok := resp["error"].(map[string]any)
+	if !ok {
+		return ""
+	}
+	msg, _ := err["message"].(string)
+	return msg
+}

+package memo

+import (
+	"context"

+// Same-watermark package refresh must admit new raw-call demand; a held
+// graph stays immutable. Resolved-only graphs are evicted rather than
+// acquiring syntax edges. A new watermark must replace the old snapshot.
+func TestSuffixDemandGraphStorePatchAndFreshness(t *testing.T) {
+	isolateGraphStore(t)
+	ctx := context.Background()
+	sc := Scope{Store: "suffix-demand-test", Service: "fixture", Watermark: "w1"}
+	caller := core.SymbolNode{Service: "fixture", Package: "api", Name: "Entry", Kind: core.KindGoFunc, FilePath: "api/entry.go"}
+	target := core.SymbolNode{Service: "fixture", Package: "Handlers", Name: "Handle.Execute", Kind: core.KindCSharpMethod, FilePath: "lib/handle.cs"}
+	nodes := []core.SymbolNode{caller, target}
+	snap, err := SnapshotFor(ctx, sc, func(context.Context) ([]core.SymbolNode, error) { return nodes, nil })
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	old := map[GraphKind]*callgraph.Graph{}
+	for _, kind := range []GraphKind{GraphSyntax, GraphBoth, GraphResolved} {
+		old[kind], err = GraphFor(ctx, snap, kind, nil)
+		if err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+	}
+	caller.Calls = []string{"receiver.Execute"}
+	PatchPackage(sc, "api", []core.SymbolNode{caller}, nil)
+	patched, err := SnapshotFor(ctx, sc, func(context.Context) ([]core.SymbolNode, error) {
+		t.Fatal("patch lost cached snapshot")
+		return nil, nil
+	})
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	for _, kind := range []GraphKind{GraphSyntax, GraphBoth, GraphResolved} {
+		got, err := GraphFor(ctx, patched, kind, nil)
+		if err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+		want := kind != GraphResolved
+		if callgraph.Reachable(got, caller.Key(), target.Key()) != want {
+			t.Fatalf("kind %v: newly demanded call changed", kind)
+		}
+		if old[kind].EdgeCount() != 0 {
+			t.Fatal("held prepatch graph mutated")
+		}
+	}
+	sc.Watermark = "w2"
+	fresh, err := SnapshotFor(ctx, sc, func(context.Context) ([]core.SymbolNode, error) { return nodes, nil })
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	for _, kind := range []GraphKind{GraphSyntax, GraphBoth, GraphResolved} {
+		got, err := GraphFor(ctx, fresh, kind, nil)
+		if err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+		if got.EdgeCount() != 0 {
+			t.Fatalf("kind %v reused stale query at new watermark", kind)
+		}
+	}
+}

+// A typed-read failure is an error, never a cached syntax-only success.
+// Retrying the same scope after recovery must build the typed graph.
+func TestSuffixDemandGraphStoreTypedFailure(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, kind := range []GraphKind{GraphBoth, GraphResolved} {
+		t.Run(string(kind), func(t *testing.T) {
+			isolateGraphStore(t)
+			ctx := context.Background()
+			sc := Scope{Store: "suffix-demand-failure", Service: "svc", Watermark: "w1"}
+			nodes := fixtureNodes()
+			snap, err := SnapshotFor(ctx, sc, func(context.Context) ([]core.SymbolNode, error) { return nodes, nil })
+			if err != nil {
+				t.Fatal(err)
+			}
+			failure := errors.New("typed read failed")
+			got, err := GraphFor(ctx, snap, kind, func(context.Context) ([]core.Edge, error) { return nil, failure })
+			if got != nil || !errors.Is(err, failure) {
+				t.Fatalf("failure returned graph=%v error=%v", got, err)
+			}
+			if _, ok := graphGroup.Peek(graphKey{sc, kind}); ok {
+				t.Fatal("failed graph cached")
+			}
+			edge := core.Edge{FromSymbol: nodes[0].Key(), ToSymbol: nodes[3].Key(), FromFile: nodes[0].FilePath, Kind: core.EdgeDirect}
+			got, err = GraphFor(ctx, snap, kind, func(context.Context) ([]core.Edge, error) { return []core.Edge{edge}, nil })
+			if err != nil || got == nil || !callgraph.Reachable(got, edge.FromSymbol, edge.ToSymbol) {
+				t.Fatalf("typed recovery graph=%v error=%v", got, err)
+			}
+		})
+	}

+package scip
+
+import (
+	"os"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/geoffmilleraz/fathom/internal/core"

+// scip-typescript0.4.0 names a property assignment's definition value0:,
+// value1:, etc (the existing D2 fixture in langbench/scip_ts_test.go).
+// Those are distinct from first./second. even on the same source line.
+// This fixture is synthetic SCIP with real syntax extraction, not a retained
+// compiler run or a new language-grade measurement.
+func TestImportIndex_TSObjectLiteralDoesNotAliasItsContainer(t *testing.T) {
+	const path = "ts-object-literal-identity.js"
+	src, err := os.ReadFile("testdata/" + path)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	e, err := extractor.NewTSExtractor("javascript")
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	defer e.Close()
+	nodes, err := e.Extract("s", path, src)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	const pre = "scip-typescript npm fixture 1.0 `ts-object-literal-identity.js`/"
+	def := func(sym string, enc []int32, rng ...int32) *scippb.Occurrence {
+		return &scippb.Occurrence{Symbol: pre + sym, Range: rng, EnclosingRange: enc, SymbolRoles: int32(scippb.SymbolRole_Definition)}
+	}
+	ref := func(sym string, rng ...int32) *scippb.Occurrence {
+		return &scippb.Occurrence{Symbol: pre + sym, Range: rng}
+	}
+	idx := &scippb.Index{Metadata: &scippb.Metadata{ToolInfo: &scippb.ToolInfo{Name: "scip-typescript", Version: "0.4.0"}},
+		Documents: []*scippb.Document{{RelativePath: path, Language: "javascript", Occurrences: []*scippb.Occurrence{
+			def("", []int32{0, 0, 5, 0}, 0, 0, 0),
+			def("first.", nil, 0, 13, 18),
+			def("value0:", nil, 0, 23, 28),
+			def("second.", nil, 1, 13, 19),
+			def("value1:", nil, 1, 24, 29),
+			def("read().", []int32{2, 0, 4, 1}, 2, 16, 20),
+			ref("first.", 3, 9, 14), ref("value0:", 3, 15, 20),
+			ref("second.", 3, 23, 29), ref("value1:", 3, 30, 35),
+		}}}}
+	imp := importOf(t, idx, nodes)
+	if imp.Report.Unmapped != 2 || imp.Report.Direct != 2 || imp.Report.Unresolved != 0 || imp.Report.Skipped["unmapped-endpoint"] != 2 {
+		t.Fatalf("object properties must stay internal-unmapped while their real containers map: %+v", imp.Report)
+	}
+	if got := len(edgePairs(imp)); got != 2 {
+		t.Fatalf("%d edges: an unsupported property fabricated a duplicate container edge", got)
+	}
+}

+	nodes := []core.SymbolNode{

+		{Service: "s", Package: "a", Name: "value0", Kind: "JSConst", FilePath: "a.js", Line: 2, EndLine: 2},
+	}
+	byLoc, byLeaf := indexNodesByLocation(nodes), indexNodesByFileAndLeaf(nodes)
+	for _, line := range []int32{0, 99} {
+		if n, mapped, _ := resolveDefinition(byLoc, byLeaf, "a.js", line, "scip-typescript npm fixture 1 a/value0:", false); mapped {
+			t.Fatalf("property joined %s via line/leaf at source line %d", n.Name, line)
+		}
+	}
+	// Real globals/fields/methods retain the existing position join. In
+	// particular C# constructor spelling differs from the extracted type
+	// name; no general same-name condition may be added for this repair.
+	for _, tc := range []struct{ sym, name, kind string }{
+		{"scip-typescript npm fixture 1 a/cfg.", "cfg", "JSConst"},
+		{"scip-typescript npm fixture 1 a/Box#value.", "Box.value", "JSField"},
+		{"scip-typescript npm fixture 1 a/Box#read().", "Box.read", "JSMethod"},
+		{"scip-dotnet nuget fixture 1 Box#Value.", "Box.Value", "CSharpProperty"},
+		{"scip-dotnet nuget fixture 1 Box#`#ctor`().", "Box.Box", "CSharpMethod"},
+		{"scip-dotnet nuget fixture 1 Box#Read().", "Box.Read", "CSharpMethod"},
+	} {
+		node := core.SymbolNode{Service: "s", Package: "a", Name: tc.name, Kind: core.SourceKind(tc.kind), FilePath: "a.js", Line: 1, EndLine: 1}
+		n, mapped, _ := resolveDefinition(indexNodesByLocation([]core.SymbolNode{node}), indexNodesByFileAndLeaf([]core.SymbolNode{node}), "a.js", 0, tc.sym, false)
+		if !mapped || n.Key() != node.Key() {
+			t.Errorf("legitimate producer-specific position join changed for %s", tc.sym)
+		}
+	}
+}

+package scip
+
+// Source receipts bind an externally produced index to the local inputs that
+// produced it. They are freshness declarations, not signatures or execution
+// attestations. Existing producers remain compatible without a receipt;
+// scip-dotnet requires one because its generated projects/references are mutable.
+import (
+	"bytes"
+	"context"
+	"crypto/sha256"
+	"encoding/hex"
+	"encoding/json"
+	"errors"
+	"fmt"
+	"io"
+	"net/url"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"regexp"
+	"slices"
+	"strings"
+
+	scippb "github.com/geoffmilleraz/fathom/third_party/scip"
+	"google.golang.org/protobuf/encoding/protowire"
+	"google.golang.org/protobuf/proto"
+)
+
+const SourceReceiptSchema = "fathom.scip.source/v1"
+
+// ErrSourceReceipt marks an operational refusal, rather than a legacy optional
+// enrichment warning. Callers must not report the typed import as successful.
+var ErrSourceReceipt = errors.New("SCIP source receipt refused")
+
+const sourceReceiptLimit = 8 << 20
+const sourceInputLimit = 20000
+const sourceInputBytesLimit int64 = 1 << 30
+const inventoryEntryLimit = 100000
+
+type SourceReceipt struct {
+	Schema      string            `json:"schema"`
+	Status      string            `json:"status"`
+	Root        string            `json:"root"`
+	IndexSHA256 string            `json:"index_sha256"`
+	Producer    SourceProducer    `json:"producer"`
+	Inputs      []SourceInput     `json:"inputs"`
+	Inventories []SourceInventory `json:"inventories"`
+}
+type SourceProducer struct {
+	Name                string `json:"name"`
+	Version             string `json:"version"`
+	DistributionVersion string `json:"distribution_version,omitempty"`
+	PackageSHA256       string `json:"package_sha256,omitempty"`
+	PackagePath         string `json:"package_path,omitempty"`
+}
+type SourceInput struct {
+	Path   string `json:"path"`
+	SHA256 string `json:"sha256"`
+}
+type SourceInventory struct {
+	Root    string   `json:"root"`
+	Pattern string   `json:"pattern"`
+	Paths   []string `json:"paths"`
+}
+
+// ValidateSourceReceipt returns bound=true when this index must carry a fresh
+// sidecar. A failure never authorizes use of a previous import. The client owns
+// clearing that index's namespace and evicting graph memos before returning it.
+func ValidateSourceReceipt(ctx context.Context, root, path string, raw []byte, required ...bool) (bound bool, err error) {
+	var index scippb.Index
+	decodeErr := proto.Unmarshal(raw, &index)
+	_, statErr := os.Stat(path + ".receipt.json")
+	bound = statErr == nil || !os.IsNotExist(statErr) || index.GetMetadata().GetToolInfo().GetName() == "scip-dotnet" || len(required) > 0 && required[0]
+	if !bound {
+		return false, nil
+	}
+	refuse := func(format string, args ...any) (bool, error) {
+		return true, fmt.Errorf("%w: %s", ErrSourceReceipt, fmt.Sprintf(format, args...))
+	}
+	if decodeErr != nil {
+		return refuse("index decode: %v", decodeErr)
+	}
+	file, openErr := os.Open(path + ".receipt.json")
+	if openErr != nil {
+		return refuse("receipt: %v", openErr)
+	}
+	defer file.Close()
+	data, readErr := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(file, sourceReceiptLimit+1))
+	if readErr != nil {
+		return refuse("receipt: %v", readErr)
+	}
+	if len(data) > sourceReceiptLimit {
+		return refuse("receipt exceeds %d bytes", sourceReceiptLimit)
+	}
+	var receipt SourceReceipt
+	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(data))
+	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
+	if decodeErr := decoder.Decode(&receipt); decodeErr != nil {
+		return refuse("receipt JSON: %v", decodeErr)
+	}
+	if decoder.Decode(new(any)) != io.EOF {
+		return refuse("receipt has trailing JSON")
+	}
+	if receipt.Schema != SourceReceiptSchema {
+		return refuse("schema %q is unsupported", receipt.Schema)
+	}
+	if receipt.Status != "complete" {
+		return refuse("status is %q, not complete", receipt.Status)
+	}
+	if !filepath.IsAbs(receipt.Root) {
+		return refuse("root must be absolute")
+	}
+	actualRoot, rootErr := sourceCanonical(root)
+	if rootErr != nil {
+		return refuse("service root: %v", rootErr)
+	}
+	receiptRoot, rootErr := sourceCanonical(receipt.Root)
+	if rootErr != nil || actualRoot != receiptRoot {
+		return refuse("root differs from the service root")
+	}
+	uri, uriErr := url.Parse(index.GetMetadata().GetProjectRoot())
+	if uriErr != nil || uri.Scheme != "file" || uri.Host != "" || !filepath.IsAbs(filepath.FromSlash(uri.Path)) {
+		return refuse("index project root is not a local file URI")
+	}
+	indexRoot, rootErr := sourceCanonical(filepath.FromSlash(uri.Path))
+	if rootErr != nil || indexRoot != actualRoot {
+		return refuse("index project root differs from the service root")
+	}
+	sum := sha256.Sum256(raw)
+	if receipt.IndexSHA256 != hex.EncodeToString(sum[:]) {
+		return refuse("index hash differs")
+	}
+	currentIndexHash, hashErr := sourceHash(ctx, path, int64(len(raw)))
+	if hashErr != nil || currentIndexHash != receipt.IndexSHA256 {
+		return refuse("index changed since it was read")
+	}
+	producer := index.GetMetadata().GetToolInfo()
+	if receipt.Producer.Name != producer.GetName() || receipt.Producer.Version != producer.GetVersion() {
+		return refuse("producer differs from the index metadata")
+	}
+	dotnet := producer.GetName() == "scip-dotnet"
+	if dotnet && (receipt.Producer.DistributionVersion == "" || receipt.Producer.PackagePath == "" || !sourceDigest(receipt.Producer.PackageSHA256)) {
+		return refuse("producer distribution/package identity is missing")
+	}
+
+	if len(receipt.Inputs) == 0 || len(receipt.Inputs) > sourceInputLimit {
+		return refuse("input count is outside 1..%d", sourceInputLimit)
+	}
+	inputs := map[string]string{}
+	var inputBytes int64
+	for _, input := range receipt.Inputs {
+		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
+			return refuse("input validation: %v", err)
+		}
+		absolute, pathErr := sourcePath(actualRoot, input.Path)
+		if pathErr != nil {
+			return refuse("input %q: %v", input.Path, pathErr)
+		}
+		if _, duplicate := inputs[absolute]; duplicate {
+			return refuse("duplicate input %q", input.Path)
+		}
+		if !sourceDigest(input.SHA256) {
+			return refuse("input %q has an invalid SHA256", input.Path)
+		}
+		info, statErr := os.Stat(absolute)
+		if statErr != nil {
+			return refuse("input %q: %v", input.Path, statErr)
+		}
+		if info.Size() > sourceInputBytesLimit-inputBytes {
+			return refuse("input byte budget exceeded at %q", input.Path)
+		}
+		inputBytes += info.Size()
+		actual, hashErr := sourceHash(ctx, absolute, info.Size())
+		if hashErr != nil {
+			return refuse("input %q: %v", input.Path, hashErr)
+		}
+		if actual != input.SHA256 {
+			return refuse("input hash changed: %s", input.Path)
+		}
+		inputs[absolute] = input.SHA256
+	}
+
+	if dotnet {
+		packagePath, err := sourcePath(actualRoot, receipt.Producer.PackagePath)
+		if err != nil || inputs[packagePath] != receipt.Producer.PackageSHA256 {
+			return refuse("producer package is not bound by an input hash")
+		}
+		project, reference := false, false
+		for path := range inputs {
+			project = project || strings.EqualFold(filepath.Ext(path), ".csproj")
+			reference = reference || strings.EqualFold(filepath.Ext(path), ".dll")
+		}
+		if !project || !reference {
+			return refuse("producer inputs require real project and reference assembly hashes")
+		}
+	}
+	if len(receipt.Inventories) == 0 {
+		return refuse("source inventory is missing")
+	}
+	covered := map[string]bool{}
+	for _, inventory := range receipt.Inventories {
+		scope, pathErr := sourcePath(actualRoot, inventory.Root)
+		if pathErr != nil || !sourceWithin(actualRoot, scope) {
+			return refuse("inventory root must be within the service")
+		}
+		if !sourcePattern(inventory.Pattern) {
+			return refuse("inventory pattern %q must be a simple *.extension", inventory.Pattern)
+		}
+		var actual []string
+		seen := 0
+		walkErr := filepath.WalkDir(scope, func(path string, entry os.DirEntry, walkErr error) error {
+			if walkErr != nil {
+				return walkErr
+			}
+			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+			seen++
+			if seen > inventoryEntryLimit {
+				return fmt.Errorf("inventory entry limit exceeded")
+			}
+			if entry.IsDir() {
+				return nil
+			}
+			match, _ := filepath.Match(inventory.Pattern, entry.Name())
+			if !match {
+				return nil
+			}
+			info, err := entry.Info()
+			if err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+			if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
+				return fmt.Errorf("inventory source is not a regular file: %s", path)
+			}
+			canonical, err := sourceCanonical(path)
+			if err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+			actual = append(actual, canonical)
+			return nil
+		})
+		if walkErr != nil {
+			return refuse("inventory %q: %v", inventory.Root, walkErr)
+		}
+		expected := make([]string, 0, len(inventory.Paths))
+		for _, name := range inventory.Paths {
+			absolute, pathErr := sourcePath(actualRoot, name)
+			if pathErr != nil || !sourceWithin(scope, absolute) {
+				return refuse("inventory path %q is outside its scope", name)
+			}
+			if _, ok := inputs[absolute]; !ok {
+				return refuse("inventory path %q has no input hash", name)
+			}
+			expected = append(expected, absolute)
+			covered[absolute] = true
+		}
+		slices.Sort(actual)
+		slices.Sort(expected)
+		if !slices.Equal(actual, expected) {
+			return refuse("inventory changed: %s/%s", inventory.Root, inventory.Pattern)
+		}
+	}
+	for _, document := range index.GetDocuments() {
+		relative := filepath.FromSlash(document.GetRelativePath())
+		if filepath.IsAbs(relative) || relative == "." || relative == ".." || strings.HasPrefix(relative, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)) {
+			return refuse("document path is not root-relative")
+		}
+		absolute, pathErr := sourcePath(actualRoot, relative)
+		if pathErr != nil {
+			return refuse("document %q: %v", relative, pathErr)
+		}
+		if _, ok := inputs[absolute]; !ok {
+			return refuse("document %q has no source hash", relative)
+		}
+		if !covered[absolute] {
+			return refuse("document %q is outside the declared inventories", relative)
+		}
+	}
+	if len(index.GetDocuments()) == 0 {
+		return refuse("index has no documents")
+	}
+	return true, nil
+}
+
+func sourceCanonical(path string) (string, error) {
+	absolute, err := filepath.Abs(path)
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", err
+	}
+	return filepath.EvalSymlinks(absolute)
+}
+func sourcePath(root, path string) (string, error) {
+	if path == "" {
+		return "", fmt.Errorf("empty path")
+	}
+	if !filepath.IsAbs(path) {
+		path = filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(path))
+	}
+	return sourceCanonical(path)
+}
+func sourceWithin(root, path string) bool {
+	relative, err := filepath.Rel(root, path)
+	return err == nil && relative != ".." && !strings.HasPrefix(relative, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)) && !filepath.IsAbs(relative)
+}
+func sourceDigest(value string) bool {
+	if len(value) != 64 {
+		return false
+	}
+	decoded, err := hex.DecodeString(value)
+	return err == nil && len(decoded) == 32 && strings.ToLower(value) == value
+}
+func sourcePattern(value string) bool {
+	return regexp.MustCompile(`^\*\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$`).MatchString(value)
+}
+func sourceHash(ctx context.Context, path string, expectedSize int64) (string, error) {
+	file, err := os.Open(path)
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", err
+	}
+	defer file.Close()
+	info, err := file.Stat()
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", err
+	}
+	if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
+		return "", fmt.Errorf("not a regular file")
+	}
+	if info.Size() != expectedSize {
+		return "", fmt.Errorf("file size changed during validation")
+	}
+	hash := sha256.New()
+	n, err := io.Copy(hash, sourceContextReader{ctx: ctx, reader: io.LimitReader(file, expectedSize+1)})
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", err
+	}
+	if n != expectedSize {
+		return "", fmt.Errorf("file size changed during hashing")
+	}
+	return hex.EncodeToString(hash.Sum(nil)), nil
+}
+
+// SourceReceiptExpected only reads the bounded metadata prefix of a SCIP file.
+// Metadata must be first under the SCIP streaming contract. It never decodes a
+// large legacy index merely to decide whether automatic source validation applies.
+func SourceReceiptExpected(path string) bool {
+	if _, err := os.Stat(path + ".receipt.json"); err == nil || !os.IsNotExist(err) {
+		return true
+	}
+	file, err := os.Open(path)
+	if err != nil {
+		return false
+	}
+	defer file.Close()
+	raw, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(file, 1<<20))
+	if err != nil {
+		return false
+	}
+	number, wire, n := protowire.ConsumeTag(raw)
+	if n < 0 || number != 1 || wire != protowire.BytesType {
+		return false
+	}
+	value, n := protowire.ConsumeBytes(raw[n:])
+	if n < 0 {
+		return false
+	}
+	var metadata scippb.Metadata
+	if proto.Unmarshal(value, &metadata) != nil {
+		return false
+	}
+	return metadata.GetToolInfo().GetName() == "scip-dotnet"
+}
+
+type sourceContextReader struct {
+	ctx    context.Context
+	reader io.Reader
+}
+
+func (r sourceContextReader) Read(buffer []byte) (int, error) {
+	if err := r.ctx.Err(); err != nil {
+		return 0, err
+	}
+	return r.reader.Read(buffer)
+}

+func receiptHash(data []byte) string { h := sha256.Sum256(data); return hex.EncodeToString(h[:]) }
+func receiptFixture(t *testing.T) (string, string, []byte, map[string]any) {
+	t.Helper()
+	root := t.TempDir()
+	path := filepath.Join(root, "index.scip")
+	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(root, "src"), 0755); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	for name, body := range map[string]string{"src/Actor.cs": "class Actor {}\n", "Game.csproj": "<Project/>\n", "sdk.dll": "reference bytes", "producer.nupkg": "producer bytes"} {
+		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, name), []byte(body), 0644); err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+	}
+	raw, err := proto.Marshal(&scippb.Index{Metadata: &scippb.Metadata{ProjectRoot: "file://" + filepath.ToSlash(root), ToolInfo: &scippb.ToolInfo{Name: "scip-dotnet", Version: "0.1.0-SNAPSHOT"}}, Documents: []*scippb.Document{{RelativePath: "src/Actor.cs", Language: "C#"}}})
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if err := os.WriteFile(path, raw, 0644); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	var inputs []any
+	for _, name := range []string{"src/Actor.cs", "Game.csproj", "sdk.dll", "producer.nupkg"} {
+		data, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, name))
+		if err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+		inputs = append(inputs, map[string]any{"path": name, "sha256": receiptHash(data)})
+	}
+	receipt := map[string]any{"schema": "fathom.scip.source/v1", "status": "complete", "root": root, "index_sha256": receiptHash(raw), "producer": map[string]any{"name": "scip-dotnet", "version": "0.1.0-SNAPSHOT", "distribution_version": "0.2.14", "package_path": "producer.nupkg", "package_sha256": receiptHash([]byte("producer bytes"))}, "inputs": inputs, "inventories": []any{map[string]any{"root": "src", "pattern": "*.cs", "paths": []string{"src/Actor.cs"}}}}
+	writeReceipt(t, path, receipt)
+	return root, path, raw, receipt
+}
+func writeReceipt(t *testing.T, path string, value any) {
+	t.Helper()
+	raw, err := json.Marshal(value)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if err := os.WriteFile(path+".receipt.json", raw, 0644); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+}
+func TestSourceReceiptFreshAndLegacyCompatibility(t *testing.T) {
+	root, path, raw, _ := receiptFixture(t)
+	bound, err := ValidateSourceReceipt(context.Background(), root, path, raw)
+	if !bound || err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("fresh bound=%v err=%v", bound, err)
+	}
+	idx := BuildTSFixtureIndex()
+	legacy, err := proto.Marshal(idx)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if err := os.Remove(path + ".receipt.json"); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	bound, err = ValidateSourceReceipt(context.Background(), root, path, legacy)
+	if bound || err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("legacy bound=%v err=%v", bound, err)
+	}
+}
+func TestSourceReceiptRefusesStaleMissingAndMixedInputs(t *testing.T) {
+	cases := []struct {
+		name, want string
+		mutate     func(*testing.T, string, string, map[string]any)
+	}{
+		{"missing receipt", "receipt", func(t *testing.T, r, p string, v map[string]any) {
+			if err := os.Remove(p + ".receipt.json"); err != nil {
+				t.Fatal(err)
+			}
+		}},
+		{"source edit", "Actor.cs", func(t *testing.T, r, p string, v map[string]any) {
+			if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(r, "src/Actor.cs"), []byte("class Other {}"), 0644); err != nil {
+				t.Fatal(err)
+			}
+		}},
+		{"source deletion", "Actor.cs", func(t *testing.T, r, p string, v map[string]any) {
+			if err := os.Remove(filepath.Join(r, "src/Actor.cs")); err != nil {
+				t.Fatal(err)
+			}
+		}},
+		{"source addition", "inventory", func(t *testing.T, r, p string, v map[string]any) {
+			if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(r, "src/New.cs"), []byte("class New {}"), 0644); err != nil {
+				t.Fatal(err)
+			}
+		}},
+		{"project drift", "Game.csproj", func(t *testing.T, r, p string, v map[string]any) {
+			if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(r, "Game.csproj"), []byte("<Project Changed='yes'/>"), 0644); err != nil {
+				t.Fatal(err)
+			}
+		}},
+		{"reference drift", "sdk.dll", func(t *testing.T, r, p string, v map[string]any) {
+			if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(r, "sdk.dll"), []byte("new reference"), 0644); err != nil {
+				t.Fatal(err)
+			}
+		}},
+		{"failed attempt", "status", func(t *testing.T, r, p string, v map[string]any) { v["status"] = "started"; writeReceipt(t, p, v) }},
+		{"index hash mismatch", "index hash", func(t *testing.T, r, p string, v map[string]any) {
+			v["index_sha256"] = strings.Repeat("0", 64)
+			writeReceipt(t, p, v)
+		}},
+		{"index changed after read", "index changed", func(t *testing.T, r, p string, v map[string]any) {
+			if err := os.WriteFile(p, []byte("different index bytes"), 0644); err != nil {
+				t.Fatal(err)
+			}
+		}},
+		{"missing producer package", "package identity", func(t *testing.T, r, p string, v map[string]any) {
+			delete(v["producer"].(map[string]any), "package_path")
+			writeReceipt(t, p, v)
+		}},
+		{"unbound producer package", "package is not bound", func(t *testing.T, r, p string, v map[string]any) {
+			v["inputs"] = v["inputs"].([]any)[:3]
+			writeReceipt(t, p, v)
+		}},
+		{"missing project hash", "project and reference", func(t *testing.T, r, p string, v map[string]any) {
+			inputs := v["inputs"].([]any)
+			v["inputs"] = append(inputs[:1], inputs[2:]...)

+// ExtractRefsBytes is ExtractRefs over source bytes. Returned token strings own
+// their bytes, so retaining a reference neither retains nor aliases the file.
+func ExtractRefsBytes(text []byte) []string {
+	raw := defaultPattern.FindAll(text, -1)
+	if len(raw) == 0 {
+		return nil
+	}
+	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(raw))
+	for _, match := range raw {
+		seen[string(match)] = struct{}{}
+	}
+	out := make([]string, 0, len(seen))
+	for id := range seen {
+		out = append(out, id)
+	}
+	sort.Strings(out)
+	return out
+}

 // is one of the supplied prefixes.  An empty prefix list returns nil.  The
 // result is sorted and deduplicated.

+package sdd_test

+func TestExtractRefsBytesEquivalent(t *testing.T) {
+	long := "[FR-" + strings.Repeat("7", 32<<10) + "]"
+	cases := []string{
+		"", "no refs", "[US-1][EP-22][FR-333][NFR-4] [FR-333]",
+		"[X-1] [FR-x] [FR-] [fr-1] [FR-1x] [OTHER-2] [NFR-02]",
+		"\xff[FR-1]\x00[EP-3]\xfe", "x[FR-1]y [[US-2]] [NFR-3]\n",
+		strings.Repeat("[FR-1][US-2]", 16384),
+		strings.Repeat("x", 8190) + "[NFR-7]" + long,
+	}
+	for i, text := range cases {
+		if got, want := sdd.ExtractRefsBytes([]byte(text)), sdd.ExtractRefs(text); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
+			t.Fatalf("case %d: got %v, want %v", i, got, want)
+		}
+	}
+}
+
+func TestExtractRefsBytesOwnsTokensFromReusedBuffer(t *testing.T) {
+	long := "[FR-" + strings.Repeat("3", 32<<10) + "]"
+	buffer := []byte("[US-1]" + strings.Repeat("[NFR-2]", 8192) + long)
+	want := sdd.ExtractRefs(string(buffer))
+	got := sdd.ExtractRefsBytes(buffer)
+	for i := range buffer {
+		buffer[i] = 'x'
+	}
+	if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
+		t.Fatalf("mutation changed previously extracted owned tokens: got %v, want %v", got, want)
+	}
+	copy(buffer, []byte("[EP-9]"))
+	if next := sdd.ExtractRefsBytes(buffer); !reflect.DeepEqual(next, []string{"[EP-9]"}) {
+		t.Fatalf("reused buffer extraction = %v", next)
+	}
+	if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
+		t.Fatal("a later extraction changed the earlier result")
+	}
+	if sdd.ExtractRefsBytes(bytes.Repeat([]byte{'x'}, 1<<20)) != nil {
+		t.Fatal("reference-free source produced refs")
+	}
+}

+func TestNativeTestJoinsAreUnknownToLegacySQLReaders(t *testing.T) {
+	st, err := Open(filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "native.sqlite"))
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	defer st.Close()
+	sqlStore := st.(*SQLiteStore)
+	ctx := context.Background()
+	native := TestRun{Suite: "EditMode", RunDigest: "native", NativeRunID: "n1", NativeJSON: `{"native":"binding"}`, Cases: []TestCase{{CaseID: "1", Status: "pass", TestSymbolKey: "svc::Workshop.BowlTests.Fits"}}}
+	legacy := TestRun{Suite: "unit", RunDigest: "go", Cases: []TestCase{{CaseID: "1", Status: "pass", TestSymbolKey: "svc::cart.TestAdd"}}}
+	if err = st.PutTestRuns(ctx, "svc", []TestRun{native, legacy}); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	// This is exactly the old reader's joined-case predicate. It must not expose
+	// any native key when that reader cannot validate its receipt or whole cohort.
+	var count int
+	if err = sqlStore.db.QueryRow(`SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_cases WHERE service_id='svc' AND run_digest='native' AND test_symbol_key!=''`).Scan(&count); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if count != 0 {
+		t.Fatalf("old reader sees %d native joins without native validation", count)
+	}
+	got, err := st.NewestTestCaseRuns(ctx, "svc")
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if len(got) != 2 {
+		t.Fatalf("current reader lost joins %+v", got)
+	}
+	for _, r := range got {
+		if r.RunDigest == "native" && r.NativeJSON == "" {
+			t.Fatal("native key escaped binding")
+		}
+	}
+}

+package store
+
+// Source reference facts are scoped to an indexed ingest generation. A nil
+// Refs means the bytes were not examined; an empty non-nil slice means they
+// were examined and contained no references. Neither is inferred from symbols.
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"crypto/sha256"
+	"database/sql"
+	"encoding/hex"
+	"encoding/json"
+	"fmt"
+	"sort"
+)
+
+const SourceRefExtractorVersion = "sdd-default-refs-v1"
+const SourceRefScopeIngestGeneration = "ingest_generation"
+
+type SourceRefFact struct {
+	Path             string
+	SourceHash       string // SHA-256 of the exact fetched bytes, independent of extractor epoch
+	ExtractorVersion string
+	Refs             []string
+	Excluded         string
+}
+
+type SourceRefProjection struct {
+	ServiceID                string
+	Scope                    string // ingest_generation on a read
+	CurrentWorktreeFreshness string // unknown on a read
+	Watermark                string
+	Root                     string
+	Policy                   string
+	ExtractorVersion         string
+	MembershipHash           string
+	ProducedAt               int64
+	Complete                 bool
+	Rows                     []SourceRefFact
+}
+
+type SourceRefProjectionReader interface {
+	ReadSourceRefProjection(context.Context, string) (SourceRefProjection, bool, error)
+}
+
+// SourceRefProjectionBackfillReader is ingest-only: call after Discover and
+// before the first content write. It may read the previous sealed generation
+// while the new run has already marked ingest_state in_progress.
+type SourceRefProjectionBackfillReader interface {
+	ReadSourceRefProjectionForBackfill(context.Context, string) (SourceRefProjection, bool, error)
+}
+
+type SourceRefProjectionInvalidator interface {
+	InvalidateSourceRefProjection(context.Context, string) error
+}
+
+func (s *SQLiteStore) InvalidateSourceRefProjection(ctx context.Context, service string) error {
+	_, err := s.db.ExecContext(ctx, `DELETE FROM source_ref_seals WHERE service_id=?`, service)
+	return err
+}
+
+func (m *MemoryStore) InvalidateSourceRefProjection(_ context.Context, service string) error {
+	m.mu.Lock()
+	defer m.mu.Unlock()
+	delete(m.sourceRefProjections, service)
+	return nil
+}
+
+// SourceRefMembershipHash seals ordered membership and every per-file fact.
+// JSON encoding avoids ambiguous concatenations.
+func SourceRefMembershipHash(rows []SourceRefFact) string {
+	copyRows := append([]SourceRefFact(nil), rows...)
+	sort.Slice(copyRows, func(i, j int) bool { return copyRows[i].Path < copyRows[j].Path })
+	b, _ := json.Marshal(copyRows)
+	h := sha256.Sum256(b)
+	return hex.EncodeToString(h[:])
+}
+
+func validSourceRefProjection(p SourceRefProjection) bool {
+	if p.ExtractorVersion != SourceRefExtractorVersion || p.MembershipHash != SourceRefMembershipHash(p.Rows) || p.Policy == "" || p.Root == "" || p.Watermark == "" {
+		return false
+	}
+	excluded := 0
+	for i, row := range p.Rows {
+		if row.Path == "" || row.ExtractorVersion != p.ExtractorVersion || (i > 0 && p.Rows[i-1].Path >= row.Path) {
+			return false
+		}
+		if row.Excluded == "" && (row.SourceHash == "" || row.Refs == nil) {
+			return false
+		}
+		if row.SourceHash != "" {
+			decoded, err := hex.DecodeString(row.SourceHash)
+			if err != nil || len(decoded) != sha256.Size {
+				return false
+			}
+		}
+		if row.Excluded != "" && row.Refs != nil {
+			return false
+		}
+		if row.Excluded != "" {
+			excluded++
+		}
+		if p.Complete && row.Excluded != "" {
+			return false
+		}
+	}
+	return p.Complete == (excluded == 0)
+}
+
+// ValidSourceRefProjection is the read-side integrity check for optional
+// consumers. It checks the seal and every fact without consulting live files.
+func ValidSourceRefProjection(p SourceRefProjection) bool { return validSourceRefProjection(p) }
+
+func writeSourceRefProjectionTx(ctx context.Context, tx *sql.Tx, meta ServiceMeta, files []FileStat, p *SourceRefProjection) error {
+	if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `DELETE FROM source_ref_seals WHERE service_id = ?`, meta.ServiceID); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `DELETE FROM source_ref_facts WHERE service_id = ?`, meta.ServiceID); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	if p == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	p.ServiceID, p.Watermark, p.Root = meta.ServiceID, WatermarkOf(meta), meta.Path
+	p.MembershipHash = SourceRefMembershipHash(p.Rows)
+	if !validSourceRefProjection(*p) {
+		return fmt.Errorf("invalid source reference projection")
+	}
+	if len(files) != len(p.Rows) {
+		return fmt.Errorf("source reference membership differs from file_stats")
+	}
+	paths := make([]FileStat, 0, len(files))
+	for _, file := range files {
+		paths = append(paths, file)
+	}
+	sort.Slice(paths, func(i, j int) bool { return paths[i].Path < paths[j].Path })
+	for i, file := range paths {
+		if file.Path != p.Rows[i].Path || (p.Rows[i].Excluded != "" && file.Excluded != p.Rows[i].Excluded) {
+			return fmt.Errorf("source reference membership differs from file_stats")
+		}
+	}
+	for _, row := range p.Rows {
+		var refs any
+		if row.Refs != nil {
+			b, _ := json.Marshal(row.Refs)
+			refs = string(b)
+		}
+		if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `INSERT INTO source_ref_facts(service_id,path,source_hash,extractor_version,refs_json,excluded) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)`, meta.ServiceID, row.Path, row.SourceHash, row.ExtractorVersion, refs, row.Excluded); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+	}
+	complete := 0
+	if p.Complete {
+		complete = 1
+	}
+	_, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `INSERT INTO source_ref_seals(service_id,watermark,root,policy,extractor_version,membership_hash,produced_at,complete) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)`, meta.ServiceID, p.Watermark, p.Root, p.Policy, p.ExtractorVersion, p.MembershipHash, p.ProducedAt, complete)
+	return err
+}
+
+// ReadSourceRefProjection returns a compact, self-checked indexed-generation
+// snapshot. ok=false covers absent, interrupted, mixed or corrupt generations.
+func (s *SQLiteStore) ReadSourceRefProjection(ctx context.Context, service string) (SourceRefProjection, bool, error) {
+	return s.readSourceRefProjection(ctx, service, false)
+}
+
+func (s *SQLiteStore) ReadSourceRefProjectionForBackfill(ctx context.Context, service string) (SourceRefProjection, bool, error) {
+	return s.readSourceRefProjection(ctx, service, true)
+}
+
+func (s *SQLiteStore) readSourceRefProjection(ctx context.Context, service string, duringIngest bool) (SourceRefProjection, bool, error) {
+	tx, err := s.db.BeginTx(ctx, &sql.TxOptions{ReadOnly: true})
+	if err != nil {
+		return SourceRefProjection{}, false, err
+	}
+	defer tx.Rollback()
+	var p SourceRefProjection
+	var complete int
+	err = tx.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT watermark,root,policy,extractor_version,membership_hash,produced_at,complete FROM source_ref_seals WHERE service_id=?`, service).Scan(&p.Watermark, &p.Root, &p.Policy, &p.ExtractorVersion, &p.MembershipHash, &p.ProducedAt, &complete)
+	if err == sql.ErrNoRows || isNoSuchTable(err) {
+		return SourceRefProjection{}, false, nil
+	}
+	if err != nil {
+		return SourceRefProjection{}, false, err
+	}
+	p.ServiceID, p.Complete = service, complete == 1
+	var commit, path string
+	var at int64
+	if err := tx.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT indexed_commit,indexed_at,path FROM service_meta WHERE service_id=?`, service).Scan(&commit, &at, &path); err != nil {
+		return SourceRefProjection{}, false, err
+	}
+	if p.Watermark != WatermarkOf(ServiceMeta{IndexedCommit: commit, IndexedAt: at}) || p.Root != path {
+		return SourceRefProjection{}, false, nil
+	}
+	var busy int
+	if err := tx.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ingest_state WHERE service_id=? AND state='in_progress')`, service).Scan(&busy); err != nil && !isNoSuchTable(err) {
+		return SourceRefProjection{}, false, err
+	}
+	if busy != 0 && !duringIngest {
+		return SourceRefProjection{}, false, nil
+	}
+	rows, err := tx.QueryContext(ctx, `SELECT path,source_hash,extractor_version,refs_json,excluded FROM source_ref_facts WHERE service_id=? ORDER BY path`, service)
+	if isNoSuchTable(err) {
+		return SourceRefProjection{}, false, nil
+	}
+	if err != nil {
+		return SourceRefProjection{}, false, err
+	}
+	for rows.Next() {
+		var f SourceRefFact
+		var raw sql.NullString
+		if err := rows.Scan(&f.Path, &f.SourceHash, &f.ExtractorVersion, &raw, &f.Excluded); err != nil {
+			rows.Close()
+			return SourceRefProjection{}, false, err
+		}
+		if raw.Valid {
+			if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(raw.String), &f.Refs); err != nil {
+				rows.Close()
+				return SourceRefProjection{}, false, err
+			}
+			if f.Refs == nil {
+				f.Refs = []string{}
+			}
+		}
+		p.Rows = append(p.Rows, f)
+	}
+	err = rows.Err()
+	rows.Close()
+	if err != nil {
+		return SourceRefProjection{}, false, err
+	}
+	if !validSourceRefProjection(p) {
+		return SourceRefProjection{}, false, nil
+	}
+	stats, err := tx.QueryContext(ctx, `SELECT path,excluded FROM file_stats WHERE service_id=? ORDER BY path`, service)
+	if err != nil {
+		return SourceRefProjection{}, false, err
+	}
+	i := 0
+	for stats.Next() {
+		var path, excluded string
+		if err := stats.Scan(&path, &excluded); err != nil {
+			stats.Close()
+			return SourceRefProjection{}, false, err
+		}
+		if i >= len(p.Rows) || p.Rows[i].Path != path || (p.Rows[i].Excluded != "" && p.Rows[i].Excluded != excluded) {
+			stats.Close()
+			return SourceRefProjection{}, false, nil
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	err = stats.Err()
+	stats.Close()
+	if err != nil {
+		return SourceRefProjection{}, false, err
+	}
+	if i != len(p.Rows) {
+		return SourceRefProjection{}, false, nil
+	}
+	p.Scope, p.CurrentWorktreeFreshness = SourceRefScopeIngestGeneration, "unknown"
+	if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
+		return SourceRefProjection{}, false, err
+	}
+	if !duringIngest {
+		visible, err := filterScoped(ctx, s.gate, service, p.Rows, nil, func(f SourceRefFact) string { return f.Path })
+		if err != nil {
+			return SourceRefProjection{}, false, err
+		}
+		if len(visible) != len(p.Rows) {
+			return SourceRefProjection{}, false, nil
+		}
+	}
+	return p, true, nil
+}
+
+func (m *MemoryStore) ReadSourceRefProjection(ctx context.Context, service string) (SourceRefProjection, bool, error) {
+	return m.readSourceRefProjection(ctx, service, false)
+}
+
+func (m *MemoryStore) ReadSourceRefProjectionForBackfill(ctx context.Context, service string) (SourceRefProjection, bool, error) {
+	return m.readSourceRefProjection(ctx, service, true)
+}
+
+func (m *MemoryStore) readSourceRefProjection(ctx context.Context, service string, duringIngest bool) (SourceRefProjection, bool, error) {
+	m.mu.RLock()
+	defer m.mu.RUnlock()
+	p, ok := m.sourceRefProjections[service]
+	if !ok {
+		return SourceRefProjection{}, false, nil
+	}
+	meta, mok := m.serviceMeta[service]
+	if !mok || p.Watermark != WatermarkOf(meta) || p.Root != meta.Path || !validSourceRefProjection(p) {
+		return SourceRefProjection{}, false, nil
+	}
+	stats := m.fileStats[service]
+	if len(stats) != len(p.Rows) {
+		return SourceRefProjection{}, false, nil
+	}
+	for i, f := range stats {
+		if f.Path != p.Rows[i].Path || (p.Rows[i].Excluded != "" && f.Excluded != p.Rows[i].Excluded) {
+			return SourceRefProjection{}, false, nil
+		}
+	}
+	if state, sok := m.ingestState[service]; sok && state.State == IngestInProgress && !duringIngest {
+		return SourceRefProjection{}, false, nil
+	}
+	p.Rows = append([]SourceRefFact(nil), p.Rows...)
+	for i := range p.Rows {
+		p.Rows[i].Refs = append([]string(nil), p.Rows[i].Refs...)
+		if m.sourceRefProjections[service].Rows[i].Refs != nil && p.Rows[i].Refs == nil {
+			p.Rows[i].Refs = []string{}
+		}
+	}
+	p.Scope, p.CurrentWorktreeFreshness = SourceRefScopeIngestGeneration, "unknown"
+	if !duringIngest {
+		visible, err := filterScoped(ctx, m.gate, service, p.Rows, nil, func(f SourceRefFact) string { return f.Path })
+		if err != nil {
+			return SourceRefProjection{}, false, err
+		}
+		if len(visible) != len(p.Rows) {
+			return SourceRefProjection{}, false, nil
+		}
+	}
+	return p, true, nil
+}

+import (

+func TestSourceRefProjectionSealAndFailure(t *testing.T) {
+	ctx := context.Background()
+	s, err := NewSQLiteStore(filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "refs.sqlite"))
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	defer s.Close()
+	meta := ServiceMeta{ServiceID: "svc", Path: "/root", IndexedCommit: "head", IndexedAt: 1}
+	h := sha256.Sum256([]byte("raw"))
+	row := SourceRefFact{Path: "a.txt", SourceHash: hex.EncodeToString(h[:]), ExtractorVersion: SourceRefExtractorVersion, Refs: []string{}}
+	p := &SourceRefProjection{Policy: "policy", ExtractorVersion: SourceRefExtractorVersion, ProducedAt: 1, Complete: true, Rows: []SourceRefFact{row}}
+	if err := s.WriteServiceSummary(ctx, meta, ServiceSummary{RefProjection: p}, []FileStat{{Path: "a.txt"}}); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	got, ok, err := s.ReadSourceRefProjection(ctx, "svc")
+	if err != nil || !ok || !got.Complete || got.Rows[0].Refs == nil {
+		t.Fatalf("sealed projection=%+v ok=%v err=%v", got, ok, err)
+	}
+	if _, err := s.db.ExecContext(ctx, `UPDATE source_ref_facts SET extractor_version='older' WHERE service_id='svc'`); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if _, ok, err := s.ReadSourceRefProjection(ctx, "svc"); err != nil || ok {
+		t.Fatalf("mixed fact version visible: ok=%v err=%v", ok, err)
+	}
+	if _, err := s.db.ExecContext(ctx, `UPDATE source_ref_facts SET extractor_version=? WHERE service_id='svc'`, SourceRefExtractorVersion); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if err := s.SetIngestState(ctx, IngestState{ServiceID: "svc", State: IngestInProgress}); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if _, ok, err := s.ReadSourceRefProjection(ctx, "svc"); err != nil || ok {
+		t.Fatalf("mixed ingest visible: ok=%v err=%v", ok, err)
+	}
+	if err := s.DeleteIngestState(ctx, "svc"); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	bad := &SourceRefProjection{Policy: "policy", ExtractorVersion: SourceRefExtractorVersion, Complete: true, Rows: []SourceRefFact{{Path: "b.txt", ExtractorVersion: SourceRefExtractorVersion}}}
+	meta.IndexedAt = 2
+	if err := s.WriteServiceSummary(ctx, meta, ServiceSummary{RefProjection: bad}, nil); err == nil {
+		t.Fatal("invalid transaction accepted")
+	}
+	got, ok, err = s.ReadSourceRefProjection(ctx, "svc")
+	if err != nil || !ok || got.Watermark != WatermarkOf(ServiceMeta{IndexedCommit: "head", IndexedAt: 1}) {
+		t.Fatalf("failed transaction changed seal: %+v ok=%v err=%v", got, ok, err)
+	}
+	if err := s.SetServiceMeta(ctx, meta); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if _, ok, err := s.ReadSourceRefProjection(ctx, "svc"); err != nil || ok {
+		t.Fatalf("meta-only fallback exposed stale seal: ok=%v err=%v", ok, err)
+	}
+}

+func TestSourceRefProjectionRefusesTamperedSealAndExclusions(t *testing.T) {
+	ctx := context.Background()
+	s, err := NewSQLiteStore(filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "refs.sqlite"))
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	defer s.Close()
+	h := sha256.Sum256([]byte("[FR-1]"))
+	meta := ServiceMeta{ServiceID: "svc", Path: "/root", IndexedCommit: "head", IndexedAt: 1}
+	rows := []SourceRefFact{
+		{Path: "a.go", SourceHash: hex.EncodeToString(h[:]), ExtractorVersion: SourceRefExtractorVersion, Refs: []string{"[FR-1]"}},
+		{Path: "empty.go", SourceHash: hex.EncodeToString(h[:]), ExtractorVersion: SourceRefExtractorVersion, Refs: []string{}},
+		{Path: "large.dat", ExtractorVersion: SourceRefExtractorVersion, Excluded: "oversize"},
+	}
+	p := &SourceRefProjection{Policy: "policy", ExtractorVersion: SourceRefExtractorVersion, Rows: rows}
+	files := []FileStat{{Path: "a.go"}, {Path: "empty.go"}, {Path: "large.dat", Excluded: "oversize"}}
+	if err := s.WriteServiceSummary(ctx, meta, ServiceSummary{RefProjection: p}, files); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if got, ok, err := s.ReadSourceRefProjection(ctx, "svc"); err != nil || !ok || got.Complete || got.Rows[1].Refs == nil {
+		t.Fatalf("valid excluded projection missing: %+v ok=%v err=%v", got, ok, err)
+	}
+	for _, tc := range []struct{ name, update, restore string }{
+		{"root", `UPDATE source_ref_seals SET root='/elsewhere'`, `UPDATE source_ref_seals SET root='/root'`},
+		{"watermark", `UPDATE source_ref_seals SET watermark='stale'`, `UPDATE source_ref_seals SET watermark='head@1'`},
+		{"policy", `UPDATE source_ref_seals SET policy=''`, `UPDATE source_ref_seals SET policy='policy'`},
+		{"extractor", `UPDATE source_ref_seals SET extractor_version='old'`, `UPDATE source_ref_seals SET extractor_version='sdd-default-refs-v1'`},
+		{"membership", `UPDATE source_ref_seals SET membership_hash='bad'`, `UPDATE source_ref_seals SET membership_hash='` + SourceRefMembershipHash(rows) + `'`},
+		{"raw hash", `UPDATE source_ref_facts SET source_hash='bad' WHERE path='a.go'`, `UPDATE source_ref_facts SET source_hash='` + rows[0].SourceHash + `' WHERE path='a.go'`},
+		{"file stats exclusion", `UPDATE file_stats SET excluded='' WHERE path='large.dat'`, `UPDATE file_stats SET excluded='oversize' WHERE path='large.dat'`},
+		{"file stats membership", `DELETE FROM file_stats WHERE path='empty.go'`, `INSERT INTO file_stats(service_id,path,size,mtime_ns,ino,content_hash,lang,excluded) VALUES('svc','empty.go',0,0,0,'','','')`},
+	} {
+		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			if _, err := s.db.ExecContext(ctx, tc.update); err != nil {
+				t.Fatal(err)
+			}
+			if _, ok, err := s.ReadSourceRefProjection(ctx, "svc"); err != nil || ok {
+				t.Fatalf("tampered projection visible: ok=%v err=%v", ok, err)
+			}
+			if _, err := s.db.ExecContext(ctx, tc.restore); err != nil {
+				t.Fatal(err)
+			}
+		})
+	}
+}

+package store
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"encoding/json"
+	"fmt"
+	"sort"
+
+	"github.com/geoffmilleraz/fathom/internal/core"
+	"github.com/geoffmilleraz/fathom/internal/tenancy"
+)
+
+// ListSymbolNodes reads the same complete observation rows as QueryObservations,
+// directly into their public symbol projection. It avoids retaining an entire
+// Observation slice beside the SymbolNode slice. Other Store implementations may
+// omit this optional capability; the client retains its existing fallback.
+func (s *SQLiteStore) ListSymbolNodes(ctx context.Context, serviceID string) ([]core.SymbolNode, error) {
+	rows, err := s.db.QueryContext(ctx, queryObservationsSQL, serviceID)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("QueryObservations query: %w", err)
+	}
+	defer rows.Close()
+	nodes, err := scanSymbolNodes(ctx, rows)
+	return filterScoped(ctx, s.gate, serviceID, nodes, err, func(n core.SymbolNode) string { return n.FilePath })
+}
+
+type symbolNodeRows interface {
+	Next() bool
+	Scan(...any) error
+	Err() error
+}
+
+// symbolNodeOrder preserves QueryObservations' stable timestamp ordering without
+// storing complete Observations or a second node slice. Equal timestamps retain
+// the row order delivered by the unchanged query.
+type symbolNodeOrder struct {
+	nodes  []core.SymbolNode
+	stamps []int64
+}
+
+func (s symbolNodeOrder) Len() int           { return len(s.nodes) }
+func (s symbolNodeOrder) Less(i, j int) bool { return s.stamps[i] < s.stamps[j] }
+func (s symbolNodeOrder) Swap(i, j int) {
+	s.nodes[i], s.nodes[j] = s.nodes[j], s.nodes[i]
+	s.stamps[i], s.stamps[j] = s.stamps[j], s.stamps[i]
+}
+
+func scanSymbolNodes(ctx context.Context, rows symbolNodeRows) ([]core.SymbolNode, error) {
+	nodes := make([]core.SymbolNode, 0)
+	var stamps []int64
+	gov := tenancy.NewRowGovernor(ctx, tenancy.ClassIndex)
+	for rows.Next() {
+		if err := gov.Row(); err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		nodes = append(nodes, core.SymbolNode{})
+		n := &nodes[len(nodes)-1]
+		var concern, hash, callsJSON string
+		var stamp int64
+		var generated bool
+		// Read every original column, including fields not exposed by
+		// ToSymbolNode: row/JSON failures must not disappear in a projection.
+		if err := rows.Scan(&n.Service, &concern, &n.FilePath, (*string)(&n.Kind),
+			(*string)(&n.Tier), &n.Name, &n.Package, &n.Signature, &hash,
+			&callsJSON, &n.Complexity, &n.Line, &n.EndLine, &stamp,
+			&n.ToolKind, &generated); err != nil {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("scanObservations scan: %w", err)
+		}
+		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(callsJSON), &n.Calls); err != nil {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("scanObservations unmarshal calls: %w", err)
+		}
+		stamps = append(stamps, stamp)
+	}
+	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("scanObservations rows: %w", err)
+	}
+	sort.Stable(symbolNodeOrder{nodes: nodes, stamps: stamps})
+	return nodes, nil
+}

+func projectionStore(t *testing.T) *SQLiteStore {
+	t.Helper()
+	s, err := NewSQLiteStore(filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "projection.sqlite"))
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	t.Cleanup(func() { _ = s.Close() })
+	return s
+}
+
+func projectedObservations(t *testing.T, s *SQLiteStore, ctx context.Context) []core.SymbolNode {
+	t.Helper()
+	obs, err := s.QueryObservations(ctx, "svc", "")
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	nodes := make([]core.SymbolNode, 0, len(obs))
+	for _, o := range obs {
+		nodes = append(nodes, o.ToSymbolNode())
+	}
+	return nodes
+}

+func TestSymbolProjectionMatchesObservationPath(t *testing.T) {
+	s := projectionStore(t)
+	ctx := context.Background()
+	base := time.Date(2026, 10, 1, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
+	rows := []core.Observation{
+		{ServiceID: "svc", ConcernID: "first", SourceRef: "a/file.go", SourceKind: core.KindGoFunc, EvidenceTier: core.TierVerified, Symbol: "Duplicate", Package: "p", Claim: "func Duplicate()", Calls: []string{"p.A", "p.A"}, IngestedAt: base.Add(3 * time.Second), Complexity: 7, Line: 2, EndLine: 9, ToolKind: "go", Generated: true},
+		{ServiceID: "svc", ConcernID: "second", SourceRef: "z/data.json", SourceKind: core.SourceKind("JSONKey"), EvidenceTier: core.TierPreScan, Symbol: "long.key.with.no.calls", Package: "data", Claim: "value", IngestedAt: base},
+		{ServiceID: "svc", ConcernID: "third", SourceRef: "b/file.go", SourceKind: core.KindGoFunc, EvidenceTier: core.TierVerified, Symbol: "Duplicate", Package: "p", Claim: "second identity", Calls: []string{}, IngestedAt: base},
+		{ServiceID: "other", SourceRef: "other.go", Symbol: "NeverReturned", IngestedAt: base},
+	}
+	if err := s.PutObservations(ctx, rows); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	want := projectedObservations(t, s, ctx)
+	got, err := s.ListSymbolNodes(ctx, "svc")
+	if err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
+		t.Fatalf("projection differs: got %#v, %v; want %#v", got, err, want)
+	}
+	if len(got) != 3 || got[0].FilePath != "z/data.json" || got[1].FilePath != "b/file.go" {
+		t.Fatalf("stable timestamp/insertion order or complete row population changed: %#v", got)
+	}
+	empty, err := s.ListSymbolNodes(ctx, "absent")
+	if err != nil || empty == nil || len(empty) != 0 {
+		t.Fatalf("empty public projection = %#v, %v", empty, err)
+	}
+}

+func TestSymbolProjectionSuppressionAndReversal(t *testing.T) {
+	s := projectionStore(t)
+	path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "suppressions.jsonl")
+	now := time.Date(2026, 10, 1, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
+	s.gate = scopeGate{src: scope.NewSource(path, func() time.Time { return now })}
+	rows := []core.Observation{
+		{ServiceID: "svc", SourceRef: "secret/a.go", Symbol: "Hidden", IngestedAt: now},
+		{ServiceID: "svc", SourceRef: "public/b.go", Symbol: "Visible", IngestedAt: now},
+	}
+	if err := s.PutObservations(context.Background(), rows); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	id, err := scope.AppendSuppression(path, scope.Suppression{Service: "svc", Pattern: "secret/**", Reason: "test boundary", CreatedAt: now, CreatedBy: scope.OriginCLI})
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	oldCtx, oldCollector := scope.WithCollector(context.Background())
+	newCtx, newCollector := scope.WithCollector(context.Background())
+	want := projectedObservations(t, s, oldCtx)
+	got, err := s.ListSymbolNodes(newCtx, "svc")
+	if err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) || len(got) != 1 || !reflect.DeepEqual(oldCollector.For("svc"), newCollector.For("svc")) {
+		t.Fatalf("scoped result/disclosure differs: %#v, %v; old=%#v new=%#v", got, err, oldCollector.For("svc"), newCollector.For("svc"))
+	}
+	if err := scope.RemoveSuppression(path, id, now); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	got, err = s.ListSymbolNodes(context.Background(), "svc")
+	if err != nil || len(got) != 2 {
+		t.Fatalf("same handle did not observe reversal: %#v, %v", got, err)
+	}
+}

+func TestSymbolProjectionErrorAndCancellationDifferential(t *testing.T) {
+	s := projectionStore(t)
+	ctx := context.Background()
+	if err := s.PutObservations(ctx, []core.Observation{{ServiceID: "svc", SourceRef: "a.go", Symbol: "A"}}); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if _, err := s.db.Exec("UPDATE observations SET calls = '{' WHERE service_id = ?", "svc"); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	_, oldErr := s.QueryObservations(ctx, "svc", "")
+	nodes, newErr := s.ListSymbolNodes(ctx, "svc")
+	if oldErr == nil || newErr == nil || oldErr.Error() != newErr.Error() || nodes != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("malformed calls became success/partial: old=%v new=%v nodes=%#v", oldErr, newErr, nodes)
+	}
+	canceled, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
+	cancel()
+	_, oldErr = s.QueryObservations(canceled, "svc", "")
+	nodes, newErr = s.ListSymbolNodes(canceled, "svc")
+	if !errors.Is(oldErr, context.Canceled) || !errors.Is(newErr, context.Canceled) || nodes != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("cancel differs: old=%v new=%v nodes=%#v", oldErr, newErr, nodes)
+	}
+}

+type projectionErrorRows struct {
+	remaining int
+	scanErr   error
+	rowErr    error
+}
+
+func (r *projectionErrorRows) Next() bool { r.remaining--; return r.remaining >= 0 }
+func (r *projectionErrorRows) Scan(dest ...any) error {
+	if r.scanErr != nil {
+		return r.scanErr
+	}
+	*dest[9].(*string) = "null"
+	return nil
+}
+func (r *projectionErrorRows) Err() error { return r.rowErr }
+
+func TestSymbolProjectionTerminalAndGovernorFailures(t *testing.T) {
+	sentinel := errors.New("row failure")
+	for _, rows := range []*projectionErrorRows{{remaining: 1, scanErr: sentinel}, {remaining: 2, rowErr: sentinel}} {
+		got, err := scanSymbolNodes(context.Background(), rows)
+		if !errors.Is(err, sentinel) || got != nil {
+			t.Fatalf("error returned partial nodes: %#v, %v", got, err)
+		}
+	}
+	t.Cleanup(func() { tenancy.PublishLevel(tenancy.LevelNormal) })
+	tenancy.PublishLevel(tenancy.LevelRefuse)
+	ctx := tenancy.WithProducerClass(context.Background(), tenancy.ClassTree)
+	got, err := scanSymbolNodes(ctx, &projectionErrorRows{remaining: 2500})
+	if !errors.Is(err, tenancy.ErrOverBudget) || got != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("tree row governor bypassed: %d, %v", len(got), err)
+	}
+	// The original scan's default index class still serves at refuse.
+	got, err = scanSymbolNodes(context.Background(), &projectionErrorRows{remaining: 2})
+	if err != nil || len(got) != 2 {
+		t.Fatalf("default index class changed: %d, %v", len(got), err)
+	}
+}

+func TestIngestCertifyMarkers_UsesCorpusScopeAndReplacesExcludedDeclarations(t *testing.T) {
+	ctx := context.Background()
+	st := store.NewMemoryStore()
+	t.Cleanup(func() { _ = st.Close() })
+	root := t.TempDir()
+	markerFixture(t, root, "src/maintained_test.go", "I-MAINTAINED")
+	markerFixture(t, root, "example/ignored_test.go", "I-CACHE")
+	markerFixture(t, root, ".artifacts/ignored_test.go", "I-ARTIFACT")
+	mustWrite(t, filepath.Join(root, ".fathomignore"), ".artifacts/\n")
+
+	check := func(want int, targets ...string) {
+		t.Helper()
+		report, err := IngestCertifyMarkers(ctx, st, "svc", "wm", root)
+		if err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+		if report.Declared != want {
+			t.Fatalf("Declared = %d, want %d", report.Declared, want)
+		}
+		decls, err := st.CertifyDeclarationsForService(ctx, "svc")
+		if err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+		if len(decls) != want {
+			t.Fatalf("stored = %d, want %d", len(decls), want)
+		}
+		got := map[string]bool{}
+		for _, d := range decls {
+			got[d.TargetID] = true
+		}
+		for _, target := range targets {
+			if !got[target] {
+				t.Fatalf("target %q absent from %+v", target, decls)
+			}
+		}
+		if got["I-ARTIFACT"] {
+			t.Fatalf("ignored artifact declared: %+v", decls)
+		}
+	}
+	check(1, "I-MAINTAINED")
+	mustWrite(t, filepath.Join(root, ".fathom", "config.toml"), "[connector]\ninclude = [\".cache\"]\n")
+	check(2, "I-MAINTAINED", "I-CACHE")
+	mustWrite(t, filepath.Join(root, ".fathom", "config.toml"), "[connector]\ninclude = []\n")
+	check(1, "I-MAINTAINED") // Whole-service replacement prunes the old cache declaration.
+}

+// unityRuntimeFresh is read-only. Replacing the active receipt with a newer
+// started attempt, changing XML/envelope/source/index bytes, or losing any
+// declared input invalidates a previous runtime result immediately at this read.
+func unityRuntimeFresh(ctx context.Context, nativeJSON, digest string) (UnityBinding, string) {
+	var b UnityBinding
+	if err := unityDecode([]byte(nativeJSON), &b); err != nil {
+		return b, "native binding is malformed: " + err.Error()
+	}
+	raw, err := unityRead(b.ReceiptPath, unityJSONLimit)
+	if err != nil {
+		return b, "native active receipt unavailable: " + err.Error()
+	}
+	if unityDigest(raw) != b.ReceiptSHA256 {
+		return b, "native active receipt changed; previous result is not current"
+	}
+	evidence, err := LoadUnityNUnitEvidence(ctx, b.Root, b.XMLPath, b.ReceiptPath)
+	if err != nil {
+		return b, err.Error()
+	}
+	if evidence.Receipt.RunID != b.RunID || evidence.Run.Digest != digest {
+		return b, "native run identity no longer matches its stored standard record"
+	}
+	if evidence.Receipt.Symbols == nil {
+		return b, "native run has no fresh typed C# identity"
+	}
+	return b, ""
+}

+var runtimeBenchStore = flag.String("runtime-bench-store", "", "path to an owned closed SQLite copy for the native runtime benchmark")
+var runtimeBenchService = flag.String("runtime-bench-service", "<CONSUMER_SERVICE>", "service in the owned runtime benchmark store")

+type runtimeBenchResult struct {
+	Key string             `json:"key"`
+	Run verify.AttestedRun `json:"run"`

+type runtimeBenchCounts struct {
+	Rows, Native, Pass, Fail, Skip, Flake, Unknown, Other, Refusals int

+// BenchmarkLoadRuntimeRunsRealStore reads the supplied owned SQLite copy on
+// every iteration, including native receipt, XML, source and SCIP freshness.
+// The hash covers every newest keyed result and its refusal reason. It does
+// not run during ordinary tests or benchmarks without -runtime-bench-store.
+func BenchmarkLoadRuntimeRunsRealStore(b *testing.B) {
+	if *runtimeBenchStore == "" {
+		b.Skip("set -runtime-bench-store to an owned closed SQLite copy")
+	}
+	info, err := os.Stat(*runtimeBenchStore)
+	if err != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() || info.Size() == 0 {
+		b.Fatalf("runtime benchmark store must be an existing nonempty regular file: %v", err)
+	}
+	st, err := store.Open(*runtimeBenchStore)
+	if err != nil {
+		b.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	b.Cleanup(func() {
+		if err := st.Close(); err != nil {
+			b.Error(err)
+		}
+	})
+	rows, err := st.NewestTestCaseRuns(context.Background(), *runtimeBenchService)
+	if err != nil {
+		b.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if len(rows) == 0 {
+		b.Fatalf("no newest runs for service %q", *runtimeBenchService)
+	}
+	keys := make([]string, len(rows))
+	native := 0
+	for i, row := range rows {
+		if row.TestSymbolKey == "" || (i > 0 && rows[i-1].TestSymbolKey >= row.TestSymbolKey) {
+			b.Fatalf("newest runs lack sorted unique canonical keys at row %d", i)
+		}
+		keys[i] = row.TestSymbolKey
+		if row.NativeJSON != "" {
+			native++
+		}
+	}
+	if native == 0 {
+		b.Fatalf("service %q has no native joined runs", *runtimeBenchService)
+	}
+	rows = nil
+	now := func() time.Time { return time.Date(2026, 10, 20, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC) }
+	var expectedHash [sha256.Size]byte
+	var expectedCounts runtimeBenchCounts
+	b.ReportAllocs()
+	b.ResetTimer()
+	for i := 0; i < b.N; i++ {
+		ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
+		runs, loadErr := LoadRuntimeRuns(ctx, st, *runtimeBenchService, now)
+		cancel()
+		if loadErr != nil {
+			b.Fatal(loadErr)
+		}
+		got, resultErr := runs.NewestAttestedRuns(keys)
+		if resultErr != nil || len(got) != len(keys) {
+			b.Fatalf("newest keyed results: got %d of %d: %v", len(got), len(keys), resultErr)
+		}
+		canonical := make([]runtimeBenchResult, len(keys))
+		counts := runtimeBenchCounts{Rows: len(keys), Native: native}
+		for j, key := range keys {
+			run, ok := got[key]
+			if !ok {
+				b.Fatalf("missing runtime key %q", key)
+			}
+			canonical[j] = runtimeBenchResult{Key: key, Run: run}
+			switch run.Status {
+			case "pass":
+				counts.Pass++
+			case "fail":
+				counts.Fail++
+			case "skip":
+				counts.Skip++
+			case "flake":
+				counts.Flake++
+			case "unknown":
+				counts.Unknown++
+			default:
+				counts.Other++
+			}
+			if run.UnknownReason != "" {
+				counts.Refusals++
+			}
+		}
+		encoded, encodeErr := json.Marshal(canonical)
+		if encodeErr != nil {
+			b.Fatal(encodeErr)
+		}
+		hash := sha256.Sum256(encoded)
+		if i == 0 {
+			expectedHash, expectedCounts = hash, counts
+		} else if hash != expectedHash || counts != expectedCounts {
+			b.Fatalf("runtime results changed at iteration %d: hash=%x counts=%+v; first hash=%x counts=%+v", i, hash, counts, expectedHash, expectedCounts)
+		}
+	}
+	b.StopTimer()
+	b.Logf("runtime_results_sha256=%x counts=%+v", expectedHash, expectedCounts)
+}

+// result.cue — #TestResult: one envelope, every framework (ADR-0042 §2).
+//
+// The engine never trusts a framework's stdout as the record. Runner
+// adapters convert native output INTO this shape, and this shape is the
+// record; JUnit XML and CTRF are emitted FROM it, one-way, forever. A
+// surface that can only be fed by reading a projection back is a wrong
+// surface, not a reason to relax the rule.
+package testkit
+
+// #Verdict — flake-pass is a MEMBER, not a flavour of pass. There is no
+// field anywhere in this schema that maps one onto the other, which is
+// what makes "a retry-rescued suite is visible on every surface"
+// (ADR-0042) structural rather than a reporting convention someone can
+// quietly drop.
+#Verdict: "pass" | "fail" | "flake-pass" | "quarantined" | "error"
+
+#CaseStatus: "pass" | "fail" | "skip" | "flake"
+
+// #FailureKind is ADR-0042's failure taxonomy. It is load-bearing, not
+// decoration: `infra` failures never poison a key's verdict history, so a
+// runner that reports every failure as "assertion" is destroying the
+// signal prediction and fleet health depend on.
+#FailureKind: "assertion" | "timeout" | "panic" | "infra" | "dependency"
+
+#CaseFailure: {
+	kind:    #FailureKind
+	message: string & !=""
+	where?:  string
+}
+
+#Case: {
+	id:       string & !=""
+	name:     string & !=""
+	status:   #CaseStatus
+	duration: string
+	failure?: #CaseFailure
+	// attempts is REQUIRED with a default of 1 rather than optional: a
+	// runner cannot omit its way out of admitting a retry (ADR-0042's
+	// "retry lineage is data, never hidden"). An optional field would
+	// make "no retries" and "did not say" the same document.
+	attempts: int & >=1 | *1
+	// A case that failed and then passed is `flake`, and a flake by
+	// definition took more than one attempt. The pairing is enforced here
+	// so a runner cannot report a clean single-attempt flake.
+	if status == "flake" {
+		attempts: int & >=2
+	}
+}
+
+#Totals: {
+	run:     int & >=0
+	passed:  int & >=0
+	failed:  int & >=0
+	skipped: int & >=0
+	flaked:  int & >=0
+}
+
+#CoverageReport: {
+	statements?: number & >=0 & <=100
+	branches?:   number & >=0 & <=100
+	perPackage?: [string]: number & >=0 & <=100
+}
+
+#Timing: {
+	startedAt:   string & =~"^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T"
+	wallClock:   string
+	perCaseP95?: string
+}
+
+#EnvInfo: {
+	toolchainDigest: string
+	runnerClass:     string
+	arch:            string
+	os:              string
+	// commit/dirty/race are optional (ADR-0106, "results bind to the
+	// commit they exercised"): the commit the suite ran against, whether
+	// the working tree carried uncommitted changes at that moment, and
+	// whether the race detector was on. Absent on an envelope from before
+	// this field existed, or from an adapter that was never told — never
+	// a fabricated value. A consumer that needs to know whether a run is
+	// bound to a commit checks commit's presence, not a zero value: an
+	// absent commit and a zero-length string read identically in CUE and
+	// in JSON, so "never fabricate" already covers both.
+	commit?: string & =~"^[0-9a-f]{40}$"
+	dirty?:  bool
+	race?:   bool
+}
+
+// #ArtifactRef is a CAS reference — logs, coverage profiles, screenshots.
+// A digest, never a path: a path is a claim about a filesystem that will
+// not exist when somebody reads this envelope.
+#ArtifactRef: {
+	name:   string & !=""
+	digest: string & =~"^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$"
+}
+
+#TestResult: {
+	suite: {
+		component: string & !=""
+		name:      string & !=""
+		class:     #SuiteClass
+	}
+	// key binds the result to the executor's input closure. Opaque to
+	// test-kit for the same reason #Suite.inputs is: whose closure, and
+	// how hashed, is the executor's business.
+	key:     string
+	verdict: #Verdict
+	cases: [...#Case]
+	totals:    #Totals
+	coverage?: #CoverageReport
+	timing:    #Timing
+	env:       #EnvInfo
+	trace?: traceId: string
+	artifacts: [...#ArtifactRef] | *[]
+	// flake is the policy the verdict was judged UNDER, round-tripped from
+	// the manifest. Without it a reader cannot tell whether a flake-pass
+	// was within budget, and "was this allowed" becomes a second lookup
+	// against a manifest that may since have changed.
+	flake: #FlakePolicy
+
+	// A verdict of flake-pass with nothing flaked, or a fail with nothing
+	// failed, is an envelope contradicting itself. Refused rather than
+	// reported.
+	if verdict == "flake-pass" {
+		totals: flaked: int & >=1
+	}
+	if verdict == "fail" {
+		totals: failed: int & >=1
+	}
+}

+package testevidence
+
+import (
+	_ "embed"
+	"fmt"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+
+	"cuelang.org/go/cue"
+	"cuelang.org/go/cue/cuecontext"
+	"github.com/geoffmilleraz/fathom/internal/testrun"
