+//go:embed testkit_result.cue
+var testKitResultSchema []byte
+
+type unityEnvelope struct {
+	Suite   SuiteRef `json:"suite"`
+	Key     string   `json:"key"`
+	Verdict string   `json:"verdict"`
+	Cases   []Case   `json:"cases"`
+	Totals  Totals   `json:"totals"`
+	Timing  struct {
+		StartedAt  string `json:"startedAt"`
+		WallClock  string `json:"wallClock"`
+		PerCaseP95 string `json:"perCaseP95,omitempty"`
+	} `json:"timing"`
+	Env struct {
+		ToolchainDigest string `json:"toolchainDigest"`
+		RunnerClass     string `json:"runnerClass"`
+		Arch            string `json:"arch"`
+		OS              string `json:"os"`
+		Commit          string `json:"commit"`
+		Dirty           *bool  `json:"dirty"`
+		Race            *bool  `json:"race"`
+	} `json:"env"`
+	Artifacts []ArtifactRef `json:"artifacts"`
+	Flake     struct {
+		MaxRetries      int    `json:"maxRetries"`
+		QuarantineAfter int    `json:"quarantineAfter"`
+		Budget          string `json:"budget"`
+	} `json:"flake"`
+	Trace struct {
+		TraceID string `json:"traceId"`
+	} `json:"trace"`
+	Coverage *CoverageReport `json:"coverage,omitempty"`
+}
+
+func unityValidateEnvelope(raw []byte, r UnityReceipt, native testrun.NUnitRun) (Run, error) {
+	var w unityEnvelope
+	if err := unityDecode(raw, &w); err != nil {
+		return Run{}, fmt.Errorf("native test-kit envelope JSON: %w", err)
+	}
+	cctx := cuecontext.New()
+	schemaBytes := string(testKitManifestSchema) + "\n" + strings.Replace(string(testKitResultSchema), "package testkit", "", 1)
+	schema := cctx.CompileString(schemaBytes)
+	if err := schema.Err(); err != nil {
+		return Run{}, fmt.Errorf("compile test-kit mirror: %w", err)
+	}
+	value := schema.LookupPath(cue.ParsePath("#TestResult")).Unify(cctx.CompileBytes(raw))
+	if err := value.Validate(cue.Concrete(true)); err != nil {
+		return Run{}, fmt.Errorf("native envelope violates #TestResult")
+	}
+	if w.Suite.Component != r.Project || w.Suite.Name != r.Mode || w.Suite.Class != "integration" || w.Key != "sha256:"+r.Source.BeforeSHA256 || w.Trace.TraceID != r.RunID {
+		return Run{}, fmt.Errorf("native suite/key/run identity differs from envelope")
+	}
+	if w.Env.ToolchainDigest != "sha256:"+r.Editor.SHA256 || w.Env.RunnerClass != "unity" || w.Env.Commit == "" || w.Env.Dirty == nil || w.Env.Race == nil || *w.Env.Race {
+		return Run{}, fmt.Errorf("native toolchain/commit/dirty/race facts missing or inconsistent")
+	}
+	if w.Coverage != nil {
+		return Run{}, fmt.Errorf("native XML cannot attest coverage")
+	}
+	if w.Flake.MaxRetries != 0 || w.Flake.QuarantineAfter != 3 || w.Flake.Budget != "0%" {
+		return Run{}, fmt.Errorf("native no-retry policy differs")
+	}
+	nativeAt, _ := testrun.NUnitTime(native.StartedAt)
+	envelopeAt, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, w.Timing.StartedAt)
+	if err != nil || !nativeAt.Equal(envelopeAt) {
+		return Run{}, fmt.Errorf("native envelope start differs")
+	}
+	nativeWall, _ := testrun.NUnitDuration(native.Duration)
+	wall, err := time.ParseDuration(w.Timing.WallClock)
+	if err != nil || nativeWall != wall {
+		return Run{}, fmt.Errorf("native envelope wall duration differs")
+	}
+	expectedTotals := Totals{Run: native.Total, Passed: native.Passed, Failed: native.Failed, Skipped: native.Skipped + native.Inconclusive}
+	if w.Totals != expectedTotals || len(w.Cases) != len(native.Cases) {
+		return Run{}, fmt.Errorf("native envelope totals differ")
+	}
+	verdict := "error"
+	if native.Failed > 0 {
+		verdict = "fail"
+	} else if native.Total > 0 && native.Passed == native.Total {
+		verdict = "pass"
+	}
+	if w.Verdict != verdict {
+		return Run{}, fmt.Errorf("native envelope verdict differs")
+	}
+	cases := map[string]Case{}
+	for _, c := range w.Cases {
+		if _, ok := cases[c.ID]; ok {
+			return Run{}, fmt.Errorf("native envelope duplicate case")
+		}
+		cases[c.ID] = c
+	}
+	for _, c := range native.Cases {
+		id := c.Assembly + "::" + c.FullName
+		actual, ok := cases[id]
+		if !ok {
+			return Run{}, fmt.Errorf("native envelope missing case identity")
+		}
+		status := map[string]string{"Passed": "pass", "Failed": "fail", "Skipped": "skip", "Inconclusive": "skip"}[c.Result]
+		duration, err := time.ParseDuration(actual.Duration)
+		nativeDuration, _ := testrun.NUnitDuration(c.Duration)
+		if !ok || actual.Name != c.FullName || actual.Status != status || actual.Attempts != 1 || err != nil || duration != nativeDuration {
+			return Run{}, fmt.Errorf("native envelope case outcome/duration/attempts differs")
+		}
+		if strings.EqualFold(c.Label, "Retry") || strings.EqualFold(c.Label, "Flaky") {
+			return Run{}, fmt.Errorf("native retry lineage unsupported")
+		}
+	}
+	artifacts := map[string]string{}
+	for _, a := range w.Artifacts {
+		if _, ok := artifacts[a.Name]; ok {
+			return Run{}, fmt.Errorf("duplicate native artifact name")
+		}
+		artifacts[a.Name] = a.Digest
+	}
+	if len(artifacts) != 2 || artifacts["unity-nunit-xml"] != "sha256:"+r.XML.SHA256 || artifacts["unity-source-inputs"] != "sha256:"+r.Source.BeforeSHA256 {
+		return Run{}, fmt.Errorf("native artifact digests differ")
+	}
+	run, err := decodeOneEnvelope(raw)
+	if err != nil {
+		return Run{}, err
+	}
+	run.SourceFile = r.Attestation.Path
+	return run, nil
+}

+func nativeBoundaryEnvelope(t *testing.T, runner, artifact string, wrapped bool) Run {
+	t.Helper()
+	value := map[string]any{
+		"suite": SuiteRef{Component: "component", Name: "unit", Class: "unit"},
+		"key":   "fixture", "verdict": "pass", "env": map[string]any{"runnerClass": runner},
+		"cases":  []Case{{ID: "tests/ActorTests.cs::Game.ActorTests.Adds", Name: "Game.ActorTests.Adds", Status: "pass", Duration: "1ms", Attempts: 1}},
+		"totals": Totals{Run: 1, Passed: 1},
+	}
+	if artifact != "" {
+		value["artifacts"] = []ArtifactRef{{Name: artifact, Digest: "sha256:declared"}}
+	}
+	raw, err := json.Marshal(value)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if wrapped {
+		payload, err := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"predicate": value})
+		if err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+		raw, err = json.Marshal(map[string]any{"payloadType": "application/vnd.in-toto+json", "payload": base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(payload), "tier": "local"})
+		if err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+	}
+	run, err := decodeOneEnvelope(raw)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	return run
+}
+
+func nativeBoundaryStore(t *testing.T) (store.Store, core.SymbolNode) {
+	t.Helper()
+	st := store.NewMemoryStore()
+	observation := core.Observation{ServiceID: "boundary", SourceRef: "tests/ActorTests.cs", SourceKind: core.KindCSharpMethod, Symbol: "ActorTests.Adds", Package: "Game", Line: 1, EndLine: 2, Claim: "[Test] public void Adds()"}
+	if err := st.PutObservations(context.Background(), []core.Observation{observation}); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	return st, observation.ToSymbolNode()
+}

+func TestUnityNUnitDeclaredEnvelopeCannotUseGenericJoin(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, wrapped := range []bool{false, true} {
+		for _, declared := range []struct{ runner, artifact string }{
+			{"unity", ""}, {"Unity", ""}, {"local", "unity-nunit-xml"}, {"", "unity-source-inputs"},
+		} {
+			st, symbol := nativeBoundaryStore(t)
+			native := nativeBoundaryEnvelope(t, declared.runner, declared.artifact, wrapped)
+			// Discriminating control: this exact case WOULD join through
+			// upstream TQ28's file/name path. Its native declaration forbids it.
+			_, generic := JoinCasesToSymbols(native.Cases, native.Suite.Name, []core.SymbolNode{symbol})
+			if generic.Joined != 1 {
+				t.Fatal("fixture no longer discriminates the generic fallback")
+			}
+			ordinary := nativeBoundaryEnvelope(t, "local", "", false)
+			if _, err := IngestRuns(context.Background(), st, "boundary", "w", []Run{ordinary, native}); !errors.Is(err, ErrUnityEvidence) {
+				t.Fatalf("declared native envelope fell through: wrapped=%v declaration=%+v err=%v", wrapped, declared, err)
+			}
+			rows, err := st.NewestTestCaseRuns(context.Background(), "boundary")
+			if err != nil || len(rows) != 0 {
+				t.Fatalf("refused mixed batch wrote evidence: rows=%+v err=%v", rows, err)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+}

+func TestUnityNUnitBoundaryPreservesOrdinaryGenericEnvelope(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, wrapped := range []bool{false, true} {
+		st, symbol := nativeBoundaryStore(t)
+		run := nativeBoundaryEnvelope(t, "local", "", wrapped)
+		report, err := IngestRuns(context.Background(), st, "boundary", "w", []Run{run})
+		if err != nil || report.CasesJoined != 1 || len(report.CasesUnmatched) != 0 {
+			t.Fatalf("ordinary TQ28 envelope changed: report=%+v err=%v", report, err)
+		}
+		rows, err := st.NewestTestCaseRuns(context.Background(), "boundary")
+		if err != nil || len(rows) != 1 || rows[0].TestSymbolKey != symbol.Key() || rows[0].NativeJSON != "" {
+			t.Fatalf("ordinary envelope promoted or lost: rows=%+v err=%v", rows, err)
+		}
+	}

+package testevidence
+
+import (
+	"bytes"
+	"encoding/xml"
+	"fmt"
+	"io"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"regexp"
+	"strings"
+	"text/scanner"
+
+	"github.com/geoffmilleraz/fathom/internal/core"
+	"github.com/geoffmilleraz/fathom/internal/extractor"
+	"github.com/geoffmilleraz/fathom/internal/fusion"
+	scippb "github.com/geoffmilleraz/fathom/third_party/scip"
+	"google.golang.org/protobuf/proto"
+)
+
+// UnityBinding is persisted alongside the standard run, never instead of it.
+// Re-reading the active receipt and all bound inputs is mandatory before a
+// runtime result. It is intentionally excluded from live certificates for now.
+type UnityBinding struct {
+	Root          string            `json:"root"`
+	ReceiptPath   string            `json:"receipt_path"`
+	ReceiptSHA256 string            `json:"receipt_sha256"`
+	XMLPath       string            `json:"xml_path"`
+	RunID         string            `json:"run_id"`
+	CaseKeys      map[string]string `json:"case_keys"`
+	Cohorts       map[string]string `json:"cohorts"`
+}
+
+var unityMethodDescriptor = regexp.MustCompile(`([\pL_][\pL\pN_]*)#([\pL_][\pL\pN_]*)\(\)\.$`)
+
+// UnityJoinCases requires an exact source candidate, a SCIP definition at its
+// position and a declared, bound generated-project assembly owner. No bare-name
+// join, namespace suffix matching, argument stripping or framework edge exists.
+func UnityJoinCases(e UnityEvidence, symbols []core.SymbolNode) ([]JoinedCase, UnityBinding, error) {
+	b := UnityBinding{Root: e.Receipt.Root, ReceiptPath: e.ReceiptPath, ReceiptSHA256: e.ReceiptSHA256, XMLPath: e.Receipt.XML.Path, RunID: e.Receipt.RunID, CaseKeys: map[string]string{}, Cohorts: map[string]string{}}
+	joined := make([]JoinedCase, 0, len(e.Run.Cases))
+	for _, c := range e.Run.Cases {
+		joined = append(joined, JoinedCase{Case: c, SuiteName: e.Run.Suite.Name})
+	}
+	// A selected native cohort count cannot prove the complete method family.
+	// Conservatively retain filtered execution as an unjoined observation.
+	if e.Receipt.Symbols == nil || e.Receipt.Filter != "" {
+		return joined, b, nil
+	}
+	raw, err := unityFileBytes(b.Root, UnityFile{e.Receipt.Symbols.SCIPPath, e.Receipt.Symbols.SCIPSHA256}, 256<<20)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, b, err
+	}
+	var index scippb.Index
+	if err = proto.Unmarshal(raw, &index); err != nil {
+		return nil, b, err
+	}
+	if index.GetMetadata().GetToolInfo().GetName() != "scip-dotnet" {
+		return nil, b, fmt.Errorf("native C# join requires scip-dotnet")
+	}
+	defs := map[string]map[int][]string{}
+	for _, doc := range index.Documents {
+		if doc.Language != "C#" && doc.Language != "csharp" {
+			continue
+		}
+		if _, err := unityPath(b.Root, doc.RelativePath, false); err != nil {
+			return nil, b, err
+		}
+		for _, occ := range doc.Occurrences {
+			if occ.SymbolRoles&1 == 0 || !unityDefinitionRange(occ.Range) || !strings.HasPrefix(occ.Symbol, "scip-dotnet ") {
+				continue
+			}
+			m := unityMethodDescriptor.FindStringSubmatch(occ.Symbol)
+			if len(m) != 3 {
+				continue
+			}
+			if defs[doc.RelativePath] == nil {
+				defs[doc.RelativePath] = map[int][]string{}
+			}
+			defs[doc.RelativePath][int(occ.Range[0])+1] = append(defs[doc.RelativePath][int(occ.Range[0])+1], m[1]+"."+m[2])
+		}
+	}
+	owners, err := unityProjectOwners(e.Receipt)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, b, err
+	}
+	byMethod := map[string][]core.SymbolNode{}
+	for _, s := range symbols {
+		if s.Kind != core.KindCSharpMethod {
+			continue
+		}
+		qualified := s.Name
+		if s.Package != "" {
+			qualified = s.Package + "." + s.Name
+		}
+		byMethod[qualified] = append(byMethod[qualified], s)
+	}
+	cohortKeys := map[string]string{}
+	// A display ellipsis cannot establish the end of an attribute list (in
+	// particular a Retry/Repeat policy). Re-read bound source only for clipped
+	// signatures, at most once per source in this join; no persistent cache.
+	headers := map[string][]core.SymbolNode{}
+	for _, g := range e.Native.Cohorts {
+		// This version refuses nested/generic classes and method overloads. The
+		// runtime XML does not carry a source position for disambiguating them.
+		if strings.ContainsAny(g.ClassName, "+`[]<>") {
+			continue
+		}
+		candidates := byMethod[g.ClassName+"."+g.MethodName]
+		if len(candidates) != 1 {
+			continue
+		}
+		s := candidates[0]
+		if strings.HasSuffix(s.Signature, "…") {
+			if _, checked := headers[s.FilePath]; !checked {
+				headers[s.FilePath] = nil
+				path, pathErr := unityPath(b.Root, s.FilePath, false)
+				if pathErr != nil {
+					continue
+				}
+				for _, input := range e.Receipt.Source.Inputs {
+					bound, inputErr := unityPath(b.Root, input.Path, true)
+					if inputErr != nil || bound != path {
+						continue
+					}
+					source, readErr := unityFileBytes(b.Root, input, 16<<20)
+					if readErr != nil {
+						return nil, b, readErr
+					}
+					// Parse/header failures leave this method unjoined. Native
+					// assembly/SCIP/fingerprint/uniqueness checks still apply.
+					headers[s.FilePath], _ = extractor.CSharpMethodHeaders(s.Service, s.FilePath, source)
+					break
+				}
+			}
+			matches := 0
+			for _, h := range headers[s.FilePath] {
+				if h.Name == s.Name && h.Package == s.Package && h.FilePath == s.FilePath && h.Line == s.Line && h.EndLine == s.EndLine {
+					s.Signature = h.Signature
+					matches++
+				}
+			}
+			if matches != 1 {
+				continue
+			}
+		}
+		if !s.IsTest() || unityRetryAttribute(s.Signature) {
+			continue
+		}
+		if owners[g.Assembly][s.FilePath] != 1 {
+			continue
+		}
+		hits := 0
+		for _, name := range defs[s.FilePath][s.Line] {
+			if name == g.ClassName[strings.LastIndex(g.ClassName, ".")+1:]+"."+g.MethodName {
+				hits++
+			}
+		}
+		if hits != 1 {
+			continue
+		}
+		key := s.Key()
+		cohortKeys[g.ID] = key
+		// Multiple native method cohorts mapping onto one declaration are ambiguous,
+		// even if a single returned family happened to pass.
+		if _, exists := b.Cohorts[key]; exists {
+			b.Cohorts[key] = "unknown"
+		} else {
+			b.Cohorts[key] = string(g.ObservedVerdict)
+		}
+	}
+	for _, c := range e.Native.Cases {
+		if key := cohortKeys[c.Cohort]; key != "" {
+			b.CaseKeys[c.Assembly+"::"+c.FullName] = key
+		}
+	}
+	for i := range joined {
+		joined[i].TestSymbolKey = b.CaseKeys[joined[i].ID]
+	}
+	return joined, b, nil
+}
+
+func unityProjectOwners(r UnityReceipt) (map[string]map[string]int, error) {
+	owners := map[string]map[string]int{}
+	boundInputs := map[string]bool{}
+	for _, input := range r.Source.Inputs {
+		path, err := unityPath(r.Root, input.Path, true)
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		boundInputs[path] = true
+	}
+	for _, input := range r.Source.Inputs {
+		if !strings.HasSuffix(input.Path, ".csproj") {
+			continue
+		}
+		path, err := unityPath(r.Root, input.Path, true)
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		// Unity-generated project files in the selected project only. External
+		// arbitrary projects cannot claim ownership of source in this Unity run.
+		project, _ := unityPath(r.Root, r.Project, false)
+		if filepath.Dir(path) != project {
+			continue
+		}
+		raw, err := unityFileBytes(r.Root, input, 16<<20)
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		d := xml.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(raw))
+		assembly := ""
+		compile := []string{}
+		for {
+			token, err := d.Token()
+			if err == io.EOF {
+				break
+			}
+			if err != nil {
+				return nil, err
+			}
+			switch token := token.(type) {
+			case xml.Directive:
+				return nil, fmt.Errorf("project XML directives refused")
+			case xml.StartElement:
+				switch token.Name.Local {
+				case "AssemblyName":
+					var name string
+					if err := d.DecodeElement(&name, &token); err != nil {
+						return nil, err
+					}
+					if assembly != "" {
+						return nil, fmt.Errorf("duplicate assembly name")
+					}
+					assembly = name
+				case "Compile":
+					for _, a := range token.Attr {
+						if a.Name.Local == "Include" {
+							compile = append(compile, a.Value)
+						}
+					}
+				}
+			}
+		}
+		if assembly == "" || !unitySafeText(assembly) || strings.ContainsAny(assembly, "/\\") {
+			continue
+		}
+		if owners[assembly] == nil {
+			owners[assembly] = map[string]int{}
+		}
+		for _, included := range compile {
+			included = strings.ReplaceAll(included, "\\", "/")
+			if included == "" || strings.ContainsAny(included, "$*?;") {
+				continue
+			}
+			absolute := included
+			if !filepath.IsAbs(absolute) {
+				absolute = filepath.Join(project, filepath.FromSlash(included))
+			}
+			relative, err := filepath.Rel(r.Root, filepath.Clean(absolute))
+			if err != nil {
+				return nil, err
+			}
+			relative = filepath.ToSlash(relative)
+			if _, err = unityPath(r.Root, relative, false); err != nil {
+				continue
+			}
+			if boundInputs[filepath.Clean(absolute)] {
+				owners[assembly][relative]++
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return owners, nil
+}
+
+// UnityEvidenceRun binds a validated producer record to the currently indexed
+// source declarations. Revalidation at ingestion and read preserves freshness.
+func UnityEvidenceRun(e UnityEvidence, symbols []core.SymbolNode) (Run, error) {
+	_, binding, err := UnityJoinCases(e, symbols)
+	if err != nil {
+		return Run{}, err
+	}
+	run := e.Run
+	run.Unity = &binding
+	return run, nil
+}
+
+// Read leading attribute heads only: a method name or a TestCase string value
+// containing "Retry" is not a retry policy. Unknown qualified retry heads are
+// conservatively unsupported rather than assumed to be the NUnit type.
+func unityRetryAttribute(signature string) bool {
+	var s scanner.Scanner
+	s.Init(strings.NewReader(signature))
+	s.Mode = scanner.ScanIdents | scanner.ScanStrings | scanner.ScanChars | scanner.ScanComments | scanner.SkipComments
+	bad := false
+	s.Error = func(*scanner.Scanner, string) { bad = true }
+	isRetry := func(name string) bool {
+		return name == "Retry" || name == "RetryAttribute" || name == "Repeat" || name == "RepeatAttribute"
+	}
+	for token := s.Scan(); token == '['; token = s.Scan() {
+		depth, parens := 1, 0
+		head := ""
+		inHead := true
+		for depth > 0 {
+			token = s.Scan()
+			if token == scanner.EOF || bad {
+				return true
+			}
+			if depth == 1 && parens == 0 {
+				if inHead && token == scanner.Ident {
+					head = s.TokenText()
+				}
+				if token == '(' {
+					if isRetry(head) {
+						return true
+					}
+					inHead = false
+				}
+				if token == ',' {
+					if isRetry(head) {
+						return true
+					}
+					head = ""
+					inHead = true
+				}
+				if token == ']' && isRetry(head) {
+					return true
+				}
+			}
+			switch token {
+			case '[':
+				depth++
+			case ']':
+				depth--
+			case '(':
+				parens++
+			case ')':
+				parens--
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return bad
+}
+
+func unityDefinitionRange(r []int32) bool {
+	if len(r) != 3 && len(r) != 4 {
+		return false
+	}
+	for _, n := range r {
+		if n < 0 {
+			return false
+		}
+	}
+	if len(r) == 3 {
+		return r[2] >= r[1]
+	}
+	return r[2] > r[0] || r[2] == r[0] && r[3] >= r[1]
+}
+
+// UnityCurrentSymbols refuses a stale syntax index even if its old method name
+// and line happen to coincide with a current typed definition. ContentHash is
+// extraction provenance, not another witness or an inferred framework identity.
+func UnityCurrentSymbols(e UnityEvidence, observations []core.Observation) []core.SymbolNode {
+	inputs := map[string]UnityFile{}
+	for _, input := range e.Receipt.Source.Inputs {
+		path, err := unityPath(e.Receipt.Root, input.Path, true)
+		if err == nil {
+			inputs[path] = input
+		}
+	}
+	// Observation.ContentHash is the extractor-epoch fingerprint, not a raw
+	// SHA256. Verify the raw producer-bound bytes first, then compare only the
+	// authoritative current fingerprint. Cache once per source within this call.
+	fingerprints := map[string]string{}
+	out := []core.SymbolNode{}
+	for _, o := range observations {
+		if o.SourceKind != core.KindCSharpMethod {
+			continue
+		}
+		path, err := unityPath(e.Receipt.Root, o.SourceRef, false)
+		input, bound := inputs[path]
+		if err != nil || !bound || o.ContentHash == "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		fingerprint, checked := fingerprints[path]
+		if !checked {
+			fingerprint = ""
+			if source, readErr := unityFileBytes(e.Receipt.Root, input, 16<<20); readErr == nil {
+				fingerprint = fusion.FingerprintHash(source)
+			}
+			fingerprints[path] = fingerprint
+		}
+		if fingerprint != "" && fingerprint == o.ContentHash {
+			out = append(out, o.ToSymbolNode())
+		}
+	}
+	return out
+}

+// This is a synthetic producer/SCIP fixture. The syntax observations, including
+// the display truncation and extraction fingerprint, come from actual fusion
+// ingest. The source has two declared variants, matching the native XML cohort.
+func unityLongAttributeFixture(t *testing.T, suffix string) (UnityEvidence, []core.SymbolNode) {
+	t.Helper()
+	f := newUnityFixture(t)
+	sourcePath := f.r.Project + "/Assets/BowlTests.cs"
+	attributes := "[TestCase(1)]\n[TestCase(2)]\n" + `[Category("` + strings.Repeat("category", 45) + `")]` + "\n" + suffix
+	// Use normal authored lines. A single line plus the qualified policy would
+	// exceed the connector's existing minified-file average-line boundary.
+	source := []byte("namespace Workshop {\npublic class BowlTests {\n" + attributes + "\npublic void Fits(int n) {}\n}\n}\n")
+	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(f.root, sourcePath), source, 0600); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	for i := range f.r.Source.Inputs {
+		if f.r.Source.Inputs[i].Path == sourcePath {
+			f.r.Source.Inputs[i].SHA256 = unityDigest(source)
+		}
+	}
+	addUnityTypedFixture(t, f)
+	rewriteUnityTypedDefinition(t, f, func(o *scippb.Occurrence) {
+		before := string(source[:strings.Index(string(source), "Fits(")])
+		line := int32(strings.Count(before, "\n"))
+		column := int32(len(before) - strings.LastIndex(before, "\n") - 1)
+		o.Range = []int32{line, column, column + 4}
+	})
+	e, err := f.load()
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	st := store.NewMemoryStore()
+	pipeline := fusion.New(connector.NewLocalConnector(), st, fusion.Config{DisableTypedEdges: true})
+	t.Cleanup(pipeline.Close)
+	if _, err := pipeline.Ingest(context.Background(), core.ServiceRef{ID: "svc", Path: f.root}); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	observations, err := st.QueryObservations(context.Background(), "svc", "")
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	current := UnityCurrentSymbols(e, observations)
+	if len(current) != 1 || current[0].Name != "BowlTests.Fits" || !strings.HasSuffix(current[0].Signature, "…") {
+		t.Fatalf("fixture must exercise the real clipped method display: current=%+v observations=%+v", current, observations)
+	}
+	if current[0].IsTest() {
+		t.Fatal("a clipped attribute list must not be accepted as a complete test policy")
+	}
+	return e, current
+}

+func TestUnityNUnitLongAttributesJoinFromBoundCurrentSource(t *testing.T) {
+	e, current := unityLongAttributeFixture(t, "")
+	joined, binding, err := UnityJoinCases(e, current)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	key := current[0].Key()
+	if len(joined) != 2 || joined[0].TestSymbolKey != key || joined[1].TestSymbolKey != key || binding.Cohorts[key] != "pass" {
+		t.Fatalf("a complete current two-variant method lost its typed native identity: joined=%+v binding=%+v", joined, binding)
+	}
+}

+func TestUnityNUnitLongAttributesCannotHideRetryPolicy(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, suffix := range []string{"[Retry(2)]", "[NUnit.Framework.Repeat(2)]"} {
+		t.Run(suffix, func(t *testing.T) {
+			e, current := unityLongAttributeFixture(t, suffix)
+			if strings.Contains(current[0].Signature, "Retry") || strings.Contains(current[0].Signature, "Repeat") {
+				t.Fatal("retry policy must be beyond the clipped display boundary")
+			}
+			joined, binding, err := UnityJoinCases(e, current)
+			if err != nil {
+				t.Fatal(err)
+			}
+			if len(binding.CaseKeys) != 0 || len(binding.Cohorts) != 0 {
+				t.Fatalf("hidden unsupported retry policy was joined: %+v", binding)
+			}
+			for _, c := range joined {
+				if c.TestSymbolKey != "" {
+					t.Fatal("retry case acquired a native method identity")
+				}
+			}
+		})
+	}

+func TestUnityNUnitLongAttributesKeepExactDeclarationAndSourceGuards(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, which := range []string{"wrong end line", "duplicate declaration", "filtered family", "source changed"} {
+		t.Run(which, func(t *testing.T) {
+			e, current := unityLongAttributeFixture(t, "")
+			switch which {
+			case "wrong end line":
+				current[0].EndLine++
+			case "duplicate declaration":
+				current = append(current, current[0])
+			case "filtered family":
+				e.Receipt.Filter = "Workshop.BowlTests.Fits(1)"
+			case "source changed":
+				path := filepath.Join(e.Receipt.Root, current[0].FilePath)
+				if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte("// changed after attestation\n"), 0600); err != nil {
+					t.Fatal(err)
+				}
+			}
+			joined, binding, err := UnityJoinCases(e, current)
+			if which == "source changed" {
+				if err == nil {
+					t.Fatal("changed bound source was not refused")
+				}
+				return
+			}
+			if err != nil || len(binding.CaseKeys) != 0 || len(binding.Cohorts) != 0 {
+				t.Fatalf("unexpected guard result: %+v %v", binding, err)
+			}
+			for _, c := range joined {
+				if c.TestSymbolKey != "" {
+					t.Fatal("non-exact declaration acquired a runtime identity")
+				}
+			}
+		})
+	}

+func addUnityTypedFixture(t testing.TB, f *unityFixture) core.SymbolNode {
+	t.Helper()
+	project := f.r.Project
+	source := project + "/Assets/BowlTests.cs"
+	files := map[string]string{project + "/Workshop.Tests.csproj": `<Project><PropertyGroup><AssemblyName>Workshop.Tests</AssemblyName></PropertyGroup><ItemGroup><Compile Include="Assets/BowlTests.cs"/></ItemGroup></Project>`, "sdk.dll": "synthetic reference fixture", "scip-dotnet.nupkg": "synthetic producer fixture"}
+	for path, body := range files {
+		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(f.root, path), []byte(body), 0600); err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+		f.r.Source.Inputs = append(f.r.Source.Inputs, UnityFile{path, unityDigest([]byte(body))})
+	}
+	index := &scippb.Index{Metadata: &scippb.Metadata{ProjectRoot: "file://" + filepath.ToSlash(f.root), ToolInfo: &scippb.ToolInfo{Name: "scip-dotnet", Version: "0.1.0-SNAPSHOT"}}, Documents: []*scippb.Document{{RelativePath: source, Language: "C#", Occurrences: []*scippb.Occurrence{{Symbol: "scip-dotnet nuget . . Workshop/BowlTests#Fits().", SymbolRoles: 1, Range: []int32{0, 43, 47}}}}}}
+	raw, err := proto.Marshal(index)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	path := filepath.Join(f.root, "index.scip")
+	if err = os.WriteFile(path, raw, 0600); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	inputs := []scip.SourceInput{}
+	for _, v := range f.r.Source.Inputs {
+		inputs = append(inputs, scip.SourceInput{Path: v.Path, SHA256: v.SHA256})
+	}
+	receipt := scip.SourceReceipt{Schema: scip.SourceReceiptSchema, Status: "complete", Root: f.root, IndexSHA256: unityDigest(raw), Producer: scip.SourceProducer{Name: "scip-dotnet", Version: "0.1.0-SNAPSHOT", DistributionVersion: "0.2.14", PackagePath: "scip-dotnet.nupkg", PackageSHA256: unityDigest([]byte(files["scip-dotnet.nupkg"]))}, Inputs: inputs, Inventories: []scip.SourceInventory{{Root: project + "/Assets", Pattern: "*.cs", Paths: []string{source}}}}
+	writeUnityJSON(t, path+".receipt.json", receipt)
+	receiptBytes, err := os.ReadFile(path + ".receipt.json")
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	f.r.Symbols = &UnitySymbols{SCIPPath: "index.scip", SCIPSHA256: unityDigest(raw), SourceReceiptSHA256: unityDigest(receiptBytes)}
+	f.r.Source.BeforeSHA256 = unityDigest(UnitySourceBytes(f.r.Source))
+	f.r.Source.AfterSHA256 = f.r.Source.BeforeSHA256
+	f.envelope["key"] = "sha256:" + f.r.Source.BeforeSHA256
+	f.envelope["artifacts"] = []ArtifactRef{{"unity-nunit-xml", "sha256:" + f.r.XML.SHA256}, {"unity-source-inputs", "sha256:" + f.r.Source.BeforeSHA256}}
+	f.saveEnvelope(t)
+	f.save(t)
+	return core.SymbolNode{Service: "svc", Kind: core.KindCSharpMethod, Name: "BowlTests.Fits", Package: "Workshop", FilePath: source, Line: 1, EndLine: 1, Signature: "[TestCase(1)] [TestCase(2)] public void Fits(int value)"}
+}
+func TestUnityNUnitTypedJoinRequiresExactAssemblyDefinitionAndUniqueMethod(t *testing.T) {
+	f := newUnityFixture(t)
+	symbol := addUnityTypedFixture(t, f)
+	e, err := f.load()
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	joined, binding, err := UnityJoinCases(e, []core.SymbolNode{symbol})
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if len(joined) != 2 || joined[0].TestSymbolKey != symbol.Key() || joined[1].TestSymbolKey != symbol.Key() || binding.Cohorts[symbol.Key()] != "pass" {
+		t.Fatalf("join %+v binding %+v", joined, binding)
+	}
+	tests := map[string]func(UnityEvidence, core.SymbolNode) (UnityEvidence, []core.SymbolNode){
+		"missing definitions": func(e UnityEvidence, s core.SymbolNode) (UnityEvidence, []core.SymbolNode) {
+			s.Line++
+			return e, []core.SymbolNode{s}
+		},
+		"same bare name other namespace": func(e UnityEvidence, s core.SymbolNode) (UnityEvidence, []core.SymbolNode) {
+			s.Package = "Other"
+			return e, []core.SymbolNode{s}
+		},
+		"overloaded same source identity": func(e UnityEvidence, s core.SymbolNode) (UnityEvidence, []core.SymbolNode) {
+			copy := s
+			copy.Line++
+			return e, []core.SymbolNode{s, copy}
+		},
+		"duplicate indexed declaration": func(e UnityEvidence, s core.SymbolNode) (UnityEvidence, []core.SymbolNode) {
+			return e, []core.SymbolNode{s, s}
+		},
+		"non test method": func(e UnityEvidence, s core.SymbolNode) (UnityEvidence, []core.SymbolNode) {
+			s.Signature = "public void Fits(int value)"
+			return e, []core.SymbolNode{s}
+		},
+		"retry unsupported": func(e UnityEvidence, s core.SymbolNode) (UnityEvidence, []core.SymbolNode) {
+			s.Signature = "[TestCase(1)] [Retry(2)] public void Fits(int value)"
+			return e, []core.SymbolNode{s}
+		},
+		"wrong native assembly": func(e UnityEvidence, s core.SymbolNode) (UnityEvidence, []core.SymbolNode) {
+			e.Native.Cohorts[0].Assembly = "Other.Tests"
+			return e, []core.SymbolNode{s}
+		},
+		"nested native identity": func(e UnityEvidence, s core.SymbolNode) (UnityEvidence, []core.SymbolNode) {
+			e.Native.Cohorts[0].ClassName = "Workshop.Outer+BowlTests"
+			return e, []core.SymbolNode{s}
+		},
+		"no typed artifact": func(e UnityEvidence, s core.SymbolNode) (UnityEvidence, []core.SymbolNode) {
+			e.Receipt.Symbols = nil
+			return e, []core.SymbolNode{s}
+		},
+	}
+	for name, mutate := range tests {
+		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			f := newUnityFixture(t)
+			s := addUnityTypedFixture(t, f)
+			e, err := f.load()

+				t.Fatal(err)
+			}
+			e, syms := mutate(e, s)
+			joined, _, err := UnityJoinCases(e, syms)
+			if err != nil {
+				t.Fatal(err)
+			}
+			for _, c := range joined {
+				if c.TestSymbolKey != "" {
+					t.Fatalf("guessed join %+v", c)
+				}
+			}
+		})
+	}

+func rewriteUnityTypedDefinition(t *testing.T, f *unityFixture, mutate func(*scippb.Occurrence)) {
+	t.Helper()
+	path := filepath.Join(f.root, "index.scip")
+	raw, err := os.ReadFile(path)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	var index scippb.Index
+	if err = proto.Unmarshal(raw, &index); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	mutate(index.Documents[0].Occurrences[0])
+	raw, err = proto.Marshal(&index)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if err = os.WriteFile(path, raw, 0600); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	receiptBytes, err := os.ReadFile(path + ".receipt.json")
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	var receipt scip.SourceReceipt
+	if err = json.Unmarshal(receiptBytes, &receipt); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	receipt.IndexSHA256 = unityDigest(raw)
+	writeUnityJSON(t, path+".receipt.json", receipt)
+	receiptBytes, _ = os.ReadFile(path + ".receipt.json")
+	f.r.Symbols.SCIPSHA256 = unityDigest(raw)
+	f.r.Symbols.SourceReceiptSHA256 = unityDigest(receiptBytes)
+	f.save(t)
+}

+func TestUnityNUnitCurrentSymbolsRequiresIndexedSourceHash(t *testing.T) {
+	f := newUnityFixture(t)
+	sourcePath := f.r.Project + "/Assets/BowlTests.cs"
+	source := []byte("namespace Workshop { public class BowlTests { [TestCase(1)] [TestCase(2)] public void Fits(int n) {} } }\n")
+	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(f.root, sourcePath), source, 0600); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	for i := range f.r.Source.Inputs {
+		if f.r.Source.Inputs[i].Path == sourcePath {
+			f.r.Source.Inputs[i].SHA256 = unityDigest(source)
+		}
+	}
+	symbol := addUnityTypedFixture(t, f)
+	e, err := f.load()
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	st := store.NewMemoryStore()
+	pipeline := fusion.New(connector.NewLocalConnector(), st, fusion.Config{DisableTypedEdges: true})
+	if _, err = pipeline.Ingest(context.Background(), core.ServiceRef{ID: "svc", Path: f.root}); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	observations, err := st.QueryObservations(context.Background(), "svc", "")
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	methodRows := []core.Observation{}
+	for _, o := range observations {
+		if o.SourceKind == core.KindCSharpMethod {
+			methodRows = append(methodRows, o)
+		}
+	}
+	if len(methodRows) != 1 {
+		t.Fatalf("actual method observations %+v", methodRows)
+	}
+	o := methodRows[0]
+	if o.ContentHash != fusion.FingerprintHash(append([]byte(nil), source...)) || o.ContentHash == unityDigest(source) {
+		t.Fatal("fixture did not exercise actual epoch-salted fingerprint")
+	}
+	current := UnityCurrentSymbols(e, methodRows)
+	if len(current) != 1 {
+		t.Fatalf("fresh fusion observation refused: %+v", o)
+	}
+	joined, _, err := UnityJoinCases(e, current)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if len(joined) != 2 || joined[0].TestSymbolKey != symbol.Key() || joined[1].TestSymbolKey != symbol.Key() {
+		t.Fatalf("actual extracted typed join %+v", joined)
+	}
+	old := sha256.Sum256(append(append([]byte(nil), source...), []byte("\x00fathom-extractor-epoch:not-current")...))
+	for _, hash := range []string{"", "stale", unityDigest(source), fmt.Sprintf("%x", old)} {
+		o.ContentHash = hash
+		if got := UnityCurrentSymbols(e, []core.Observation{o}); len(got) != 0 {
+			t.Fatalf("wrong fingerprint %q admitted", hash)
+		}
+	}
+	// A stale receipt cannot borrow current syntax observations after bytes change.
+	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(f.root, sourcePath), append(source, []byte("// changed\n")...), 0600); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if got := UnityCurrentSymbols(e, methodRows); len(got) != 0 {
+		t.Fatal("changed raw source admitted")
+	}
+}

+// A runner filter may select just one passing parameterized case. Unity's
+// testcasecount then describes that selection, not the whole declared family.
+func TestUnityNUnitFilteredRunsStayUnjoined(t *testing.T) {
+	f := newUnityFixture(t)
+	symbol := addUnityTypedFixture(t, f)
+	raw := strings.ReplaceAll(nativeFixtureXML, `testcasecount="2"`, `testcasecount="1"`)
+	raw = strings.ReplaceAll(raw, `total="2" passed="2"`, `total="1" passed="1"`)
+	raw = strings.ReplaceAll(raw, `<test-case id="2" name="Fits(2)" fullname="Workshop.BowlTests.Fits(2)" classname="Workshop.BowlTests" methodname="Fits" result="Passed" duration="0.2"/>`, "")
+	if err := os.WriteFile(f.xml, []byte(raw), 0600); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	f.r.XML.SHA256 = unityDigest([]byte(raw))
+	f.r.Filter = "Workshop.BowlTests.Fits(1)"
+	f.r.Command = append(f.r.Command, "-testFilter", f.r.Filter)
+	f.envelope["cases"] = f.envelope["cases"].([]Case)[:1]
+	f.envelope["totals"] = Totals{Run: 1, Passed: 1}
+	f.envelope["artifacts"] = []ArtifactRef{{"unity-nunit-xml", "sha256:" + f.r.XML.SHA256}, {"unity-source-inputs", "sha256:" + f.r.Source.BeforeSHA256}}
+	f.saveEnvelope(t)
+	f.save(t)
+	e, err := f.load()
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if e.Native.Total != 1 || len(e.Native.Cohorts) != 1 || e.Native.Cohorts[0].Expected != 1 {
+		t.Fatal("fixture is not an actual one-case selected cohort")
+	}
+	joined, binding, err := UnityJoinCases(e, []core.SymbolNode{symbol})
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if len(joined) != 1 || joined[0].TestSymbolKey != "" || len(binding.Cohorts) != 0 {
+		t.Fatalf("filtered passing leaf promoted to whole-method result: %+v %+v", joined, binding)
+	}
+	st := store.NewMemoryStore()
+	seedUnitySymbol(t, st, f, symbol)
+	run, err := UnityEvidenceRun(e, []core.SymbolNode{symbol})
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	report, err := IngestRuns(context.Background(), st, "svc", "filtered", []Run{run})
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if report.CasesJoined != 0 {
+		t.Fatal("filtered case joined on ingestion")
+	}
+	if got := nativeStatus(t, st, symbol.Key()); got.Status != "" {
+		t.Fatalf("filtered method runtime evidence %+v", got)
+	}
+}

+// record. The receipt is a local assertion plus integrity/freshness binding,

+const UnityReceiptSchema = "fathom.unity.nunit/v1"
+const unityJSONLimit = 32 << 20
+const unityInputLimit = 100000
+const unityInputBytesLimit int64 = 8 << 30

+var ErrUnityEvidence = errors.New("Unity NUnit evidence refused")
+var unitySHA = regexp.MustCompile(`^[0-9a-f]{64}$`)

+type UnityFile struct {

+	SHA256 string `json:"sha256"`

+// UnityEvidence is a validated native parse and its standard record. A missing
+// typed identity leaves cases unjoined; parsing alone never writes test_runs.
+type UnityEvidence struct {
+	Receipt                    UnityReceipt
+	Native                     testrun.NUnitRun
+	Run                        Run
+	ReceiptPath, ReceiptSHA256 string

+// UnitySourceBytes is the documented canonical input representation. Validation
+// rejects duplicate/noncanonical inputs before using this representation.
+func UnitySourceBytes(source UnitySource) []byte {
+	var b bytes.Buffer
+	b.WriteString("fathom.unity.inputs/v1\n")
+	trees := append([]UnityInventory(nil), source.Inventories...)
+	sort.Slice(trees, func(i, j int) bool { return trees[i].Root < trees[j].Root })
+	for _, tree := range trees {
+		b.WriteString("tree\x00" + tree.Root + "\n")
+	}
+	inputs := append([]UnityFile(nil), source.Inputs...)
+	sort.Slice(inputs, func(i, j int) bool { return inputs[i].Path < inputs[j].Path })
+	for _, input := range inputs {
+		b.WriteString("file\x00" + input.Path + "\x00" + input.SHA256 + "\n")
+	}
+	return b.Bytes()
+}
+func unityDigest(raw []byte) string { sum := sha256.Sum256(raw); return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:]) }
+func unityError(format string, args ...any) error {
+	return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s", ErrUnityEvidence, fmt.Sprintf(format, args...))
+}
+func unitySafeText(s string) bool {
+	if !utf8.ValidString(s) {
+		return false
+	}
+	for _, r := range s {
+		if r < 32 || r == 127 {
+			return false
+		}
+	}
+	return true
+}
+func unityPath(root, path string, absolute bool) (string, error) {
+	if path == "" || !unitySafeText(path) || strings.Contains(path, "\\") {
+		return "", fmt.Errorf("unsafe path")
+	}
+	if filepath.IsAbs(path) {
+		if !absolute || filepath.Clean(path) != path {
+			return "", fmt.Errorf("unexpected/noncanonical absolute path")
+		}
+		return path, nil
+	}
+	if !fs.ValidPath(path) || path == "." {
+		return "", fmt.Errorf("noncanonical relative path")
+	}
+	return filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(path)), nil
+}
+func unityRegular(path string) (fs.FileInfo, error) {
+	for at := path; ; at = filepath.Dir(at) {
+		info, err := os.Lstat(at)
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("symlink path")
+		}
+		if at == path && !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("not a regular file")
+		}
+		if filepath.Dir(at) == at {
+			break
+		}
+	}
+	return os.Stat(path)
+}
+func unityRead(path string, limit int64) ([]byte, error) {
+	info, err := unityRegular(path)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	if info.Size() > limit {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("file exceeds %d bytes", limit)
+	}
+	f, err := os.Open(path)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	defer f.Close()
+	raw, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(f, limit+1))
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	if int64(len(raw)) > limit {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("file grew beyond byte limit")
+	}
+	return raw, nil
+}
+func unityHash(ctx context.Context, path string, limit int64) (string, int64, error) {
+	info, err := unityRegular(path)
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", 0, err
+	}
+	if info.Size() > limit {
+		return "", 0, fmt.Errorf("input byte budget exceeded")
+	}
+	f, err := os.Open(path)
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", 0, err
+	}
+	defer f.Close()
+	h := sha256.New()
+	bufferSize := info.Size() + 1
+	if bufferSize > 128<<10 {
+		bufferSize = 128 << 10
+	}
+	buf := make([]byte, int(bufferSize))
+	var count int64
+	for {
+		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
+			return "", 0, err
+		}
+		n, e := f.Read(buf)
+		if n > 0 {
+			count += int64(n)
+			if count > limit {
+				return "", 0, fmt.Errorf("input grew beyond budget")
+			}
+			h.Write(buf[:n])
+		}
+		if e == io.EOF {
+			break
+		}
+		if e != nil {
+			return "", 0, e
+		}
+	}
+	if count != info.Size() {
+		return "", 0, fmt.Errorf("input size changed during read")
+	}
+	return hex.EncodeToString(h.Sum(nil)), count, nil
+}
+
+// Duplicate JSON members are refused before struct or CUE decoding. Encoding/json
+// otherwise accepts the last member, silently hiding contradictory provenance.
+func unityUniqueJSON(raw []byte) error {
+	if len(raw) == 0 || !utf8.Valid(raw) {
+		return fmt.Errorf("empty/invalid UTF8 JSON")
+	}
+	d := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(raw))
+	d.UseNumber()
+	var value func(int) error
+	value = func(depth int) error {
+		if depth > 64 {
+			return fmt.Errorf("JSON depth exceeded")
+		}
+		t, err := d.Token()
+		if err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		delim, ok := t.(json.Delim)
+		if !ok {
+			return nil
+		}
+		switch delim {
+		case '{':
+			seen := map[string]bool{}
+			for d.More() {
+				key, err := d.Token()
+				if err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+				k, ok := key.(string)
+				if !ok || seen[k] {
+					return fmt.Errorf("duplicate/invalid JSON member %q", k)
+				}
+				seen[k] = true
+				if err := value(depth + 1); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+			}
+		case '[':
+			for d.More() {
+				if err := value(depth + 1); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+			}
+		default:
+			return fmt.Errorf("unexpected JSON delimiter")
+		}
+		_, err = d.Token()
+		return err
+	}
+	if err := value(0); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	if _, err := d.Token(); err != io.EOF {
+		return fmt.Errorf("trailing JSON")
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+func unityDecode(raw []byte, out any) error {
+	if err := unityUniqueJSON(raw); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	d := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(raw))
+	d.DisallowUnknownFields()
+	if err := d.Decode(out); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	if d.Decode(new(any)) != io.EOF {
+		return fmt.Errorf("trailing JSON")
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+func unityFileBytes(root string, file UnityFile, limit int64) ([]byte, error) {
+	if !unitySHA.MatchString(file.SHA256) {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid SHA256")
+	}
+	path, err := unityPath(root, file.Path, true)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	raw, err := unityRead(path, limit)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	if unityDigest(raw) != file.SHA256 {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("file hash changed: %s", file.Path)
+	}
+	return raw, nil
+}
+func unityValidateSource(ctx context.Context, root string, r UnityReceipt) error {
+	s := r.Source
+	if !unitySHA.MatchString(s.BeforeSHA256) || s.BeforeSHA256 != s.AfterSHA256 || unityDigest(UnitySourceBytes(s)) != s.BeforeSHA256 {
+		return fmt.Errorf("source before/after/canonical digests disagree")
+	}
+	if len(s.Inputs) == 0 || len(s.Inputs) > unityInputLimit || len(s.Inventories) != 3 {
+		return fmt.Errorf("source input/inventory count outside native bounds")
+	}
+	inputs := map[string]string{}
+	var bytes int64
+	for _, input := range s.Inputs {
+		path, err := unityPath(root, input.Path, true)
+		if err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		if _, ok := inputs[path]; ok {
+			return fmt.Errorf("duplicate source input")
+		}
+		if !unitySHA.MatchString(input.SHA256) {
+			return fmt.Errorf("invalid source hash")
+		}
+		hash, size, err := unityHash(ctx, path, unityInputBytesLimit-bytes)
+		if err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		bytes += size
+		if hash != input.SHA256 {
+			return fmt.Errorf("source input changed: %s", input.Path)
+		}
+		inputs[path] = hash
+	}
+	required := map[string]bool{}
+	for _, name := range []string{"Assets", "Packages", "ProjectSettings"} {
+		required[r.Project+"/"+name] = true
+	}
+	for _, tree := range s.Inventories {
+		if !required[tree.Root] {
+			return fmt.Errorf("missing/duplicate/unexpected Unity inventory")
+		}
+		delete(required, tree.Root)
+		path, err := unityPath(root, tree.Root, false)
+		if err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		info, statErr := os.Lstat(path)
+		if statErr != nil || !info.IsDir() || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
+			return fmt.Errorf("Unity inventory root is not a regular directory")
+		}
+		if tree.Paths == nil || len(tree.Paths) > unityInputLimit || !sort.StringsAreSorted(tree.Paths) {
+			return fmt.Errorf("inventory membership must be bounded/sorted")
+		}
+		members := []string{}
+		visited := 0
+		err = filepath.WalkDir(path, func(at string, entry fs.DirEntry, walkErr error) error {
+			if walkErr != nil {
+				return walkErr
+			}
+			visited++
+			if visited > unityInputLimit {
+				return fmt.Errorf("inventory entry budget exceeded")
+			}
+			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+			if entry.Type()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
+				return fmt.Errorf("symlink inventory member")
+			}
+			if entry.IsDir() {
+				return nil
+			}
+			if !entry.Type().IsRegular() {
+				return fmt.Errorf("nonregular inventory member")
+			}
+			relative, err := filepath.Rel(root, at)
+			if err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+			key := filepath.ToSlash(relative)
+			if _, err = unityPath(root, key, false); err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+			if _, ok := inputs[at]; !ok {
+				return fmt.Errorf("inventory member has no input hash")
+			}
+			members = append(members, key)
+			if len(members) > unityInputLimit {
+				return fmt.Errorf("inventory member budget exceeded")
+			}
+			return nil
+		})
+		if err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		sort.Strings(members)
+		if !slices.Equal(members, tree.Paths) {
+			return fmt.Errorf("inventory membership changed: %s", tree.Root)
+		}
+	}
+
+	for _, entry := range []struct {
+		name string
+		file UnityFile
+	}{{"producer", UnityFile{r.Producer.Path, r.Producer.SHA256}}, {"Editor", UnityFile{r.Editor.Path, r.Editor.SHA256}}} {
+		path, err := unityPath(root, entry.file.Path, true)
+		if err != nil {
+			return fmt.Errorf("%s path is not canonical: %w", entry.name, err)
+		}
+		if inputs[path] != entry.file.SHA256 {
+			return fmt.Errorf("%s missing from source closure", entry.name)
+		}
+	}
+
+	return nil
+}
+func unityValidateCommand(root string, r UnityReceipt) error {
+	if len(r.Command) < 2 || len(r.Command) > 64 {
+		return fmt.Errorf("invalid Editor argv length")
+	}
+	editor, err := unityPath(root, r.Editor.Path, true)
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	command, err := unityPath(root, r.Command[0], true)
+	if err != nil || command != editor {
+		return fmt.Errorf("command executable differs from Editor")
+	}
+	pairs := map[string]string{}
+	flags := map[string]bool{}
+	for i := 1; i < len(r.Command); i++ {
+		a := r.Command[i]
+		if !unitySafeText(a) {
+			return fmt.Errorf("unsafe Editor argv")
+		}
+		switch a {
+		case "-batchmode", "-runTests", "-nographics":
+			if flags[a] {
+				return fmt.Errorf("duplicate Editor flag")
+			}
+			flags[a] = true
+		case "-projectPath", "-buildTarget", "-testPlatform", "-testResults", "-testFilter", "-logFile":
+			if _, ok := pairs[a]; ok || i+1 == len(r.Command) {
+				return fmt.Errorf("duplicate/missing Editor argument")
+			}
+			i++
+			if !unitySafeText(r.Command[i]) {
+				return fmt.Errorf("unsafe Editor argument")
+			}
+			pairs[a] = r.Command[i]
+		default:
+			return fmt.Errorf("unsupported Editor argument at position %d", i)
+		}
+	}
+	project, _ := unityPath(root, r.Project, false)
+	xmlPath, err := unityPath(root, r.XML.Path, true)
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	recordedProject, err := unityPath(root, pairs["-projectPath"], true)
+	if err != nil || recordedProject != project {
+		return fmt.Errorf("Editor project differs")
+	}
+	recordedXML, err := unityPath(root, pairs["-testResults"], true)
+	if err != nil || recordedXML != xmlPath {
+		return fmt.Errorf("Editor XML path differs")
+	}
+	if !flags["-runTests"] || pairs["-buildTarget"] != r.Target || pairs["-testPlatform"] != r.Mode || pairs["-testFilter"] != r.Filter {
+		return fmt.Errorf("Editor mode/target/filter/run flags differ")
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+// LoadUnityNUnitEvidence reads only local artifacts. A complete receipt without
+// a matching standard test-kit envelope is refused, never promoted from XML.
+func LoadUnityNUnitEvidence(ctx context.Context, root, xmlPath, receiptPath string) (UnityEvidence, error) {
+	refuse := func(err error) (UnityEvidence, error) { return UnityEvidence{}, unityError("%v", err) }
+	actualRoot, err := filepath.Abs(root)
+	if err != nil {
+		return refuse(err)
+	}
+	actualRoot = filepath.Clean(actualRoot)
+	if !unitySafeText(actualRoot) {
+		return refuse(fmt.Errorf("unsafe target root"))
+	}
+	raw, err := unityRead(receiptPath, unityJSONLimit)
+	if err != nil {
+		return refuse(err)
+	}
+	var required map[string]json.RawMessage
+	if err = json.Unmarshal(raw, &required); err != nil {
+		return refuse(err)
+	}
+	for _, key := range []string{"schema", "status", "run_id", "root", "project", "mode", "target", "filter", "started_at", "finished_at", "producer", "editor", "command", "exit_code", "xml", "source", "attestation"} {
+		if _, present := required[key]; !present {
+			return refuse(fmt.Errorf("complete receipt missing %s", key))
+		}
+	}
+	if filter := bytes.TrimSpace(required["filter"]); len(filter) == 0 || filter[0] != '"' {
+		return refuse(fmt.Errorf("filter must be an explicit string"))
+	}
+	var r UnityReceipt
+	if err = unityDecode(raw, &r); err != nil {
+		return refuse(err)
+	}
+	if r.Schema != UnityReceiptSchema || r.Status != "complete" {
+		return refuse(fmt.Errorf("receipt schema/status is not complete native v1"))
+	}
+	if r.Root != actualRoot || !filepath.IsAbs(r.Root) {
+		return refuse(fmt.Errorf("receipt root differs from target root"))
+	}
+	if _, err = unityPath(actualRoot, r.Project, false); err != nil {
+		return refuse(err)
+	}
+	expectedActive := filepath.Join(actualRoot, ".artifacts", "unity-tests", "active", filepath.FromSlash(r.Project), r.Mode+".json")
+	requestedReceipt, err := filepath.Abs(receiptPath)
+	if err != nil || filepath.Clean(requestedReceipt) != expectedActive {
+		return refuse(fmt.Errorf("execution admission requires the active project/mode receipt"))
+	}
+	if r.RunID == "" || len(r.RunID) > 256 || !unitySafeText(r.RunID) || strings.ContainsAny(r.RunID, "/\\") {
+		return refuse(fmt.Errorf("invalid native run id"))
+	}
+	if r.Mode != "EditMode" && r.Mode != "PlayMode" {
+		return refuse(fmt.Errorf("unsupported Unity mode"))
+	}
+	if !slices.Contains([]string{"StandaloneOSX", "StandaloneWindows64", "StandaloneLinux64", "WebGL"}, r.Target) {
+		return refuse(fmt.Errorf("unsupported selected target"))
+	}
+	if !unitySafeText(r.Filter) || r.ExitCode == nil {
+		return refuse(fmt.Errorf("missing exit code/unsafe filter"))
+	}
+	if r.Producer.Name != "unity-local-runner" || r.Producer.Version != "1" || r.Editor.Version == "" {
+		return refuse(fmt.Errorf("unsupported/missing producer or Editor version"))
+	}
+	if err = unityValidateCommand(actualRoot, r); err != nil {
+		return refuse(err)
+	}
+	versionPath := filepath.Join(actualRoot, filepath.FromSlash(r.Project), "ProjectSettings", "ProjectVersion.txt")
+	version, versionErr := unityRead(versionPath, 1<<20)
+	if versionErr != nil || !slices.Contains(strings.Split(string(version), "\n"), "m_EditorVersion: "+r.Editor.Version) {
+		return refuse(fmt.Errorf("declared Editor differs from the project version"))
+	}
+	if err = unityValidateSource(ctx, actualRoot, r); err != nil {
+		return refuse(err)
+	}
+	xmlRaw, err := unityFileBytes(actualRoot, r.XML, 16<<20)
+	if err != nil {
+		return refuse(err)
+	}
+	resolvedXML, _ := unityPath(actualRoot, r.XML.Path, true)
+	requestedXML, err := unityPath(actualRoot, xmlPath, true)
+	if err != nil || filepath.Clean(requestedXML) != resolvedXML {
+		return refuse(fmt.Errorf("requested XML differs from receipt"))
+	}
+	native, err := testrun.ParseUnityNUnitXML(xmlRaw)
+	if err != nil {
+		return refuse(err)
+	}
+	if native.Total == 0 {
+		return refuse(fmt.Errorf("native producer record contains no executed/discovered cases"))
+	}
+
+	start, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, r.StartedAt)
+	if err != nil {
+		return refuse(err)
+	}
+	finish, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, r.FinishedAt)
+	if err != nil || finish.Before(start) {
+		return refuse(fmt.Errorf("invalid producer interval"))
+	}
+	nativeStart, _ := testrun.NUnitTime(native.StartedAt)
+	nativeEnd, _ := testrun.NUnitTime(native.FinishedAt)
+	if nativeStart.Before(start.Add(-time.Second)) || nativeEnd.After(finish.Add(time.Second)) {
+		return refuse(fmt.Errorf("native XML lies outside producer interval"))
+	}
+	if native.Result == "Passed" && *r.ExitCode != 0 {
+		return refuse(fmt.Errorf("passing XML contradicts nonzero Editor exit"))
+	}
+	envelope, err := unityFileBytes(actualRoot, r.Attestation, unityJSONLimit)
+	if err != nil {
+		return refuse(fmt.Errorf("mandatory test-kit envelope: %w", err))
+	}
+	run, err := unityValidateEnvelope(envelope, r, native)
+	if err != nil {
+		return refuse(err)
+	}
+	if r.Symbols != nil {
+		symbols := r.Symbols
+		indexRaw, err := unityFileBytes(actualRoot, UnityFile{symbols.SCIPPath, symbols.SCIPSHA256}, 256<<20)
+		if err != nil {
+			return refuse(err)
+		}
+		indexPath, _ := unityPath(actualRoot, symbols.SCIPPath, true)
+		if _, err = unityFileBytes(actualRoot, UnityFile{symbols.SCIPPath + ".receipt.json", symbols.SourceReceiptSHA256}, 8<<20); err != nil {
+			return refuse(err)
+		}
+		if _, err = scip.ValidateSourceReceipt(ctx, actualRoot, indexPath, indexRaw, true); err != nil {
+			return refuse(err)
+		}
+	}
+	receiptAbsolute, err := filepath.Abs(receiptPath)
+	if err != nil {
+		return refuse(err)
+	}
+	return UnityEvidence{Receipt: r, Native: native, Run: run, ReceiptPath: receiptAbsolute, ReceiptSHA256: unityDigest(raw)}, nil
+}

+const nativeFixtureXML = `<?xml version="1.0"?><test-run id="2" testcasecount="2" total="2" passed="2" failed="0" skipped="0" inconclusive="0" result="Passed" start-time="2026-10-19 12:00:01Z" end-time="2026-10-19 12:00:02Z" duration="1.0"><test-suite type="Assembly" name="Workshop.Tests.dll"><test-suite type="ParameterizedMethod" id="p1" testcasecount="2"><test-case id="1" name="Fits(1)" fullname="Workshop.BowlTests.Fits(1)" classname="Workshop.BowlTests" methodname="Fits" result="Passed" duration="0.1"/><test-case id="2" name="Fits(2)" fullname="Workshop.BowlTests.Fits(2)" classname="Workshop.BowlTests" methodname="Fits" result="Passed" duration="0.2"/></test-suite></test-suite></test-run>`

+type unityFixture struct {
+	root, xml, receipt string
+	r                  UnityReceipt
+	envelope           map[string]any

+func writeUnityJSON(t testing.TB, path string, v any) {
+	t.Helper()
+	b, err := json.MarshalIndent(v, "", "  ")
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if err = os.WriteFile(path, b, 0600); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+}
+func newUnityFixture(t testing.TB) *unityFixture {
+	t.Helper()
+	root, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(t.TempDir())
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	f := &unityFixture{root: root, xml: filepath.Join(root, "results.xml"), receipt: filepath.Join(root, ".artifacts/unity-tests/active/game/Workshop/EditMode.json")}
+	project := "game/Workshop"
+	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(f.receipt), 0700); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	for _, name := range []string{"Assets", "Packages", "ProjectSettings"} {
+		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(root, project, name), 0700); err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+	}
+	files := map[string]string{"producer.py": "# local synthetic fixture\n", "Editor": "synthetic Editor bytes\n", project + "/Assets/BowlTests.cs": "namespace Workshop { class BowlTests { void Fits(int n) {} } }\n", project + "/Assets/BowlTests.cs.meta": "guid: 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef\n", project + "/Packages/manifest.json": "{}\n", project + "/ProjectSettings/ProjectVersion.txt": "m_EditorVersion: 6000.3.15f1\n"}
+	inputs := []UnityFile{}
+	for path, content := range files {
+		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, path), []byte(content), 0600); err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+		inputs = append(inputs, UnityFile{path, unityDigest([]byte(content))})
+	}
+	inv := []UnityInventory{}
+	for _, name := range []string{"Assets", "Packages", "ProjectSettings"} {
+		members := []string{}
+		for path := range files {
+			if strings.HasPrefix(path, project+"/"+name+"/") {
+				members = append(members, path)
+			}
+		}
+		sortStrings(members)
+		inv = append(inv, UnityInventory{project + "/" + name, members})
+	}
+	s := UnitySource{Inputs: inputs, Inventories: inv}
+	s.BeforeSHA256 = unityDigest(UnitySourceBytes(s))
+	s.AfterSHA256 = s.BeforeSHA256
+	zero := 0
+	f.r = UnityReceipt{Schema: UnityReceiptSchema, Status: "complete", RunID: "synthetic-run-1", Root: root, Project: project, Mode: "EditMode", Target: "WebGL", StartedAt: "2026-10-19T12:00:00.123Z", FinishedAt: "2026-10-19T12:00:03Z", Producer: UnityProducer{"unity-local-runner", "1", "producer.py", unityDigest([]byte(files["producer.py"]))}, Editor: UnityEditor{filepath.Join(root, "Editor"), "6000.3.15f1", unityDigest([]byte(files["Editor"]))}, ExitCode: &zero, XML: UnityFile{"results.xml", unityDigest([]byte(nativeFixtureXML))}, Source: s, Attestation: UnityFile{Path: "test-result.json"}}
+	// Absolute Editor is canonical in both its source row and explicit identity.
+	for i := range f.r.Source.Inputs {
+		if f.r.Source.Inputs[i].Path == "Editor" {
+			f.r.Source.Inputs[i].Path = f.r.Editor.Path
+		}
+	}
+	f.r.Source.BeforeSHA256 = unityDigest(UnitySourceBytes(f.r.Source))
+	f.r.Source.AfterSHA256 = f.r.Source.BeforeSHA256
+	f.r.Command = []string{f.r.Editor.Path, "-batchmode", "-projectPath", filepath.Join(root, project), "-buildTarget", "WebGL", "-runTests", "-testPlatform", "EditMode", "-testResults", f.xml}
+	f.envelope = map[string]any{"suite": map[string]any{"component": project, "name": "EditMode", "class": "integration"}, "key": "sha256:" + f.r.Source.BeforeSHA256, "verdict": "pass", "cases": []Case{{ID: "Workshop.Tests::Workshop.BowlTests.Fits(1)", Name: "Workshop.BowlTests.Fits(1)", Status: "pass", Duration: "100ms", Attempts: 1}, {ID: "Workshop.Tests::Workshop.BowlTests.Fits(2)", Name: "Workshop.BowlTests.Fits(2)", Status: "pass", Duration: "200ms", Attempts: 1}}, "totals": Totals{Run: 2, Passed: 2}, "timing": map[string]any{"startedAt": "2026-10-19T12:00:01Z", "wallClock": "1s"}, "env": map[string]any{"toolchainDigest": "sha256:" + f.r.Editor.SHA256, "runnerClass": "unity", "arch": "arm64", "os": "darwin", "commit": strings.Repeat("a", 40), "dirty": true, "race": false}, "artifacts": []ArtifactRef{{"unity-nunit-xml", "sha256:" + f.r.XML.SHA256}, {"unity-source-inputs", "sha256:" + f.r.Source.BeforeSHA256}}, "flake": map[string]any{"maxRetries": 0, "quarantineAfter": 3, "budget": "0%"}, "trace": map[string]any{"traceId": f.r.RunID}}
+	if err = os.WriteFile(f.xml, []byte(nativeFixtureXML), 0600); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	f.saveEnvelope(t)
+	f.save(t)
+	return f
+}
+func sortStrings(v []string) {
+	for i := 1; i < len(v); i++ {
+		for j := i; j > 0 && v[j] < v[j-1]; j-- {
+			v[j], v[j-1] = v[j-1], v[j]
+		}
+	}
+}
+func (f *unityFixture) saveEnvelope(t testing.TB) {
+	t.Helper()
+	p := filepath.Join(f.root, f.r.Attestation.Path)
+	writeUnityJSON(t, p, f.envelope)
+	b, err := os.ReadFile(p)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	f.r.Attestation.SHA256 = unityDigest(b)
+}
+func (f *unityFixture) save(t testing.TB) { t.Helper(); writeUnityJSON(t, f.receipt, f.r) }
+func (f *unityFixture) load() (UnityEvidence, error) {
+	return LoadUnityNUnitEvidence(context.Background(), f.root, f.xml, f.receipt)
+}

+func TestUnityNUnitReceiptBindsNativeAndStandardRecord(t *testing.T) {
+	f := newUnityFixture(t)
+	got, err := f.load()
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if got.Native.Total != 2 || got.Run.Totals.Passed != 2 || got.Run.Dirty != true || got.Receipt.Symbols != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("bad native record: %+v", got)
+	}
+	if got.Native.Cohorts[0].ObservedVerdict != "pass" {
+		t.Fatalf("cohort=%+v", got.Native.Cohorts)
+	}
+	// Re-reading identical immutable bytes is deterministic, not another run.
+	again, err := f.load()
+	if err != nil || again.Run.Digest != got.Run.Digest || again.ReceiptSHA256 != got.ReceiptSHA256 {
+		t.Fatalf("replay: %+v %v", again, err)
+	}
+}
+func TestUnityNUnitReceiptRefusesUnboundStaleAndMixedEvidence(t *testing.T) {
+	tests := map[string]func(*testing.T, *unityFixture){
+		"started":              func(t *testing.T, f *unityFixture) { f.r.Status = "started"; f.save(t) },
+		"missing envelope":     func(t *testing.T, f *unityFixture) { f.r.Attestation = UnityFile{}; f.save(t) },
+		"different root":       func(t *testing.T, f *unityFixture) { f.r.Root = filepath.Dir(f.root); f.save(t) },
+		"nonzero passing exit": func(t *testing.T, f *unityFixture) { n := 1; f.r.ExitCode = &n; f.save(t) },
+		"missing exit":         func(t *testing.T, f *unityFixture) { f.r.ExitCode = nil; f.save(t) },
+		"source changed": func(t *testing.T, f *unityFixture) {
+			os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(f.root, f.r.Project, "Assets/BowlTests.cs"), []byte("changed"), 0600)
+		},
+		"source added": func(t *testing.T, f *unityFixture) {
+			os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(f.root, f.r.Project, "Assets/Added.cs"), []byte("new"), 0600)
+		},
+		"source removed": func(t *testing.T, f *unityFixture) {
+			os.Remove(filepath.Join(f.root, f.r.Project, "Assets/BowlTests.cs.meta"))
+		},
+		"mixed source digests": func(t *testing.T, f *unityFixture) { f.r.Source.AfterSHA256 = strings.Repeat("b", 64); f.save(t) },
+		"duplicate input": func(t *testing.T, f *unityFixture) {
+			f.r.Source.Inputs = append(f.r.Source.Inputs, f.r.Source.Inputs[0])
+			f.r.Source.BeforeSHA256 = unityDigest(UnitySourceBytes(f.r.Source))
+			f.r.Source.AfterSHA256 = f.r.Source.BeforeSHA256
+			f.save(t)
+		},
+		"producer invoked through traversal": func(t *testing.T, f *unityFixture) { f.r.Producer.Path = "game/Workshop/../../producer.py"; f.save(t) },
+		"producer omitted from closure": func(t *testing.T, f *unityFixture) {
+			for i, v := range f.r.Source.Inputs {
+				if v.Path == "producer.py" {
+					f.r.Source.Inputs = append(f.r.Source.Inputs[:i], f.r.Source.Inputs[i+1:]...)
+					break
+				}
+			}
+			f.r.Source.BeforeSHA256 = unityDigest(UnitySourceBytes(f.r.Source))
+			f.r.Source.AfterSHA256 = f.r.Source.BeforeSHA256
+			f.save(t)
+		},
+		"xml changed": func(t *testing.T, f *unityFixture) {
+			os.WriteFile(f.xml, []byte(strings.Replace(nativeFixtureXML, "Passed", "Failed", 1)), 0600)
+		},
+		"xml from earlier attempt": func(t *testing.T, f *unityFixture) {
+			f.r.StartedAt = "2026-10-19T13:00:00Z"
+			f.r.FinishedAt = "2026-10-19T13:00:10Z"
+			f.save(t)
+		},
+		"mixed mode":   func(t *testing.T, f *unityFixture) { f.r.Mode = "PlayMode"; f.save(t) },
+		"mixed target": func(t *testing.T, f *unityFixture) { f.r.Target = "StandaloneOSX"; f.save(t) },
+		"duplicate argv": func(t *testing.T, f *unityFixture) {
+			f.r.Command = append(f.r.Command, "-testPlatform", "EditMode")
+			f.save(t)
+		},
+		"secret-like arbitrary argv rejected": func(t *testing.T, f *unityFixture) {
+			f.r.Command = append(f.r.Command, "-password", "synthetic")
+			f.save(t)
+		},
+		"traversal":      func(t *testing.T, f *unityFixture) { f.r.Project = "game/../Workshop"; f.save(t) },
+		"unsafe control": func(t *testing.T, f *unityFixture) { f.r.Filter = "x\ny"; f.save(t) },

+			p := filepath.Join(f.root, f.r.Project, "Assets/Link.cs")
+			os.Symlink(filepath.Join(f.root, "producer.py"), p)
+		},
+		"future schema": func(t *testing.T, f *unityFixture) { f.r.Schema += "-future"; f.save(t) },
+		"unknown receipt field": func(t *testing.T, f *unityFixture) {
+			b, _ := os.ReadFile(f.receipt)
+			b = append([]byte(`{"new":true,`), b[1:]...)
+			os.WriteFile(f.receipt, b, 0600)
+		},
+		"duplicate JSON": func(t *testing.T, f *unityFixture) {
+			b, _ := os.ReadFile(f.receipt)
+			b = append([]byte(`{"status":"started",`), b[1:]...)
+			os.WriteFile(f.receipt, b, 0600)
+		},
+		"missing explicit filter": func(t *testing.T, f *unityFixture) {
+			raw, _ := os.ReadFile(f.receipt)
+			var v map[string]any
+			json.Unmarshal(raw, &v)
+			delete(v, "filter")
+			writeUnityJSON(t, f.receipt, v)
+		},
+		"null filter": func(t *testing.T, f *unityFixture) {
+			raw, _ := os.ReadFile(f.receipt)
+			var v map[string]any
+			json.Unmarshal(raw, &v)
+			v["filter"] = nil
+			writeUnityJSON(t, f.receipt, v)
+		},
+		"trailing JSON": func(t *testing.T, f *unityFixture) {
+			b, _ := os.ReadFile(f.receipt)
+			os.WriteFile(f.receipt, append(b, []byte(` {}`)...), 0600)
+		},
+		"stale symbols": func(t *testing.T, f *unityFixture) {
+			f.r.Symbols = &UnitySymbols{SCIPPath: "missing.scip", SCIPSHA256: strings.Repeat("a", 64), SourceReceiptSHA256: strings.Repeat("b", 64)}
+			f.save(t)
+		},
+	}
+	for name, mutate := range tests {
+		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			f := newUnityFixture(t)
+			mutate(t, f)
+			_, err := f.load()
+			if !errors.Is(err, ErrUnityEvidence) {
+				t.Fatalf("accepted or wrong refusal: %v", err)
+			}
+		})
+	}

+func unityTestStore(t *testing.T, backend string) store.Store {
+	t.Helper()
+	if backend == "memory" {
+		return store.NewMemoryStore()
+	}
+	st, err := store.Open(filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "native.sqlite"))
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	t.Cleanup(func() { st.Close() })
+	return st
+}
+func seedUnitySymbol(t testing.TB, st store.Store, f *unityFixture, s core.SymbolNode) {
+	t.Helper()
+	source, readErr := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(f.root, s.FilePath))
+	if readErr != nil {
+		t.Fatal(readErr)
+	}
+	err := st.PutObservations(context.Background(), []core.Observation{{ServiceID: s.Service, SourceRef: s.FilePath, SourceKind: s.Kind, Symbol: s.Name, Package: s.Package, Line: s.Line, EndLine: s.EndLine, Claim: s.Signature, EvidenceTier: core.TierVerified, ContentHash: fusion.FingerprintHash(source)}})
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+}
+func ingestUnityFixture(t testing.TB, st store.Store, f *unityFixture, s core.SymbolNode) Run {
+	t.Helper()
+	e, err := f.load()
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	r, err := UnityEvidenceRun(e, []core.SymbolNode{s})
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	report, err := IngestRuns(context.Background(), st, "svc", "test-watermark", []Run{r})
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if report.CasesJoined != 2 {
+		t.Fatalf("joined=%d", report.CasesJoined)
+	}
+	return r
+}
+func nativeStatus(t *testing.T, st store.Store, key string) verify.AttestedRun {
+	t.Helper()
+	r, err := LoadRuntimeRuns(context.Background(), st, "svc", nil)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	got, err := r.NewestAttestedRuns([]string{key})
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	return got[key]
+}
+func changeUnityNativeXML(t *testing.T, f *unityFixture, raw string, status, verdict string, totals Totals) {
+	t.Helper()
+	if err := os.WriteFile(f.xml, []byte(raw), 0600); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	f.r.XML.SHA256 = unityDigest([]byte(raw))
+	cases := f.envelope["cases"].([]Case)
+	cases[1].Status = status
+	f.envelope["totals"] = totals
+	f.envelope["verdict"] = verdict
+	f.envelope["artifacts"] = []ArtifactRef{{"unity-nunit-xml", "sha256:" + f.r.XML.SHA256}, {"unity-source-inputs", "sha256:" + f.r.Source.BeforeSHA256}}
+	f.saveEnvelope(t)
+	f.save(t)
+}
+func TestUnityNUnitRuntimeRoundtripAggregatesVariantsAndRevalidates(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, backend := range []string{"memory", "sqlite"} {
+		t.Run(backend, func(t *testing.T) {
+			f := newUnityFixture(t)
+			s := addUnityTypedFixture(t, f)
+			st := unityTestStore(t, backend)
+			seedUnitySymbol(t, st, f, s)
+			run := ingestUnityFixture(t, st, f, s)
+			if got := nativeStatus(t, st, s.Key()); got.Status != "pass" || !got.Dirty || got.Run != run.Digest {
+				t.Fatalf("current runtime %+v", got)
+			}
+			rows, err := st.NewestTestCaseRuns(context.Background(), "svc")
+			if err != nil || len(rows) != 1 {
+				t.Fatalf("native cases %+v %v", rows, err)
+			}
+			binding, reason := unityRuntimeFresh(context.Background(), rows[0].NativeJSON, rows[0].RunDigest)
+			if reason != "" || binding.Cohorts[s.Key()] != "pass" {
+				t.Fatalf("fresh binding cohort=%q reason=%q", binding.Cohorts[s.Key()], reason)
+			}
+			if got := nativeStatus(t, st, "Workshop.BowlTests.Fits"); got.Status != "pass" {
+				t.Fatalf("qualified identity %+v", got)
+			}
+			ingestUnityFixture(t, st, f, s) // exact replay is idempotent
+			history, err := st.TestCaseRunsForSymbol(context.Background(), "svc", s.Key(), 0)
+			if err != nil || len(history) != 2 || history[0].NativeJSON == "" {
+				t.Fatalf("native roundtrip %+v %v", history, err)
+			}
+			// The root-level XML still says Passed, but no old result survives a newer
+			// started receipt. No ingestion of a fake incomplete run is required.
+			f.r.Status = "started"
+			f.r.RunID = "next-attempt"
+			f.save(t)
+			if _, reason := unityRuntimeFresh(context.Background(), rows[0].NativeJSON, rows[0].RunDigest); !strings.Contains(reason, "active receipt changed") {
+				t.Fatalf("changed active receipt accepted: %q", reason)
+			}
+			if got := nativeStatus(t, st, s.Key()); got.Status != "unknown" || !strings.Contains(got.UnknownReason, "active receipt changed") {
+				t.Fatalf("old pass survived started: %+v", got)
+			}
+			f.r.Status = "complete"
+			f.r.RunID = "synthetic-run-1"
+			f.save(t)
+			if got := nativeStatus(t, st, s.Key()); got.Status != "pass" {
+				t.Fatalf("exact active replay %+v", got)
+			}
+			if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(f.root, f.r.Project, "Assets/BowlTests.cs"), []byte("changed source"), 0600); err != nil {
+				t.Fatal(err)
+			}
+			if got := nativeStatus(t, st, s.Key()); got.Status != "unknown" || !strings.Contains(got.UnknownReason, "source input changed") {
+				t.Fatalf("old pass survived source change: %+v", got)
+			}
+			if _, err := IngestRuns(context.Background(), st, "svc", "other", []Run{run}); err == nil {
+				t.Fatal("stale replay ingested")
+			}
+		})
+	}
+}

+type nativeRowsFixtureStore struct {
+	store.Store
+	rows []store.TestCaseRun
+}
+
+func (s nativeRowsFixtureStore) NewestTestCaseRuns(context.Context, string) ([]store.TestCaseRun, error) {
+	return s.rows, nil
+}

+// BenchmarkLoadRuntimeRunsUnityBinding measures binding projection after the
+// store read. One real attested Unity fixture supplies the receipt and binding;
+// 713 extra distinct case keys repeat that binding, matching the cold cohort's
+// row count. It isolates per-case decoding, not whole-store allocation.
+func BenchmarkLoadRuntimeRunsUnityBinding(b *testing.B) {
+	f := newUnityFixture(b)
+	s := addUnityTypedFixture(b, f)
+	st := store.NewMemoryStore()
+	seedUnitySymbol(b, st, f, s)
+	ingestUnityFixture(b, st, f, s)
+	rows, err := st.NewestTestCaseRuns(context.Background(), "svc")
+	if err != nil || len(rows) != 1 {
+		b.Fatalf("native cases %+v %v", rows, err)
+	}
+	cohort := make([]store.TestCaseRun, 714)
+	for i := range cohort {
+		cohort[i] = rows[0]
+		cohort[i].TestSymbolKey = fmt.Sprintf("svc::benchmark.Test%d", i)
+	}
+	cohort[0].TestSymbolKey = s.Key()
+	fixture := nativeRowsFixtureStore{Store: st, rows: cohort}
+	ctx := context.Background()
+	var last *RuntimeRuns
+	b.ReportAllocs()
+	b.ResetTimer()
+	for i := 0; i < b.N; i++ {
+		last, err = LoadRuntimeRuns(ctx, fixture, "svc", nil)
+		if err != nil {
+			b.Fatal(err)
+		}
+	}
+	b.StopTimer()
+	runs, err := last.NewestAttestedRuns([]string{s.Key()})
+	if err != nil || runs[s.Key()].Status != "pass" {
+		b.Fatalf("native result %+v %v", runs, err)
+	}
+}

+func TestUnityNUnitRuntimeNeverChoosesPassingParameterizedLeaf(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, outcome := range []string{"Failed", "Skipped", "Inconclusive", "Missing"} {
+		for _, backend := range []string{"memory", "sqlite"} {
+			t.Run(backend+"/"+outcome, func(t *testing.T) {
+				f := newUnityFixture(t)
+				s := addUnityTypedFixture(t, f)
+				raw := nativeFixtureXML
+				status := "skip"
+				verdict := "error"
+				want := "unknown"
+				totals := Totals{Run: 2, Passed: 1, Skipped: 1}
+				switch outcome {
+				case "Failed":
+					raw = strings.Replace(raw, `result="Passed"`, `result="Failed"`, 1)
+					raw = strings.Replace(raw, `passed="2" failed="0"`, `passed="1" failed="1"`, 1)
+					status = "fail"
+					verdict = "fail"
+					want = "fail"
+					totals = Totals{Run: 2, Passed: 1, Failed: 1}
+				case "Skipped":
+					raw = strings.Replace(raw, `passed="2"`, `passed="1"`, 1)
+					raw = strings.Replace(raw, `skipped="0"`, `skipped="1"`, 1)
+					raw = strings.Replace(raw, `result="Passed"`, `result="Skipped"`, 1)
+				case "Inconclusive":
+					raw = strings.Replace(raw, `passed="2"`, `passed="1"`, 1)
+					raw = strings.Replace(raw, `inconclusive="0"`, `inconclusive="1"`, 1)
+					raw = strings.Replace(raw, `result="Passed"`, `result="Inconclusive"`, 1)
+				case "Missing":
+					raw = strings.Replace(raw, `testcasecount="2" total="2" passed="2"`, `testcasecount="2" total="1" passed="1"`, 1)
+					start := strings.Index(raw, `<test-case id="2"`)
+					end := strings.Index(raw[start:], "/>") + start + 2
+					raw = raw[:start] + raw[end:]
+					cases := f.envelope["cases"].([]Case)
+					f.envelope["cases"] = cases[:1]
+					status = "pass"
+					verdict = "pass"
+					totals = Totals{Run: 1, Passed: 1}
+				}
+				if outcome != "Missing" {
+					old := `methodname="Fits" result="Passed" duration="0.2"`
+					raw = strings.Replace(raw, old, `methodname="Fits" result="`+outcome+`" duration="0.2"`, 1)
+					changeUnityNativeXML(t, f, raw, status, verdict, totals)
+				} else {
+					if err := os.WriteFile(f.xml, []byte(raw), 0600); err != nil {
+						t.Fatal(err)
+					}
+					f.r.XML.SHA256 = unityDigest([]byte(raw))
+					f.envelope["totals"] = totals
+					f.envelope["verdict"] = verdict
+					f.envelope["artifacts"] = []ArtifactRef{{"unity-nunit-xml", "sha256:" + f.r.XML.SHA256}, {"unity-source-inputs", "sha256:" + f.r.Source.BeforeSHA256}}
+					f.saveEnvelope(t)
+					f.save(t)
+				}
+				st := unityTestStore(t, backend)
+				seedUnitySymbol(t, st, f, s)
+				e, err := f.load()
+				if err != nil {
+					t.Fatal(err)
+				}
+				r, err := UnityEvidenceRun(e, []core.SymbolNode{s})
+				if err != nil {
+					t.Fatal(err)
+				}
+				if _, err = IngestRuns(context.Background(), st, "svc", "test", []Run{r}); err != nil {
+					t.Fatal(err)
+				}
+				if got := nativeStatus(t, st, s.Key()); got.Status != want {
+					t.Fatalf("outcome=%s runtime %+v", outcome, got)
+				}
+			})
+		}
+	}
+}

+func TestUnityNUnitStoreRefusesConflictingRunIDReplayAtomically(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, backend := range []string{"memory", "sqlite"} {
+		t.Run(backend, func(t *testing.T) {
+			st := unityTestStore(t, backend)

+			if err := st.PutTestRuns(ctx, "svc", []store.TestRun{r}); err != nil {
+				t.Fatal(err)
+			}
+			different := r
+			different.RunDigest = "different"
+			if err := st.PutTestRuns(ctx, "svc", []store.TestRun{different}); err == nil {
+				t.Fatal("different payload accepted same run id")
+			}
+			history, err := st.TestCaseRunsForSymbol(ctx, "svc", "svc::X", 0)
+			if err != nil || len(history) != 1 {
+				t.Fatalf("replay mutated store %+v %v", history, err)
+			}
+			if err := st.PutTestRuns(ctx, "other", []store.TestRun{different}); err != nil {
+				t.Fatalf("cross-service run id incorrectly refused %v", err)
+			}
+		})
+	}
