+package testrun
+
+// Native Unity Test Framework output is NUnit3, not JUnit. Parsing records
+// observations only; even a complete passing XML is never an attestation.
+import (
+	"bytes"
+	"encoding/xml"
+	"fmt"
+	"io"
+	"math"
+	"sort"
+	"strconv"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+	"unicode/utf8"
+)
+
+const RunnerUnityNUnit Runner = "unity-nunit"
+const maxNUnitBytes = 16 << 20
+const maxNUnitCases = 100000
+
+// NUnitCase retains the producer's identity, including parameter values and
+// custom names. MethodName is explicit native metadata, never name stripping.
+type NUnitCase struct {
+	ID, Name, FullName, Assembly, ClassName, MethodName string
+	Result, Label, Duration, Message, StackTrace        string
+	Cohort                                              string
+}
+
+// NUnitCohort is a native method's selected variants. A missing declared variant
+// is unknown even when every returned leaf passed. Failure is never hidden.
+type NUnitCohort struct {
+	ID, Assembly, ClassName, MethodName string
+	Expected, Observed                  int
+	Complete                            bool
+	ObservedVerdict                     Verdict // parsed outcome, never attestation
+}
+
+// NUnitRun is a bounded native parse, not a claim about source or execution.
+type NUnitRun struct {
+	ID, Result, Label, EngineVersion, StartedAt, FinishedAt, Duration string
+	Total, Passed, Failed, Skipped, Inconclusive, Discovered          int
+	Cases                                                             []NUnitCase
+	Cohorts                                                           []NUnitCohort
+}
+
+type nunitElement struct {
+	name     string
+	attrs    map[string]string
+	children []*nunitElement
+	text     strings.Builder
+}
+
+func nunitTree(raw []byte) (*nunitElement, error) {
+	if len(raw) == 0 || len(raw) > maxNUnitBytes || !utf8.Valid(raw) {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("NUnit XML is empty, oversized or invalid UTF8")
+	}
+	d := xml.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(raw))
+	var root *nunitElement
+	var stack []*nunitElement
+	count := 0
+	for {
+		tok, err := d.Token()
+		if err == io.EOF {
+			break
+		}
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("NUnit XML: %w", err)
+		}
+		switch v := tok.(type) {
+		case xml.Directive:
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("NUnit XML directives/entities are refused")
+		case xml.StartElement:
+			count++
+			if count > maxNUnitCases*10 || len(stack) >= 64 {
+				return nil, fmt.Errorf("NUnit XML element/depth limit exceeded")
+			}
+			if v.Name.Space != "" {
+				return nil, fmt.Errorf("NUnit XML namespace is unsupported")
+			}
+			node := &nunitElement{name: v.Name.Local, attrs: map[string]string{}}
+			for _, a := range v.Attr {
+				if a.Name.Space != "" {
+					return nil, fmt.Errorf("NUnit XML namespaced attribute is unsupported")
+				}
+				if _, ok := node.attrs[a.Name.Local]; ok {
+					return nil, fmt.Errorf("NUnit XML duplicate attribute %s", a.Name.Local)
+				}
+				node.attrs[a.Name.Local] = a.Value
+			}
+			if len(stack) == 0 {
+				if root != nil {
+					return nil, fmt.Errorf("NUnit XML has multiple roots")
+				}
+				root = node
+			} else {
+				parent := stack[len(stack)-1]
+				parent.children = append(parent.children, node)
+			}
+			stack = append(stack, node)
+		case xml.EndElement:
+			if len(stack) == 0 {
+				return nil, fmt.Errorf("NUnit XML has unmatched close")
+			}
+			stack = stack[:len(stack)-1]
+		case xml.CharData:
+			if len(stack) == 0 {
+				if strings.TrimSpace(string(v)) != "" {
+					return nil, fmt.Errorf("NUnit XML trailing content")
+				}
+			} else {
+				stack[len(stack)-1].text.Write(v)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	if root == nil || root.name != "test-run" || len(stack) != 0 {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("expected one complete native NUnit test-run")
+	}
+	return root, nil
+}
+
+func nunitCount(node *nunitElement, key string, required bool) (int, error) {
+	text, ok := node.attrs[key]
+	if !ok && !required {
+		return -1, nil
+	}
+	if text == "" {
+		return 0, fmt.Errorf("NUnit %s missing %s", node.name, key)
+	}
+	for _, b := range []byte(text) {
+		if b < '0' || b > '9' {
+			return 0, fmt.Errorf("NUnit invalid %s", key)
+		}
+	}
+	n, err := strconv.Atoi(text)
+	if err != nil || n < 0 || n > maxNUnitCases {
+		return 0, fmt.Errorf("NUnit %s exceeds case limit", key)
+	}
+	return n, nil
+}
+
+// NUnitDuration parses native seconds without treating NaN/overflow as zero.
+func NUnitDuration(value string) (time.Duration, error) {
+	if value == "" {
+		return 0, nil
+	}
+	seconds, err := strconv.ParseFloat(value, 64)
+	if err != nil || math.IsNaN(seconds) || math.IsInf(seconds, 0) || seconds < 0 || seconds >= float64(math.MaxInt64)/1e9 {
+		return 0, fmt.Errorf("invalid NUnit duration %q", value)
+	}
+	return time.Duration(math.Round(seconds * 1e9)), nil
+}
+
+// NUnitTime handles the native whole-second UTC spelling and RFC3339 variants.
+func NUnitTime(value string) (time.Time, error) {
+	for _, layout := range []string{time.RFC3339Nano, "2006-01-02 15:04:05Z", "2006-01-02 15:04:05.999999999Z"} {
+		if at, err := time.Parse(layout, value); err == nil {
+			return at, nil
+		}
+	}
+	return time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("invalid NUnit timestamp %q", value)
+}
+
+func nunitBody(node *nunitElement, name, child string) string {
+	for _, n := range node.children {
+		if n.name == name {
+			for _, c := range n.children {
+				if c.name == child {
+					return c.text.String()
+				}
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return ""
+}
+
+// ParseUnityNUnitXML strictly parses a single native document. It does not
+// execute commands, resolve methods, read files, or write test_runs.
+func ParseUnityNUnitXML(raw []byte) (NUnitRun, error) {
+	root, err := nunitTree(raw)
+	if err != nil {
+		return NUnitRun{}, err
+	}
+	r := NUnitRun{ID: root.attrs["id"], Result: root.attrs["result"], Label: root.attrs["label"], EngineVersion: root.attrs["engine-version"], StartedAt: root.attrs["start-time"], FinishedAt: root.attrs["end-time"], Duration: root.attrs["duration"]}
+	counts := []struct {
+		name string
+		ptr  *int
+	}{{"total", &r.Total}, {"passed", &r.Passed}, {"failed", &r.Failed}, {"skipped", &r.Skipped}, {"inconclusive", &r.Inconclusive}, {"testcasecount", &r.Discovered}}
+	for _, c := range counts {
+		n, e := nunitCount(root, c.name, true)
+		if e != nil {
+			return NUnitRun{}, e
+		}
+		*c.ptr = n
+	}
+	if r.Duration == "" {
+		return NUnitRun{}, fmt.Errorf("NUnit run duration missing")
+	}
+	if _, err = NUnitDuration(r.Duration); err != nil {
+		return NUnitRun{}, err
+	}
+	start, err := NUnitTime(r.StartedAt)
+	if err != nil {
+		return NUnitRun{}, err
+	}
+	finish, err := NUnitTime(r.FinishedAt)
+	if err != nil || finish.Before(start) {
+		return NUnitRun{}, fmt.Errorf("NUnit run interval is invalid")
+	}
+	if r.ID == "" {
+		return NUnitRun{}, fmt.Errorf("NUnit run id missing")
+	}
+	ids, names := map[string]bool{}, map[string]bool{}
+	groups := map[string]*NUnitCohort{}
+	var walk func(*nunitElement, string, string) error
+	walk = func(node *nunitElement, assembly, group string) error {
+		if node.name == "test-suite" && node.attrs["type"] == "Assembly" {
+			assembly = node.attrs["name"]
+			if i := strings.LastIndexAny(assembly, "/\\"); i >= 0 {
+				assembly = assembly[i+1:]
+			}
+			assembly = strings.TrimSuffix(assembly, ".dll")
+			if assembly == "" {
+				return fmt.Errorf("NUnit assembly name missing")
+			}
+		}
+		if node.name == "test-suite" && node.attrs["type"] == "ParameterizedMethod" {
+			group = assembly + "::" + node.attrs["id"]
+			if node.attrs["id"] == "" || groups[group] != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("NUnit parameterized suite id missing/duplicate")
+			}
+			count, e := nunitCount(node, "testcasecount", false)
+			if e != nil {
+				return e
+			}
+			groups[group] = &NUnitCohort{ID: group, Assembly: assembly, Expected: count}
+		}
+		if node.name == "test-case" {
+			var inspect func(*nunitElement) bool
+			inspect = func(n *nunitElement) bool {
+				for _, child := range n.children {
+					if child.name == "test-case" || child.name == "test-suite" || child.name == "test-run" || inspect(child) {
+						return true
+					}
+				}
+				return false
+			}
+			if inspect(node) {
+				return fmt.Errorf("NUnit test-case contains nested test structure")
+			}
+			c := NUnitCase{ID: node.attrs["id"], Name: node.attrs["name"], FullName: node.attrs["fullname"], Assembly: assembly, ClassName: node.attrs["classname"], MethodName: node.attrs["methodname"], Result: node.attrs["result"], Label: node.attrs["label"], Duration: node.attrs["duration"], Cohort: group, Message: nunitBody(node, "failure", "message"), StackTrace: nunitBody(node, "failure", "stack-trace")}
+			if c.ID == "" || c.Name == "" || c.FullName == "" || c.ClassName == "" || c.MethodName == "" || assembly == "" {
+				return fmt.Errorf("NUnit case identity/assembly missing")
+			}
+			identity := assembly + "::" + c.FullName
+			if ids[c.ID] || names[identity] {
+				return fmt.Errorf("NUnit duplicate case id or full identity")
+			}
+			ids[c.ID] = true
+			names[identity] = true
+			switch c.Result {
+			case "Passed", "Failed", "Skipped", "Inconclusive":
+			default:
+				return fmt.Errorf("NUnit unsupported case outcome %q", c.Result)
+			}
+			if c.Duration == "" {
+				return fmt.Errorf("NUnit case duration missing")
+			}
+			if _, e := NUnitDuration(c.Duration); e != nil {
+				return e
+			}
+			if c.Message == "" {
+				c.Message = nunitBody(node, "reason", "message")
+			}
+			if group == "" {
+				group = assembly + "::method:" + c.ClassName + "." + c.MethodName
+				c.Cohort = group
+				if groups[group] == nil {
+					groups[group] = &NUnitCohort{ID: group, Assembly: assembly, ClassName: c.ClassName, MethodName: c.MethodName, Expected: 1, Complete: c.FullName == c.ClassName+"."+c.MethodName}
+				} else {
+					groups[group].Complete = false
+					groups[group].Expected = -1
+				}
+			}
+			g := groups[group]
+			if g.ClassName != "" && (g.ClassName != c.ClassName || g.MethodName != c.MethodName) {
+				return fmt.Errorf("NUnit cohort mixes methods")
+			}
+			g.ClassName = c.ClassName
+			g.MethodName = c.MethodName
+			g.Observed++
+			r.Cases = append(r.Cases, c)
+			if len(r.Cases) > maxNUnitCases {
+				return fmt.Errorf("NUnit case limit exceeded")
+			}
+			return nil
+		}
+		for _, child := range node.children {
+			if err := walk(child, assembly, group); err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+		}
+		return nil
+	}
+	if err = walk(root, "", ""); err != nil {
+		return NUnitRun{}, err
+	}
+	actual := map[string]int{}
+	for _, c := range r.Cases {
+		actual[c.Result]++
+	}
+	if len(r.Cases) != r.Total || r.Passed != actual["Passed"] || r.Failed != actual["Failed"] || r.Skipped != actual["Skipped"] || r.Inconclusive != actual["Inconclusive"] || r.Discovered < r.Total {
+		return NUnitRun{}, fmt.Errorf("NUnit root counts contradict native cases")
+	}
+	switch r.Result {
+	case "Passed":
+		if r.Failed+r.Skipped+r.Inconclusive > 0 || r.Total == 0 {
+			return NUnitRun{}, fmt.Errorf("NUnit Passed contradicts nonpassing/empty cases")
+		}
+	case "Failed", "Failed(Child)":
+		if r.Failed == 0 {
+			return NUnitRun{}, fmt.Errorf("NUnit Failed has no failed cases")
+		}
+	case "Skipped", "Inconclusive":
+		if r.Failed > 0 {
+			return NUnitRun{}, fmt.Errorf("NUnit skipped/inconclusive hides failed case")
+		}
+	default:
+		return NUnitRun{}, fmt.Errorf("NUnit unsupported run outcome %q", r.Result)
+	}
+	observed := map[string]map[string]int{}
+	for _, c := range r.Cases {
+		if observed[c.Cohort] == nil {
+			observed[c.Cohort] = map[string]int{}
+		}
+		observed[c.Cohort][c.Result]++
+	}
+	for _, g := range groups {
+		if g.Expected >= 0 && g.Observed > g.Expected {
+			return NUnitRun{}, fmt.Errorf("NUnit cohort exceeds declared count")
+		}
+
+		if strings.Contains(g.ID, "::method:") {
+			g.Complete = g.Complete && g.Observed == 1
+		} else {
+			g.Complete = g.Expected > 0 && g.Observed == g.Expected
+		}
+		g.ObservedVerdict = Unknown
+		if observed[g.ID]["Failed"] > 0 {
+			g.ObservedVerdict = Fail
+		} else if g.Complete && observed[g.ID]["Passed"] == g.Observed {
+			g.ObservedVerdict = Pass
+		}
+		r.Cohorts = append(r.Cohorts, *g)
+	}
+	sort.Slice(r.Cases, func(i, j int) bool {
+		if r.Cases[i].Assembly != r.Cases[j].Assembly {
+			return r.Cases[i].Assembly < r.Cases[j].Assembly
+		}
+		return r.Cases[i].FullName < r.Cases[j].FullName
+	})
+	sort.Slice(r.Cohorts, func(i, j int) bool { return r.Cohorts[i].ID < r.Cohorts[j].ID })
+	return r, nil
+}
+
+func nativeNUnitDocument(output string) bool {
+	if len(output) > maxNUnitBytes {
+		return false
+	}
+	d := xml.NewDecoder(strings.NewReader(output))
+	for {
+		tok, err := d.Token()
+		if err != nil {
+			return false
+		}
+		switch t := tok.(type) {
+		case xml.Directive:
+			return false
+		case xml.CharData:
+			if strings.TrimSpace(string(t)) != "" {
+				return false
+			}
+		case xml.StartElement:
+			return t.Name.Space == "" && t.Name.Local == "test-run"
+		}
+	}
+}
+
+func parseUnityNUnit(output string) Run {
+	native, err := ParseUnityNUnitXML([]byte(output))
+	r := Run{Runner: RunnerUnityNUnit}
+	if err != nil {
+		return r
+	}
+	r.Complete = true
+	for _, cohort := range native.Cohorts {
+		if !cohort.Complete {
+			r.Complete = false
+		}
+	}
+	r.Summary = &Summary{Tests: native.Total, Failures: native.Failed, Skipped: native.Skipped + native.Inconclusive}
+	packages := map[string]Status{}
+	for _, c := range native.Cases {
+		if packages[c.Assembly] == "" {
+			packages[c.Assembly] = StatusOK
+		}
+		if c.Result == "Failed" {
+			packages[c.Assembly] = StatusFail
+			r.Failures = append(r.Failures, Failure{Package: c.ClassName, Test: strings.TrimPrefix(c.FullName, c.ClassName+".")})
+		}
+	}
+	for name, status := range packages {
+		r.Packages = append(r.Packages, PackageResult{Package: name, Status: status})
+	}
+	sort.Slice(r.Packages, func(i, j int) bool { return r.Packages[i].Package < r.Packages[j].Package })
+	return r
+}

+func TestUnityNUnitHookRecognizesNativeXMLWithoutJUnit(t *testing.T) {
+	r := ParseTestRun(nativeNUnitFixture)
+	if r.Runner != Runner("unity-nunit") || !r.Complete || !r.Failed() {
+		t.Fatalf("native NUnit must be a complete failed native run, not JUnit or unknown: %+v", r)
+	}
+	if len(r.Failures) != 1 || r.Failures[0].ID() != "Workshop.WorkTests.Fits(2)" {
+		t.Fatalf("parameterized failure identity lost: %+v", r.Failures)
+	}
+	if r.Summary == nil || r.Summary.Tests != 4 || r.Summary.Failures != 1 || r.Summary.Skipped != 2 {
+		t.Fatalf("native counts must retain nonpassing skip/inconclusive: %+v", r.Summary)
+	}
+}

+func TestUnityNUnitPreservesNativeOutcomeAndParameterizedIdentity(t *testing.T) {
+	run, err := ParseUnityNUnitXML([]byte(nativeNUnitFixture))
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if run.EngineVersion != "3.5.0.0" || len(run.Cases) != 4 || run.Inconclusive != 1 {
+		t.Fatalf("metadata: %+v", run)
+	}
+	var failed *NUnitCase
+	for i := range run.Cases {
+		if run.Cases[i].ID == "101" {
+			failed = &run.Cases[i]
+		}
+	}
+	if failed == nil || failed.Assembly != "Workshop.Tests" || failed.FullName != "Workshop.WorkTests.Fits(2)" || failed.MethodName != "Fits" || failed.Duration != "0.2" || failed.Message != "expected a fit" || !strings.Contains(failed.StackTrace, "WorkTests.cs:42") {
+		t.Fatalf("native case lost information: %+v", failed)
+	}
+	for _, g := range run.Cohorts {
+		if g.MethodName == "Fits" && (!g.Complete || g.Observed != 2 || g.Expected != 2) {
+			t.Fatalf("cohort: %+v", g)
+		}
+	}

+func TestUnityNUnitRefusesMalformedContradictoryAndDuplicateEvidence(t *testing.T) {
+	cases := map[string]string{
+		"nested case smuggling": strings.Replace(nativeNUnitFixture, `duration="0.1"/>`, `duration="0.1"><test-case id="hidden"/></test-case>`, 1),
+		"missing duration":      strings.Replace(nativeNUnitFixture, ` duration="0.2"`, "", 1),
+
+		"truncated":                   strings.TrimSuffix(nativeNUnitFixture, "</test-run>"),
+		"duplicate id":                strings.Replace(nativeNUnitFixture, `id="101"`, `id="100"`, 1),
+		"duplicate identity":          strings.Replace(nativeNUnitFixture, `fullname="Workshop.WorkTests.Fits(2)"`, `fullname="Workshop.WorkTests.Fits(1)"`, 1),
+		"unsupported result":          strings.Replace(nativeNUnitFixture, `result="Failed" duration="0.2"`, `result="Maybe" duration="0.2"`, 1),
+		"DTD":                         `<!DOCTYPE test-run [<!ENTITY x SYSTEM "file:///secret">]>` + nativeNUnitFixture,
+		"invalid UTF8":                nativeNUnitFixture + string([]byte{0xff}),
+		"trailing root":               nativeNUnitFixture + `<extra/>`,
+		"contradictory total":         strings.Replace(nativeNUnitFixture, `total="4"`, `total="3"`, 1),
+		"negative counter":            strings.Replace(nativeNUnitFixture, `passed="1"`, `passed="-1"`, 1),
+		"NaN duration":                strings.Replace(nativeNUnitFixture, `duration="0.2"`, `duration="NaN"`, 1),
+		"missing method":              strings.Replace(nativeNUnitFixture, `methodname="Fits"`, `methodname=""`, 1),
+		"missing assembly":            strings.Replace(nativeNUnitFixture, `type="Assembly"`, `type="TestFixture"`, 1),
+		"more variants than declared": strings.Replace(nativeNUnitFixture, `testcasecount="2"`, `testcasecount="1"`, 1),
+	}
+	for name, text := range cases {
+		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			if _, err := ParseUnityNUnitXML([]byte(text)); err == nil {
+				t.Fatal("malformed native evidence accepted")
+			}
+		})
+	}
+}

+func TestUnityNUnitHookCannotTurnInvalidOrSkippedXMLIntoPass(t *testing.T) {

+	skipped := strings.NewReplacer(`result="Failed"`, `result="Skipped"`, `failed="1"`, `failed="0"`, `skipped="1"`, `skipped="2"`).Replace(nativeNUnitFixture)
+	if got := Analyze(skipped, Evidence{ExitCode: &zero}).Verdict; got != Unknown {

+	}

+func TestUnityNUnitVariantCohortNeverSelectsAnArbitraryLeaf(t *testing.T) {
+	run, err := ParseUnityNUnitXML([]byte(nativeNUnitFixture))
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	for _, c := range run.Cohorts {
+		if c.MethodName == "Fits" && c.ObservedVerdict != Fail {
+			t.Fatalf("failed variant hidden: %+v", c)
+		}
+	}

+	}

+	if err != nil {

+	}

+// Consult indexed C# source identity without replacing upstream's naming

+func isTestEntry(name string, ev Evidence) bool {
+	if name == "" {
+		return false
+	}

+		}
+	}

+		return false
+	}
+	return isTestName(name)

+func TestRuntimePassNativeRefusalRemainsNamedAndInformational(t *testing.T) {
+	now := time.Date(2026, 10, 20, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
+	sym := node("Charge", "pay/charge.go", 10, core.TierVerified)

+			t.Fatalf("informational native observation changed the static gate: %+v", v)
+		}

+package client
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"fmt"
+
+	"github.com/geoffmilleraz/fathom/internal/assetrefs"
+	"github.com/geoffmilleraz/fathom/internal/core"
+)
+
+type AssetReferenceSnapshot = core.AssetReferenceSnapshot
+type AssetReferenceQuery = core.AssetReferenceQuery
+type AssetReferenceResult = core.AssetReferenceResult
+type AssetObjectID = core.AssetObjectID
+
+// UnityAssetReferenceOptions selects an explicit local producer receipt. It
+// cannot choose a filesystem root; the client's registered service owns that.
+// Preparation/query and the explicit CLI reader are read-only; no durable store
+// importer or caller-prepared snapshot can supply current authority.
+type UnityAssetReferenceOptions struct {
+	Project               string
+	FamilyID              string
+	ReceiptPath           string
+	ActivePath            string
+	ExpectedEditorVersion string
+	ExpectedEditorSHA256  string
+	ExpectedBuildTarget   string
+}
+
+var ErrAssetReferencesRefused = assetrefs.ErrRefused
+
+func (c *Client) assetReferenceOptions(ctx context.Context, service string, opts UnityAssetReferenceOptions) (assetrefs.Options, error) {
+	root, _, found, err := c.ServiceMeta(ctx, service)
+	if err != nil {
+		return assetrefs.Options{}, fmt.Errorf("client.assetReferences: service metadata: %w", err)
+	}
+	if !found || root == "" {
+		return assetrefs.Options{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: registered service root required", ErrAssetReferencesRefused)
+	}
+	return assetrefs.Options{Root: root, Service: service, Project: opts.Project, FamilyID: opts.FamilyID, ReceiptPath: opts.ReceiptPath, ActivePath: opts.ActivePath, ExpectedEditorVersion: opts.ExpectedEditorVersion, ExpectedEditorSHA256: opts.ExpectedEditorSHA256, ExpectedBuildTarget: opts.ExpectedBuildTarget}, nil
+}
+
+// PrepareUnityAssetReferences validates current source/receipt/native identity
+// and returns a partial candidate DTO. It never persists or registers facts.
+func (c *Client) PrepareUnityAssetReferences(ctx context.Context, service string, opts UnityAssetReferenceOptions) (AssetReferenceSnapshot, error) {
+	local, err := c.assetReferenceOptions(ctx, service, opts)
+	if err != nil {
+		return AssetReferenceSnapshot{}, err
+	}
+	return assetrefs.Prepare(ctx, local)
+}
+
+// UnityAssetReferences validates current local proof again; a caller-supplied
+// prepared snapshot is deliberately not accepted as current query authority.
+func (c *Client) UnityAssetReferences(ctx context.Context, service string, opts UnityAssetReferenceOptions, query AssetReferenceQuery) (AssetReferenceResult, error) {
+	local, err := c.assetReferenceOptions(ctx, service, opts)
+	if err != nil {
+		return AssetReferenceResult{}, err
+	}
+	return assetrefs.Query(ctx, local, query)
+}

+	ctx := context.Background()

+	client := &Client{st: st}
+	options := UnityAssetReferenceOptions{Project: "game/Fixture", FamilyID: "cart", ReceiptPath: ".artifacts/receipt.json", ActivePath: ".artifacts/active.json", ExpectedEditorVersion: "fixture", ExpectedEditorSHA256: "1111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111", ExpectedBuildTarget: "StandaloneOSX"}

+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	edges := []core.Edge{{FromSymbol: "fixture::Caller", ToSymbol: "fixture::Target", Kind: core.EdgeDirect}}
+	if err := st.PutTypedEdges(ctx, "fixture", "scip:independent", edges); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)

+	if _, err := client.PrepareUnityAssetReferences(ctx, "fixture", options); !errors.Is(err, ErrAssetReferencesRefused) {
+		t.Fatalf("missing active proof accepted: %v", err)

+		t.Fatalf("query invented proof: %v", err)
+	}
+	after, err := st.TypedEdges(ctx, "fixture")

+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}

+		t.Fatalf("asset refusal disturbed code edges: %#v", after)

+// The normal ingest's IndexedAt watermark changes even when only the CUE pass
+// epoch changed. Exercise the same snapshot/typed graph memo used by MCP so a
+// deleted policy-denied row cannot survive in a warm graph at an unchanged tree.
+func TestCUEPolicyEpochIngestRefreshesWarmTypedGraph(t *testing.T) {
+	root := t.TempDir()
+	write := func(name, body string) {
+		t.Helper()
+		path := filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(name))
+		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0755); err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+		if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(body), 0644); err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+	}
+	write("cue.mod/module.cue", "module: \"example.org/policy@v0\"\nlanguage: version: \"v0.16.1\"\n")
+	write("schema/schema.cue", "package schema\n#Base: string\n")
+	write("consumer/main.cue", "package consumer\nimport \"example.org/policy/schema\"\n#Copy: schema.#Base\n")
+	ctx := context.Background()
+	st := store.NewMemoryStore()
+	conn := connector.NewLocalConnector()
+	c := New(conn, st)
+	const service = "cue-policy-memo"
+	t.Cleanup(func() { memo.EvictStoreService(c.StoreID(), service) })
+	svc := ServiceRef{ID: service, Path: root}
+	if report, err := c.Ingest(ctx, svc); err != nil || report.CUEEdgesDirect != 1 {
+		t.Fatalf("initial real local typed edge missing: report=%+v err=%v", report, err)
+	}
+
+	write("cue.mod/module.cue", "module: \"example.org/policy@v0\"\nlanguage: version: \"v0.16.1\"\ndeps: \"example.org/remote@v0\": v: \"v0.0.1\"\n")
+	write("consumer/main.cue", "package consumer\nimport \"example.org/remote/pkg\"\n#Copy: pkg.#Name\n")
+	// Reproduce a pre-policy store: current syntax indexed without a native
+	// pass, while prior CUE typed rows and an old completion stamp survive.
+	c.pipe = fusion.New(conn, st, fusion.Config{DisableTypedEdges: true})
+	if _, err := c.Ingest(ctx, svc); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if err := st.SetTypedEdgePackageFingerprint(ctx, service, "typed-pass-state:cue", "ok"); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	c.pipe = fusion.New(conn, st, fusion.Config{})
+	from := core.SymbolKey(service, "consumer/consumer", "#Copy")
+	to := core.SymbolKey(service, "schema/schema", "#Base")
+	graph := func() (string, *callgraph.Graph) {
+		t.Helper()
+		watermark, err := c.StoreWatermark(ctx, service)
+		if err != nil || watermark == "" {
+			t.Fatalf("store watermark unavailable: %q %v", watermark, err)
+		}
+		snapshot, err := memo.SnapshotFor(ctx, memo.Scope{Store: c.StoreID(), Service: service, Watermark: watermark}, func(ctx context.Context) ([]core.SymbolNode, error) {
+			return c.ListAllSymbols(ctx, service)
+		})
+		if err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+		graph, err := memo.GraphFor(ctx, snapshot, memo.GraphResolved, func(ctx context.Context) ([]core.Edge, error) { return c.TypedEdges(ctx, service) })
+		if err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+		return watermark, graph
+	}
+	before, oldGraph := graph()
+	if !callgraph.Reachable(oldGraph, from, to) {
+		t.Fatal("fixture did not establish the old typed row in a warm memo")
+	}
+	if report, err := c.Ingest(ctx, svc); err != nil || report.Extracted != 0 || report.CUEPackagesFailed == 0 {
+		t.Fatalf("epoch-only native retry did not run on unchanged syntax: report=%+v err=%v", report, err)
+	}
+	if state, _, err := st.TypedEdgePackageFingerprint(ctx, service, "typed-pass-state:cue"); err != nil || state != "partial@epoch-1" {
+		t.Fatalf("synthetic loader failure was falsely stamped clean: state=%q err=%v", state, err)
+	}
+	after, freshGraph := graph()
+	if before == after || callgraph.Reachable(freshGraph, from, to) {
+		t.Fatalf("normal ingest served policy-denied typed evidence from its memo: before=%q after=%q reachable=%v", before, after, callgraph.Reachable(freshGraph, from, to))
+	}
+}

+package client
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"errors"
+	"fmt"
+	"io"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"slices"
+	"strings"

+const scipSourceStatePrefix = "scip-source:"
+
+func (c *Client) scipSourceState(ctx context.Context, service, root, path string) (bool, error) {
+	_, found, err := c.st.TypedEdgePackageFingerprint(ctx, service, scipSourceStatePrefix+scipIndexKey(root, path))
+	return found, err
+}
+func (c *Client) rememberSCIPSource(ctx context.Context, service, root, path string) error {
+	absolute, err := filepath.Abs(path)
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	return c.st.SetTypedEdgePackageFingerprint(ctx, service, scipSourceStatePrefix+scipIndexKey(root, path), absolute)
+}
+func (c *Client) clearSCIPSource(ctx context.Context, service, root, path string) error {
+	defer memo.EvictStoreService(c.StoreID(), service)
+	prefix := scipStoreKeyPrefix(scipIndexKey(root, path))
+	packages, err := c.st.ListTypedEdgePackages(ctx, service)
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	for _, key := range packages {
+		if strings.HasPrefix(key, prefix) {
+			if err := c.st.DeleteTypedEdgePackage(ctx, service, key); err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+// reconcileSCIPSources runs on every shared ingest path, including the daemon
+// queue and file refresh. Source-bound indexes remain remembered when a producer
+// deletes its sidecar/index or leaves an incomplete attempt, so old rows cannot
+// silently outlive the artifact that justified them. Legacy producers with no
+// source receipt retain their existing explicit-import behavior.
+func (c *Client) reconcileSCIPSources(ctx context.Context, service, root string, importFresh bool) error {
+	paths := map[string]bool{}
+	keys, err := c.st.ListTypedEdgePackages(ctx, service)
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	for _, key := range keys {
+		if strings.HasPrefix(key, scipSourceStatePrefix) {
+			path, found, err := c.st.TypedEdgePackageFingerprint(ctx, service, key)
+			if err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+			if found {
+				paths[path] = true
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	candidates := []string{filepath.Join(root, "index.scip")}
+	// Use the same selected locations as CLI ingest: state-directory copies
+	// supersede same-named legacy files, without modifying either artifact.
+	candidates = append(candidates, statedir.SCIPIndexes(root)...)
+	shadowed := map[string]bool{}
+	for _, path := range statedir.ShadowedSCIP(root) {
+		shadowed[scipIndexKey(root, path)] = true
+	}
+	for _, path := range candidates {
+		if scip.SourceReceiptExpected(path) {
+			paths[path] = true
+		}
+	}
+	ordered := make([]string, 0, len(paths))
+	for path := range paths {
+		ordered = append(ordered, path)
+	}
+	slices.Sort(ordered)
+	var failures []error
+	for _, path := range ordered {
+		if shadowed[scipIndexKey(root, path)] {
+			// A remembered legacy source must not resurrect the shadowed
+			// namespace. Keep its marker/history, clear its derived rows.
+			if err := c.clearSCIPSource(context.WithoutCancel(ctx), service, root, path); err != nil {
+				failures = append(failures, fmt.Errorf("%w: shadowed legacy index: %v", scip.ErrSourceReceipt, err))
+			}
+			continue
+		}
+		if importFresh {
+			if _, err := c.ImportSCIP(ctx, service, path); err != nil {
+				failures = append(failures, err)
+			}
+			continue
+		}
+		raw, readErr := readSourceSCIP(ctx, path)
+		_, checkErr := scip.ValidateSourceReceipt(ctx, root, path, raw, true)
+		if readErr != nil {
+			checkErr = fmt.Errorf("%w: index: %v", scip.ErrSourceReceipt, readErr)
+		}
+		if checkErr != nil {
+			clearErr := c.clearSCIPSource(context.WithoutCancel(ctx), service, root, path)
+			failures = append(failures, errors.Join(checkErr, clearErr))
+		}
+	}
+	return errors.Join(failures...)
+}
+
+const sourceSCIPIndexLimit int64 = 64 << 20
+
+func readSourceSCIP(ctx context.Context, path string) ([]byte, error) {
+	file, err := os.Open(path)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	defer file.Close()
+	info, err := file.Stat()
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	if !info.Mode().IsRegular() || info.Size() > sourceSCIPIndexLimit {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("source-bound SCIP index is not regular or exceeds the 64MiB import budget")
+	}
+	if err := tenancy.Charge(ctx, info.Size()); err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	raw, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(file, sourceSCIPIndexLimit+1))
+	if len(raw) > int(sourceSCIPIndexLimit) {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("source-bound SCIP index grew beyond the 64MiB import budget")
+	}
+	return raw, err
+}

+func copySCIPSourcePair(t *testing.T, from, to string) {
+	t.Helper()
+	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(to), 0700); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	for _, suffix := range []string{"", ".receipt.json"} {
+		raw, err := os.ReadFile(from + suffix)
+		if err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+		if err := os.WriteFile(to+suffix, raw, 0600); err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+	}
+}

+func hasSCIPSourceNamespace(t *testing.T, st store.Store, prefix string) bool {
+	t.Helper()
+	packages, err := st.ListTypedEdgePackages(context.Background(), scipO116Service)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	for _, pkg := range packages {
+		if strings.HasPrefix(pkg, prefix) {
+			return true
+		}
+	}
+	return false
+}

+func TestSCIPSourceStateDirectorySelectionAndRefusal(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Setenv(statedir.EnvOverride, filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "state"))
+	c, st, root, original := scipSourceFixture(t)
+	legacy := filepath.Join(root, ".fathom", "scip", "native.scip")
+	fresh := statedir.LocalPath(root, projectdir.SCIP, "native.scip")
+	copySCIPSourcePair(t, original, legacy)
+	if err := c.IngestService(context.Background(), scipO116Service); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	legacyPrefix := "scip:.fathom/scip/native.scip::"
+	statePrefix := "scip:native.scip::"
+	if !hasSCIPSourceNamespace(t, st, legacyPrefix) {
+		t.Fatal("unshadowed legacy index was not imported")
+	}
+	copySCIPSourcePair(t, original, fresh)
+	// The remembered legacy bytes are now invalid. They must not be read as
+	// an active source once upstream state-directory precedence shadows them.
+	if err := os.WriteFile(legacy, []byte("superseded legacy bytes"), 0600); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if err := c.IngestService(context.Background(), scipO116Service); err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("valid selected state index refused: %v", err)
+	}
+	if hasSCIPSourceNamespace(t, st, legacyPrefix) || !hasSCIPSourceNamespace(t, st, statePrefix) {
+		t.Fatal("shadowed legacy rows survived or selected state index was not imported")
+	}
+	// A valid legacy copy cannot rescue a corrupt selected state index.
+	copySCIPSourcePair(t, original, legacy)
+	if err := os.WriteFile(fresh, []byte("failed preferred attempt"), 0600); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if err := c.IngestService(context.Background(), scipO116Service); !errors.Is(err, client.ErrSCIPSourceReceipt) {
+		t.Fatalf("preferred failure fell back instead of refusing: %v", err)
+	}
+	if hasSCIPSourceNamespace(t, st, legacyPrefix) || hasSCIPSourceNamespace(t, st, statePrefix) {
+		t.Fatal("preferred refusal retained selected or shadowed typed rows")
+	}
+	if !hasSCIPSourceNamespace(t, st, "scip:index.scip::") {
+		t.Fatal("state/legacy refusal removed the unrelated root index")
+	}
+}

+func scipSourceFixture(t *testing.T) (*client.Client, store.Store, string, string) {
+	t.Helper()
+	root := t.TempDir()
+	st := store.NewMemoryStore()
+	c := client.New(connector.NewLocalConnector(), st)
+	for name, body := range scipO116TSFixtureSources {
+		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, name), []byte(body), 0644); err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+	}
+	idx := scip.BuildTSFixtureIndex()
+	idx.Metadata.ProjectRoot = "file://" + filepath.ToSlash(root)
+	raw, err := proto.Marshal(idx)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	path := filepath.Join(root, "index.scip")
+	if err := os.WriteFile(path, raw, 0644); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	hash := func(data []byte) string { h := sha256.Sum256(data); return hex.EncodeToString(h[:]) }
+	var inputs []scip.SourceInput
+	var names []string
+	for _, name := range []string{"greeter.ts", "main.ts", "math.ts"} {
+		body, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, name))
+		if err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+		inputs = append(inputs, scip.SourceInput{Path: name, SHA256: hash(body)})
+		names = append(names, name)
+	}
+	receipt := scip.SourceReceipt{Schema: scip.SourceReceiptSchema, Status: "complete", Root: root, IndexSHA256: hash(raw), Producer: scip.SourceProducer{Name: idx.Metadata.ToolInfo.Name, Version: idx.Metadata.ToolInfo.Version}, Inputs: inputs, Inventories: []scip.SourceInventory{{Root: ".", Pattern: "*.ts", Paths: names}}}
+	data, err := json.Marshal(receipt)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if err := os.WriteFile(path+".receipt.json", data, 0644); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if _, err := c.Ingest(context.Background(), client.ServiceRef{ID: scipO116Service, Path: root}); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	return c, st, root, path
+}

+func TestSCIPSourceRefusalClearsOnlyItsOwnPriorRows(t *testing.T) {

+				t.Fatalf("initial edges=%d", got)
+			}
+			if err := st.PutTypedEdges(ctx, scipO116Service, "scip:other.scip::independent", []core.Edge{{FromSymbol: "unrelated", ToSymbol: "safe", Kind: core.EdgeDirect}}); err != nil {
+				t.Fatal(err)
+			}
+			if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, "math.ts"), []byte("export function add(a:number,b:number){return a-b;}\n"), 0644); err != nil {
+				t.Fatal(err)
+			}
+			var err error
+			switch entry {
+			case "import":
+				_, err = c.ImportSCIP(ctx, scipO116Service, path)
+			case "ingest":
+				_, err = c.Ingest(ctx, client.ServiceRef{ID: scipO116Service, Path: root})
+			case "daemon":
+				err = c.IngestService(ctx, scipO116Service)
+			case "onboard":
+				err = c.IngestServiceAt(ctx, scipO116Service, root)
+			case "file-refresh":
+				_, err = c.ReingestFile(ctx, scipO116Service, "math.ts")
+			}
+			if err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "receipt") {
+				t.Fatalf("err=%v, want receipt refusal", err)
+			}
+			edges := scipSourceEdges(t, c)
+			if len(edges) != 1 || edges[0].FromSymbol != "unrelated" {
+				t.Fatalf("stale edges survived or unrelated rows removed: %+v", edges)
+			}
+		})
+	}
+}

+package client
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"sort"
+
+	"github.com/geoffmilleraz/fathom/internal/connector"
+	"github.com/geoffmilleraz/fathom/internal/core"
+	"github.com/geoffmilleraz/fathom/internal/store"

+// SourceRefProjection reads facts sealed for an indexed ingest generation.
+// found=false means unavailable or invalid; callers must not treat that as an
+// empty corpus. The result makes no claim about current worktree bytes.
+func (c *Client) SourceRefProjection(ctx context.Context, service string) (store.SourceRefProjection, bool, error) {
+	reader, ok := c.st.(store.SourceRefProjectionReader)
+	if !ok {
+		return store.SourceRefProjection{}, false, nil
+	}
+	p, found, err := reader.ReadSourceRefProjection(ctx, service)
+	if err != nil || !found {
+		return p, found, err
+	}
+	local, ok := c.conn.(*connector.LocalConnector)
+	if !ok {
+		return store.SourceRefProjection{}, false, nil
+	}
+	// PolicyDigest's Git/walk mode follows Discover's actual selection. A
+	// restarted read client has no remembered mode, so derive it on a
+	// separate connector to avoid changing an in-flight ingest's roots.
+	probe := &connector.LocalConnector{RespectGitignore: local.RespectGitignore}
+	svc := core.ServiceRef{ID: service, Path: p.Root}
+	members, err := probe.Discover(ctx, svc)
+	if err != nil {
+		return store.SourceRefProjection{}, false, err
+	}
+	if len(members) != len(p.Rows) {
+		return store.SourceRefProjection{}, false, nil
+	}
+	for i, ref := range members {
+		if ref.Path != p.Rows[i].Path {
+			return store.SourceRefProjection{}, false, nil
+		}
+	}
+	policy, err := probe.DiscoveryPolicyDigest(ctx, svc)
+	if err != nil {
+		return store.SourceRefProjection{}, false, err
+	}
+	if policy != p.Policy {
+		return store.SourceRefProjection{}, false, nil
+	}
+	// file_stats is the store's scoped read. If a suppression hides even one
+	// member, refuse the whole sealed projection rather than serving refs or
+	// absence from an unfiltered optional store capability.
+	stats, ok, err := c.st.FileStats(ctx, service)
+	if err != nil {
+		return store.SourceRefProjection{}, false, err
+	}
+	if !ok || len(stats) != len(p.Rows) {
+		return store.SourceRefProjection{}, false, nil
+	}
+	sort.Slice(stats, func(i, j int) bool { return stats[i].Path < stats[j].Path })
+	for i, row := range p.Rows {
+		if stats[i].Path != row.Path || stats[i].Excluded != row.Excluded {
+			return store.SourceRefProjection{}, false, nil
+		}
+	}
+	return p, true, nil
+}

+func TestSourceRefProjectionRefusesPolicyDrift(t *testing.T) {
+	ctx := context.Background()
+	root := t.TempDir()
+	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, "a.go"), []byte("[FR-1]"), 0600); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	conn := &connector.LocalConnector{}
+	policy, err := conn.DiscoveryPolicyDigest(ctx, core.ServiceRef{ID: "svc", Path: root})
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	h := sha256.Sum256([]byte("[FR-1]"))
+	st := store.NewMemoryStore()
+	meta := store.ServiceMeta{ServiceID: "svc", Path: root, IndexedCommit: "head", IndexedAt: 1}
+	p := &store.SourceRefProjection{Policy: policy, ExtractorVersion: store.SourceRefExtractorVersion, Complete: true, Rows: []store.SourceRefFact{{Path: "a.go", SourceHash: hex.EncodeToString(h[:]), ExtractorVersion: store.SourceRefExtractorVersion, Refs: []string{"[FR-1]"}}}}
+	if err := st.WriteServiceSummary(ctx, meta, store.ServiceSummary{RefProjection: p}, []store.FileStat{{Path: "a.go"}}); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	c := New(conn, st)
+	if _, found, err := c.SourceRefProjection(ctx, "svc"); err != nil || !found {
+		t.Fatalf("valid projection missing: found=%v err=%v", found, err)
+	}
+	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, "new.go"), []byte("new"), 0600); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if _, found, err := c.SourceRefProjection(ctx, "svc"); err != nil || found {
+		t.Fatalf("membership drift accepted: found=%v err=%v", found, err)
+	}
+	if err := os.Remove(filepath.Join(root, "new.go")); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	conn.RespectGitignore = true
+	if _, found, err := c.SourceRefProjection(ctx, "svc"); err != nil || found {
+		t.Fatalf("policy drift accepted: found=%v err=%v", found, err)
+	}
+}

+package client
+
+// A source window is an observed, bounded comparison of a sealed ingest
+// projection with the current local tree. It holds hashes, never file bodies.
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"crypto/sha256"
+	"encoding/hex"
+	"errors"
+	"fmt"
+	"hash"
+	"io"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"sort"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/geoffmilleraz/fathom/internal/connector"
+	"github.com/geoffmilleraz/fathom/internal/store"
+	"github.com/geoffmilleraz/fathom/internal/tenancy"
+)
+
+const sourceWindowBytes = 64 << 20
+const sourceWindowTime = 5 * time.Second
+
+// SourceWindow keeps only one file's rolling hash and per-member hashes.
+// Its owner serializes calls; a failed call invalidates the window.
+type SourceWindow struct {
+	Projection  store.SourceRefProjection
+	Pass, Index int
+	Offset      int64
+	Bytes       int64
+	Files       int
+	Ready       bool
+	Failed      bool
+	first       []string
+	hash        hash.Hash
+	identity    os.FileInfo
+	stats       []store.FileStat
+	readChunk   func(context.Context, *os.File, []byte) (int, error) // test seam for a late filesystem read
+}
+
+// ExcludedHashes names the current bytes observed at both boundaries. These
+// hashes attest only this window; the excluded ingest rows have no ref facts.
+func (w *SourceWindow) ExcludedHashes() []map[string]string {
+	if w == nil || !w.Ready || w.Failed {
+		return nil
+	}
+	out := make([]map[string]string, 0)
+	for i, row := range w.Projection.Rows {
+		if row.Excluded != "" {
+			out = append(out, map[string]string{"path": row.Path, "reason": row.Excluded, "sha256": w.first[i]})
+		}
+	}
+	return out
+}
+
+// BeginSourceWindow refuses absent seals, non-local connectors and any
+// membership, root, policy, exclusion or file_stats disagreement.
+func (c *Client) BeginSourceWindow(ctx context.Context, service string) (*SourceWindow, error) {
+	release, err := acquireSourcesSlot(ctx)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	defer release()
+	ctx, cancel := cancelOnAbandon(ctx)
+	defer cancel()
+	p, found, err := c.SourceRefProjection(ctx, service)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	if !found || !store.ValidSourceRefProjection(p) || p.ServiceID != service {
+		return nil, errors.New("current source window: sealed projection unavailable")
+	}
+	stats, err := c.sourceWindowBoundary(ctx, p, nil)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	return &SourceWindow{Projection: p, first: make([]string, len(p.Rows)), stats: stats}, nil
+}
+
+func (c *Client) sourceWindowBoundary(ctx context.Context, p store.SourceRefProjection, baseline []store.FileStat) ([]store.FileStat, error) {
+	meta, found, err := c.st.GetServiceMeta(ctx, p.ServiceID)
+	if err != nil || !found || meta.Path != p.Root || store.WatermarkOf(meta) != p.Watermark {
+		return nil, errors.New("current source window: root or watermark changed")
+	}
+	latest, found, err := c.SourceRefProjection(ctx, p.ServiceID)
+	if err != nil || !found || latest.Root != p.Root || latest.Policy != p.Policy || latest.Watermark != p.Watermark || latest.MembershipHash != p.MembershipHash || latest.ExtractorVersion != p.ExtractorVersion || latest.ProducedAt != p.ProducedAt || latest.Complete != p.Complete || latest.Scope != p.Scope {
+		return nil, errors.New("current source window: seal or discovery changed")
+	}
+	stats, ok, err := c.st.FileStats(ctx, p.ServiceID)
+	if err != nil || !ok || len(stats) != len(p.Rows) {
+		return nil, errors.New("current source window: file_stats unavailable or changed")
+	}
+	sort.Slice(stats, func(i, j int) bool { return stats[i].Path < stats[j].Path })
+	for i, row := range p.Rows {
+		if stats[i].Path != row.Path || stats[i].Excluded != row.Excluded {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("current source window: file_stats mismatch at %s", row.Path)
+		}
+		if baseline != nil && stats[i] != baseline[i] {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("current source window: file_stats fields changed at %s", row.Path)
+		}
+		if row.Excluded != "" && row.Excluded != "oversize" {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("current source window: unreadable or unreviewed exclusion %s: %s", row.Path, row.Excluded)
+		}
+	}
+	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	return append([]store.FileStat(nil), stats...), nil
+}
+
+// AdvanceSourceWindow reads at most byteLimit bytes and observes a timeLimit
+// deadline. A synchronous filesystem read can return after that deadline;
+// such an overrun invalidates the window and cannot publish a verdict.
+// Zero limits select the production 64 MiB / 5 s unit. The caller must not
+// retain a SourcesScope across calls: each unit takes and releases its slot.
+func (c *Client) AdvanceSourceWindow(ctx context.Context, w *SourceWindow, byteLimit int64, timeLimit time.Duration) (err error) {
+	if w == nil || w.Failed || w.Ready {
+		return errors.New("current source window: invalid continuation")
+	}
+	if byteLimit <= 0 || byteLimit > sourceWindowBytes {
+		byteLimit = sourceWindowBytes
+	}
+	if timeLimit <= 0 || timeLimit > sourceWindowTime {
+		timeLimit = sourceWindowTime
+	}
+	parentCtx := ctx
+	ctx, deadlineCancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, timeLimit)
+	defer deadlineCancel()
+	release, err := acquireSourcesSlot(ctx)
+	if err != nil {
+		w.Failed = true
+		return err
+	}
+	defer release()
+	ctx, cancel := cancelOnAbandon(ctx)
+	defer cancel()
+	deadline, _ := ctx.Deadline()
+	spent := int64(0)
+	buf := make([]byte, 256<<10)
+	for spent < byteLimit && time.Now().Before(deadline) {
+		if err = ctx.Err(); err != nil {
+			if errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) && parentCtx.Err() == nil {
+				return nil
+			}
+			w.Failed = true
+			return err
+		}
+		if w.Index == len(w.Projection.Rows) {
+			if w.Pass == 0 {
+				w.Pass = 1
+				w.Index = 0
+				w.Offset = 0
+				w.hash = nil
+				w.identity = nil
+				return nil
+			}
+			_, err = c.sourceWindowBoundary(ctx, w.Projection, w.stats)
+			if err != nil {
+				w.Failed = true
+				return err
+			}
+			if err = ctx.Err(); err != nil {
+				w.Failed = true
+				return err
+			}
+			w.Ready = true
+			return nil
+		}
+		row := w.Projection.Rows[w.Index]
+		path := filepath.Join(w.Projection.Root, filepath.FromSlash(row.Path))
+		if !filepath.IsLocal(row.Path) {
+			w.Failed = true
+			return fmt.Errorf("current source window: nonlocal path %q", row.Path)
+		}
+		li, e := os.Lstat(path)
+		if e != nil || !li.Mode().IsRegular() {
+			w.Failed = true
+			return fmt.Errorf("current source window: unreadable or nonregular %s: %v", row.Path, e)
+		}
+		if row.Excluded == "oversize" && li.Size() <= connector.MaxFetchSize || row.Excluded == "" && li.Size() > connector.MaxFetchSize {
+			w.Failed = true
+			return fmt.Errorf("current source window: eligibility changed at %s", row.Path)
+		}
+		if err = tenancy.ProducerAllowsCtx(ctx, tenancy.ClassTree); err != nil {
+			w.Failed = true
+			return fmt.Errorf("current source window: producer refusal: %w", err)
+		}
+		f, e := os.Open(path)
+		if e != nil {
+			w.Failed = true
+			return fmt.Errorf("current source window: open %s: %w", row.Path, e)
+		}
+		fi, e := f.Stat()
+		if e != nil || !os.SameFile(li, fi) || (w.identity != nil && (!os.SameFile(w.identity, fi) || w.identity.Size() != fi.Size() || !w.identity.ModTime().Equal(fi.ModTime()))) {
+			f.Close()
+			w.Failed = true
+			return fmt.Errorf("current source window: file changed at %s", row.Path)
+		}
+		if w.hash == nil {
+			w.hash = sha256.New()
+			w.identity = fi
+		}
+		if _, e = f.Seek(w.Offset, io.SeekStart); e != nil {
+			f.Close()
+			w.Failed = true
+			return e
+		}
+		remaining := byteLimit - spent
+		if remaining > int64(len(buf)) {
+			remaining = int64(len(buf))
+		}
+		var n int
+		if w.readChunk != nil {
+			n, e = w.readChunk(ctx, f, buf[:remaining])
+		} else {
+			n, e = f.Read(buf[:remaining])
+		}
+		post, statErr := f.Stat()
+		f.Close()
+		if err = ctx.Err(); err != nil {
+			w.Failed = true
+			return err
+		}
+		if !time.Now().Before(deadline) {
+			w.Failed = true
+			return context.DeadlineExceeded
+		}
+		if err = tenancy.ProducerAllowsCtx(ctx, tenancy.ClassTree); err != nil {
+			w.Failed = true
+			return fmt.Errorf("current source window: producer refusal: %w", err)
+		}
+		if statErr != nil || !os.SameFile(w.identity, post) || w.identity.Size() != post.Size() || !w.identity.ModTime().Equal(post.ModTime()) {
+			w.Failed = true
+			return fmt.Errorf("current source window: file mutated at %s", row.Path)
+		}
+		if e != nil && e != io.EOF {
+			w.Failed = true
+			return fmt.Errorf("current source window: read %s: %w", row.Path, e)
+		}
+		if n > 0 {
+			w.hash.Write(buf[:n])
+			w.Offset += int64(n)
+			w.Bytes += int64(n)
+			spent += int64(n)
+		}
+		if w.Offset < fi.Size() {
+			if e == io.EOF || n == 0 {
+				w.Failed = true
+				return fmt.Errorf("current source window: short read at %s", row.Path)
+			}
+			continue
+		}
+		got := hex.EncodeToString(w.hash.Sum(nil))
+		if row.Excluded == "" && got != row.SourceHash {
+			w.Failed = true
+			return fmt.Errorf("current source window: source hash changed at %s", row.Path)
+		}
+		if w.Pass == 0 {
+			w.first[w.Index] = got
+		} else if got != w.first[w.Index] {
+			w.Failed = true
+			return fmt.Errorf("current source window: bytes changed across window at %s", row.Path)
+		}
+		w.Files++
+		w.Index++
+		w.Offset = 0
+		w.hash = nil
+		w.identity = nil
+	}
+	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil && (!errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) || parentCtx.Err() != nil) {
+		w.Failed = true
+		return err
+	}
+	return nil
+}

+func windowFixture(t *testing.T) (*Client, *store.MemoryStore, string) {
+	t.Helper()
+	root := t.TempDir()
+	small := []byte("[FR-1]")
+	large := bytes.Repeat([]byte("x"), connector.MaxFetchSize+17)
+	for name, data := range map[string][]byte{"a.go": small, "large.dat": large} {
+		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, name), data, 0600); err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+	}
+	conn := connector.NewLocalConnector()
+	ctx := context.Background()
+	policy, err := conn.DiscoveryPolicyDigest(ctx, core.ServiceRef{ID: "svc", Path: root})
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	h := sha256.Sum256(small)
+	p := &store.SourceRefProjection{Policy: policy, ExtractorVersion: store.SourceRefExtractorVersion, Rows: []store.SourceRefFact{
+		{Path: "a.go", SourceHash: hex.EncodeToString(h[:]), ExtractorVersion: store.SourceRefExtractorVersion, Refs: []string{"[FR-1]"}},
+		{Path: "large.dat", ExtractorVersion: store.SourceRefExtractorVersion, Excluded: "oversize"},
+	}}
+	st := store.NewMemoryStore()
+	meta := store.ServiceMeta{ServiceID: "svc", Path: root, IndexedCommit: "head", IndexedAt: 1}
+	if err := st.WriteServiceSummary(ctx, meta, store.ServiceSummary{RefProjection: p}, []store.FileStat{{Path: "a.go"}, {Path: "large.dat", Excluded: "oversize"}}); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	return New(conn, st), st, root
+}
+
+func advanceWindowPass(t *testing.T, c *Client, w *SourceWindow, want int) {
+	t.Helper()
+	for i := 0; i < 30 && w.Pass == want && !w.Ready; i++ {
+		before := w.Bytes
+		if err := c.AdvanceSourceWindow(context.Background(), w, 256<<10, 5*time.Second); err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+		if w.Bytes-before > 256<<10 {
+			t.Fatalf("unit read %d bytes", w.Bytes-before)
+		}
+	}
+	if want == 0 && w.Pass != 1 || want == 1 && !w.Ready {
+		t.Fatalf("window did not complete pass %d: %+v", want, w)
+	}
+}
+
+func TestSourceWindowChunksLargeCorpusAndCloses(t *testing.T) {
+	c, _, _ := windowFixture(t)
+	w, err := c.BeginSourceWindow(context.Background(), "svc")
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	advanceWindowPass(t, c, w, 0)
+	if w.Ready || w.Projection.Rows[1].Refs != nil {
+		t.Fatal("provisional window or excluded refs became final")
+	}
+	advanceWindowPass(t, c, w, 1)
+	wantBytes := int64(2 * (len("[FR-1]") + connector.MaxFetchSize + 17))
+	if !w.Ready || w.Bytes != wantBytes || w.Files != 4 || w.Offset != 0 {
+		t.Fatalf("two-pass bytes=%d ready=%v", w.Bytes, w.Ready)
+	}
+}

+func TestSourceWindowRefusesDriftAndCancellation(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, tc := range []struct {
+		name   string
+		mutate func(*testing.T, *store.MemoryStore, string)
+	}{
+		{"examined bytes", func(t *testing.T, _ *store.MemoryStore, root string) {
+			os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, "a.go"), []byte("[FR-2]"), 0600)
+		}},
+		{"new member", func(t *testing.T, _ *store.MemoryStore, root string) {
+			os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, "new.go"), []byte("new"), 0600)
+		}},
+		{"policy", func(t *testing.T, _ *store.MemoryStore, root string) {
+			os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, ".fathomignore"), []byte("new.go\n"), 0600)
+		}},
+		{"excluded bytes", func(t *testing.T, _ *store.MemoryStore, root string) {
+			os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, "large.dat"), bytes.Repeat([]byte("z"), connector.MaxFetchSize+17), 0600)
+		}},
+		{"excluded eligibility", func(t *testing.T, _ *store.MemoryStore, root string) {
+			os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, "large.dat"), []byte("small"), 0600)
+		}},
+		{"symlink", func(t *testing.T, _ *store.MemoryStore, root string) {
+			os.Remove(filepath.Join(root, "large.dat"))
+			os.Symlink(filepath.Join(root, "a.go"), filepath.Join(root, "large.dat"))
+		}},
+		{"watermark", func(t *testing.T, st *store.MemoryStore, _ string) {
+			st.SetServiceMeta(context.Background(), store.ServiceMeta{ServiceID: "svc", Path: "/changed", IndexedCommit: "new", IndexedAt: 2})
+		}},
+	} {
+		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			c, st, root := windowFixture(t)
+			w, err := c.BeginSourceWindow(context.Background(), "svc")
+			if err != nil {
+				t.Fatal(err)
+			}
+			advanceWindowPass(t, c, w, 0)
+			tc.mutate(t, st, root)
+			failed := false
+			for i := 0; i < 30 && !w.Ready && !failed; i++ {
+				failed = c.AdvanceSourceWindow(context.Background(), w, 256<<10, 5*time.Second) != nil
+			}
+			if !failed || !w.Failed || w.Ready {
+				t.Fatalf("drift accepted: failed=%v state=%+v", failed, w)
+			}
+		})
+	}
+	c, _, _ := windowFixture(t)
+	w, err := c.BeginSourceWindow(context.Background(), "svc")
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
+	cancel()
+	if err := c.AdvanceSourceWindow(ctx, w, 256<<10, time.Second); err == nil || !w.Failed {
+		t.Fatalf("cancel accepted: %v %+v", err, w)
+	}
+	if !strings.Contains(c.AdvanceSourceWindow(context.Background(), w, 256<<10, time.Second).Error(), "invalid continuation") {
+		t.Fatal("failed window replayed")
+	}
+}

+func TestSourceWindowRejectsMutationBetweenPartialOffsets(t *testing.T) {
+	c, _, root := windowFixture(t)
+	w, err := c.BeginSourceWindow(context.Background(), "svc")
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	for w.Index == 0 {
+		if err := c.AdvanceSourceWindow(context.Background(), w, 64<<10, time.Second); err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+	}
+	if err := c.AdvanceSourceWindow(context.Background(), w, 64<<10, time.Second); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if w.Index != 1 || w.Offset == 0 {
+		t.Fatalf("large file did not retain offset: %+v", w)
+	}
+	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, "large.dat"), bytes.Repeat([]byte("z"), connector.MaxFetchSize+17), 0600); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if err := c.AdvanceSourceWindow(context.Background(), w, 64<<10, time.Second); err == nil || !w.Failed {
+		t.Fatalf("partial-file mutation accepted: %v %+v", err, w)
+	}
+}

+type windowDriftStats struct {
+	*store.MemoryStore
+	change func(*store.FileStat)
+}
+
+func (s *windowDriftStats) FileStats(ctx context.Context, service string) ([]store.FileStat, bool, error) {
+	rows, ok, err := s.MemoryStore.FileStats(ctx, service)
+	if s.change != nil && len(rows) > 0 {
+		s.change(&rows[0])
+	}
+	return rows, ok, err
+}

+func TestSourceWindowRefusesEveryFileStatFieldDrift(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, tc := range []struct {
+		name   string
+		change func(*store.FileStat)
+	}{
+		{"size", func(f *store.FileStat) { f.Size++ }},
+		{"mtime", func(f *store.FileStat) { f.MtimeNS++ }},
+		{"inode", func(f *store.FileStat) { f.Ino++ }},
+		{"content hash", func(f *store.FileStat) { f.ContentHash = "changed" }},
+		{"language", func(f *store.FileStat) { f.Lang = "changed" }},
+	} {
+		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			c, st, _ := windowFixture(t)
+			drift := &windowDriftStats{MemoryStore: st}
+			c.st = drift
+			w, err := c.BeginSourceWindow(context.Background(), "svc")
+			if err != nil {
+				t.Fatal(err)
+			}
+			advanceWindowPass(t, c, w, 0)
+			drift.change = tc.change
+			for i := 0; i < 30 && !w.Ready && !w.Failed; i++ {
+				_ = c.AdvanceSourceWindow(context.Background(), w, 256<<10, 5*time.Second)
+			}
+			if !w.Failed || w.Ready {
+				t.Fatalf("file_stats %s drift accepted", tc.name)
+			}
+		})
+	}
+}

+func TestSourceWindowAbandonAndGovernorRefuse(t *testing.T) {
+	c, _, _ := windowFixture(t)
+	w, err := c.BeginSourceWindow(context.Background(), "svc")
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	abandon := make(chan struct{})
+	ctx, done := WithSourcesScope(context.Background(), abandon)
+	defer done()
+	close(abandon)
+	if err := c.AdvanceSourceWindow(ctx, w, 256<<10, time.Second); err == nil || !w.Failed {
+		t.Fatalf("abandoned read accepted: %v", err)
+	}
+	c, _, _ = windowFixture(t)
+	w, err = c.BeginSourceWindow(context.Background(), "svc")
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	tenancy.PublishLevel(tenancy.LevelRefuse)
+	defer tenancy.PublishLevel(tenancy.LevelNormal)
+	if err := c.AdvanceSourceWindow(context.Background(), w, 256<<10, time.Second); err == nil || !w.Failed || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "producer refusal") {
+		t.Fatalf("governor read accepted: %v", err)
+	}
+}

+func TestSourceWindowLateReadAndMidReadRefusalInvalidate(t *testing.T) {
+	c, _, _ := windowFixture(t)
+	w, err := c.BeginSourceWindow(context.Background(), "svc")
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	entered := false
+	w.readChunk = func(ctx context.Context, f *os.File, buf []byte) (int, error) {
+		entered = true
+		<-ctx.Done()
+		return f.Read(buf)
+	}
+	if err := c.AdvanceSourceWindow(context.Background(), w, 256<<10, time.Second); !entered || !errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) || !w.Failed || w.Ready || w.Bytes != 0 {
+		t.Fatalf("late read accepted: entered=%v err=%v failed=%v ready=%v bytes=%d", entered, err, w.Failed, w.Ready, w.Bytes)
+	}
+
+	c, _, _ = windowFixture(t)
+	w, err = c.BeginSourceWindow(context.Background(), "svc")
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	w.readChunk = func(_ context.Context, f *os.File, buf []byte) (int, error) {
+		n, err := f.Read(buf)
+		tenancy.PublishLevel(tenancy.LevelRefuse)
+		return n, err
+	}
+	defer tenancy.PublishLevel(tenancy.LevelNormal)
+	if err := c.AdvanceSourceWindow(context.Background(), w, 256<<10, time.Second); err == nil || !w.Failed || w.Bytes != 0 || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "producer refusal") {
+		t.Fatalf("mid-read refusal accepted: err=%v failed=%v bytes=%d", err, w.Failed, w.Bytes)
+	}
+}

+	store.Store

+func (s projectionCapabilityStore) ListSymbolNodes(context.Context, string) ([]core.SymbolNode, error) {
+	return s.nodes, s.err

+func TestListAllSymbolsProjectionCapabilityAndFallback(t *testing.T) {
+	want := []core.SymbolNode{{Service: "svc", Name: "AllFields", Package: "p", FilePath: "a.go", Signature: "complete header", Calls: []string{"p.Target"}, Line: 7, EndLine: 11, Complexity: 3}}
+	fast := &Client{st: projectionCapabilityStore{nodes: want}}
+	got, err := fast.ListAllSymbols(context.Background(), "svc")
+	if err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
+		t.Fatalf("capability result = %#v, %v", got, err)
+	}
+	sentinel := errors.New("projection terminal failure")
+	fast.st = projectionCapabilityStore{nodes: want, err: sentinel}
+	got, err = fast.ListAllSymbols(context.Background(), "svc")
+	if !errors.Is(err, sentinel) || got != nil || err.Error() != "client.ListAllSymbols: projection terminal failure" {
+		t.Fatalf("partial/failure escaped: %#v, %v", got, err)
+	}
+	memory := store.NewMemoryStore()
+	obs := []core.Observation{{ServiceID: "svc", Symbol: "Fallback", SourceRef: "b.go"}}
+	if err := memory.PutObservations(context.Background(), obs); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	legacy := &Client{st: observationOnlyStore{memory}}
+	got, err = legacy.ListAllSymbols(context.Background(), "svc")
+	if err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(got, []core.SymbolNode{obs[0].ToSymbolNode()}) {
+		t.Fatalf("Store fallback changed: %#v, %v", got, err)
+	}
+}

+func symbolProjectionFixture(tb testing.TB) (*Client, *Client, int) {
+	tb.Helper()
+	s, err := store.NewSQLiteStore(filepath.Join(tb.TempDir(), "symbols.sqlite"))
+	if err != nil {
+		tb.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	tb.Cleanup(func() { _ = s.Close() })
+	const count = 16384
+	rows := make([]core.Observation, count)
+	now := time.Date(2026, 10, 1, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
+	for i := range rows {
+		rows[i] = core.Observation{ServiceID: "svc", SourceRef: fmt.Sprintf("data/nested/%05d.json", i), SourceKind: core.SourceKind("JSONKey"), Symbol: fmt.Sprintf("Root.Section.Entry%05d", i), Package: "data", Claim: strings.Repeat("payload", 48), IngestedAt: now.Add(time.Duration(i%17) * time.Second)}
+		if i%4 == 0 {
+			rows[i].Calls = []string{"data.Target"}
+		}
+	}
+	if err := s.PutObservations(context.Background(), rows); err != nil {
+		tb.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	return &Client{st: s}, &Client{st: observationOnlyStore{s}}, count
+}

+func TestListAllSymbolsProjectionFullCorpusDifferential(t *testing.T) {
+	fast, legacy, count := symbolProjectionFixture(t)
+	a, err := fast.ListAllSymbols(context.Background(), "svc")
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	b, err := legacy.ListAllSymbols(context.Background(), "svc")
+	if err != nil || len(a) != count || !reflect.DeepEqual(a, b) {
+		t.Fatalf("full corpus/order/fields changed: fast=%d legacy=%d err=%v", len(a), len(b), err)
+	}
+	var calls int
+	for _, n := range a {
+		calls += len(n.Calls)
+	}
+	if calls != count/4 {
+		t.Fatalf("raw calls changed: %d", calls)
+	}
+}
+
+var symbolProjectionSink []core.SymbolNode
+
+func projectionAllocated(t *testing.T, client *Client, count int) uint64 {
+	t.Helper()
+	runtime.GC() // Measurement boundary only; production GC policy is unchanged.
+	var before, after runtime.MemStats
+	runtime.ReadMemStats(&before)
+	nodes, err := client.ListAllSymbols(context.Background(), "svc")
+	runtime.ReadMemStats(&after)
+	if err != nil || len(nodes) != count {
+		t.Fatalf("allocation workload changed: %d, %v", len(nodes), err)
+	}
+	symbolProjectionSink = nodes
+	return after.TotalAlloc - before.TotalAlloc
+}
+
+func TestListAllSymbolsProjectionAllocationBound(t *testing.T) {
+	fast, legacy, count := symbolProjectionFixture(t)
+	for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
+		oldBytes := projectionAllocated(t, legacy, count)
+		newBytes := projectionAllocated(t, fast, count)
+		saved := int64(oldBytes) - int64(newBytes)
+		t.Logf("sample=%d nodes=%d raw_calls=%d legacy_B=%d projected_B=%d saved_B=%d", i, count, count/4, oldBytes, newBytes, saved)
+		// A falsifiable conservative hypothesis, not an observed saving.
+		if saved < 1<<20 {
+			t.Fatalf("projection did not save the fixed 1MiB floor: %d", saved)
+		}
+	}
+}
+
+func BenchmarkListAllSymbolsProjection(b *testing.B) {
+	fast, legacy, count := symbolProjectionFixture(b)
+	for _, item := range []struct {
+		name   string
+		client *Client
+	}{{"legacy", legacy}, {"projected", fast}} {
+		b.Run(item.name, func(b *testing.B) {
+			b.ReportAllocs()
+			for i := 0; i < b.N; i++ {
+				nodes, err := item.client.ListAllSymbols(context.Background(), "svc")
+				if err != nil || len(nodes) != count {
+					b.Fatalf("incomplete workload: %d, %v", len(nodes), err)
+				}
+				symbolProjectionSink = nodes
+			}
+			b.ReportMetric(float64(count), "nodes/op")
+			b.ReportMetric(float64(count/4), "raw-calls/op")
+		})
+	}
